462	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
463	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
464	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
465	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
466	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
467	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
468	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
469	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
470	    if ($Catalog) {
471	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
472	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
473	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
474	        return $raw
475	    }
476	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
477	    $raw
478	}

483	    $null

486	# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
487	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
488	# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
489	function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
490	    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
491	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
492	    $models = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $Catalog
493	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
494	    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
495	
496	    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
497	    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
498	        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
499	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
500	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
501	
502	        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
503	            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
504	        )
505	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
506	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
507	
508	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
509	            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
510	        )
511	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
512	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
513	
514	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
515	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
516	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
517	    }
518	    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
519	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
520	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
521	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
522	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
523	    }
524	
525	    [ordered]@{
526	        main   = $main
527	        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
528	        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
529	        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
530	        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
531	    }
532	}

543	# "<model>|<source>" — the model Claude Code would send from this directory.
544	function script:Get-CopilotEffectiveModel {
545	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
546	    if (Test-Path $settings) {
547	        try {
548	            $j = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
549	            if ($j.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
550	                $m = $j.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
551	                if ($m) { return "$m|project pin: $settings" }
552	            }
553	        } catch { $null = $_ }
554	    }
555	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return "$($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL)|`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" }
556	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
557	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return "$(Get-Content -First 1 $sf)|state file: $sf" }
558	    "$(Get-CopilotDefaultModel)|built-in default"
559	}

561	# The EXACT env block `copilot-here on` / `copilot-run` would apply right now.
562	#
563	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for three callers: copilot-run (process env),
564	# `copilot-here on` (what it merges into settings.local.json) and
565	# Get-CopilotHereDrift (what it compares against). These used to be hand-maintained
566	# copies and they diverged — the drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `on` writes,
567	# so a pin missing ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
568	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC reported "no drift" while `on` would
569	# still have changed it. Add a key here and all three follow.
570	#
571	# -Pinned uses the shim base when the shim is enabled but not yet up (what a
572	# written-to-disk pin should say); copilot-run wants the live base instead.
573	function script:Get-CopilotEnvBlock {
574	    param([switch] $Pinned, [string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
575	    $modelProfile = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) {
576	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
577	    } else {
578	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model
579	    }
580	    $block = [ordered]@{
581	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = if ($Pinned) { Get-CopilotPinnedBase } else { Get-CopilotClientBase }
582	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
583	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $modelProfile.main
584	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL  = $modelProfile.fable
585	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $modelProfile.opus
586	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = $modelProfile.sonnet
587	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = $modelProfile.haiku
588	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = $modelProfile.haiku
589	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
590	    }
591	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
592	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
593	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
594	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
595	        $block.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
596	    }
597	    $block
598	}

600	# --- shim start/stop ---
601	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
602	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
603	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
604	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
605	    }
606	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
607	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
608	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
609	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
610	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
611	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
612	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
613	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
614	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
615	}
616	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
617	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
618	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
619	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
620	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
621	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
622	    }
623	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
624	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
625	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
626	}

628	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
629	function copilot-proxy {
630	    [CmdletBinding()]
631	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
632	
633	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
634	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
635	    }
636	
637	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
638	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
639	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
640	
641	    switch ($action) {
642	        'start' {
643	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
644	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
645	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
646	            }
647	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
648	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
649	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
650	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
651	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
652	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
653	            }
654	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
655	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
656	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
657	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
658	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
659	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
660	
661	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
662	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
663	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
664	            if ($httpProxy) {
665	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
666	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
667	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
668	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
669	            }
670	
671	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
672	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
673	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
674	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
675	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
676	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
677	            } else {
678	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
679	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
680	            }
681	
682	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
683	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
684	            $saved = @{}
685	            if ($httpProxy) {
686	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
687	            }
688	            try {
689	                $spArgs = @{
690	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
691	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
692	                    PassThru                = $true
693	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
694	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
695	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
696	                }
697	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
698	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
699	            } finally {
700	                if ($httpProxy) {
701	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
702	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
703	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
704	                    }
705	                }
706	            }
707	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
708	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
709	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
710	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
711	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
712	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
713	                    }
714	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
715	                    return
716	                }
717	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
718	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
719	                if ($p.HasExited) {
720	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
721	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
722	                }
723	                Start-Sleep 1
724	            }
725	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
726	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
727	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
728	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
729	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
730	        }
731	        'stop' {
732	            Stop-CopilotShim
733	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
734	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
735	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
736	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
737	            }
738	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
739	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
740	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
741	            Start-Sleep 1
742	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
743	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
744	        }
745	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
746	        'status' {
747	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
748	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
749	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
750	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
751	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
752	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
753	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
754	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
755	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
756	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
757	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
758	            } else {
759	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
760	            }
761	        }
762	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
763	        'logs' {
764	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
765	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
766	            } else {
767	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
768	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
769	            }
770	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
771	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
772	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
773	        }
774	        'auth' {
775	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
776	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
777	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
778	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth --provider copilot }
779	        }
780	        'reinstall' {
781	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
782	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
783	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
784	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
785	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
786	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $(Get-CopilotPkg) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
787	        }
788	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
789	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
790	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
791	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
792	            }
793	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
794	                try {
795	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
796	                    [pscustomobject]@{
797	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
798	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
799	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
800	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
801	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
802	            } else {
803	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
804	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
805	            }
806	        }
807	        'shim' {
808	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
809	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
810	            switch ($sub) {
811	                'on' {
812	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
813	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
814	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
815	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
816	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
817	                }
818	                'off' {
819	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
820	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
821	                }
822	                default {
823	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
824	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
825	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
826	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
827	                }
828	            }
829	        }
830	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
831	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
832	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
833	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
834	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
835	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
836	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
837	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
838	        }
839	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
840	    }
841	}
842	
843	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
844	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
845	    param([switch] $Live)
846	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
847	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
848	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
849	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
850	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
851	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
852	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
853	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
854	
855	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
856	
857	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
858	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
859	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
860	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
861	    }
862	
863	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
864	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
865	    # network at all. An un-installed prefix is not a fault: the next start installs it.
866	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
867	        OK 'installed' $pkg
868	        $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
869	        if ($launch) {
870	            $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()
871	            if ($launch.Cwd) { $how += "   (cwd: $($launch.Cwd))" }
872	            SKIP 'runs via' $how
873	        } else { BAD 'runs via' 'no runnable binary'; HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall' }
874	    } else {
875	        NOTE 'not installed' "$pkg — the next 'copilot-proxy start' installs it (one-time)"
876	        HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now'
877	    }
878	
879	    Write-Host "`nAuthentication"
880	    if (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken)) { OK 'token file' (Get-CopilotToken) } else { BAD 'token file' 'absent'; HINT 'copilot-proxy auth' }
881	
882	    Write-Host "`nProxy"
883	    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { OK 'listening' (Get-CopilotBase) } else { BAD 'listening' "nothing on port $port"; HINT 'copilot-proxy start' }
884	    # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds the
885	    # port: `start` just says "did not come up in time" and the log shows only
886	    # "Resolving dependencies". Hard failure when nothing is listening (that IS the
887	    # fault), softer when the proxy is up (a leftover still holding bun's cache lock,
888	    # which will hang the next restart).
889	    $stale = @(Get-CopilotStaleInstaller)
890	    if ($stale.Count -gt 0) {
891	        if (Test-CopilotAlive) { NOTE 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)" }
892	        else { BAD 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at `"Resolving dependencies`", never binds port $port" }
893	        HINT "kill just those: Stop-Process -Id $($stale.ProcessId -join ',') -Force"
894	        HINT 'then: copilot-proxy reinstall'
895	        HINT 're-hangs? bun is stalling on the proxy — $env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1; copilot-proxy reinstall'
896	    } else {
897	        SKIP 'installer' "no wedged 'bun add' process"
898	    }
899	    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
900	        if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { OK 'throttle shim' "up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)" } else { BAD 'throttle shim' 'enabled but DOWN'; HINT 'copilot-proxy shim on' }
901	    } else { SKIP 'throttle shim' 'off' }
902	
903	    Write-Host "`nModels"
904	    $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
905	    $proxyMode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
906	    if ($httpProxy) { NOTE 'http proxy' "$httpProxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this" }
907	    else { SKIP 'http proxy' "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode)" }
908	
909	    # A/B: true-direct vs via the local proxy. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog
910	    # on some egress, and .NET/curl follow the System Proxy by default — so a single
911	    # "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as an entitlement problem.
912	    $dirClaude = 0; $viaClaude = 0; $anyUpstream = $false
913	    $upDirect = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via 'direct'
914	    if ($upDirect) {
915	        $anyUpstream = $true
916	        $dirClaude = @($upDirect | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
917	        OK 'upstream direct' "$($upDirect.Count) ids, $dirClaude claude (no proxy)"
918	    } else {
919	        SKIP 'upstream direct' 'could not query GitHub direct (need a token, or blocked)'
920	    }
921	    if ($httpProxy) {
922	        $upVia = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via $httpProxy
923	        if ($upVia) {
924	            $anyUpstream = $true
925	            $viaClaude = @($upVia | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
926	            OK 'upstream via proxy' "$($upVia.Count) ids, $viaClaude claude ($httpProxy)"
927	        } else {
928	            BAD 'upstream via proxy' "no response through $httpProxy"
929	            HINT 'the Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another selection'
930	        }
931	    }
932	
933	    $served = Get-CopilotServedModels
934	    if ($served -and $served.Count -gt 0) {
935	        $claude = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' })
936	        OK 'served' "$($served.Count) model ids"
937	        if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { OK 'claude models' "$($claude.Count) ids available" }
938	        else { NOTE 'claude models' "0 of $($served.Count) — Anthropic unavailable; role-aware OpenAI fallback will be used" }
939	
940	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0) {
941	            NOTE 'egress geo' 'Claude appears ONLY via the local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct egress'
942	            if ($claude.Count -eq 0) {
943	                BAD 'MISSING --proxy-env' 'copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog'
944	                HINT 'copilot-proxy restart   # auto attaches --proxy-env when a proxy is detected'
945	                HINT '$env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7897"; copilot-proxy restart'
946	            }
947	        } elseif ($viaClaude -eq 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0 -and $anyUpstream) {
948	            NOTE 'entitlement' 'neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude'
949	            HINT 'org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help'
950	        } elseif ($claude.Count -eq 0 -and $viaClaude -gt 0) {
951	            BAD 'STALE CACHE' 'via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not'
952	            HINT 'copilot-proxy restart'
953	        } elseif ($claude.Count -gt 0) {
954	            OK 'cache' 'the served Claude list looks healthy'
955	        }
956	
957	        $pin = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
958	        $model = $pin[0]; $src = $pin[1]
959	        if ($served -contains $model) { OK 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)" }
960	        else {
961	            BAD 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)"
962	            HINT 'not served -> requests return 400 model_not_supported'
963	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # Claude; else capability-ranked OpenAI, then Gemini'
964	            HINT 'copilot-model -l       # list served ids'
965	        }
966	
967	        # Validate every alias Claude Code may select for background/subagent
968	        # work. A stale Sonnet/Haiku id can fail with 400 while main chat works.
969	        $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
970	        $modelProfile = $null
971	        if (Test-Path $settings) {
972	            try {
973	                $localEnv = (Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env
974	                if ($localEnv.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
975	                    $modelProfile = [ordered]@{
976	                        main   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
977	                        fable  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
978	                        opus   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
979	                        sonnet = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
980	                        haiku  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
981	                    }
982	                }
983	            } catch { $modelProfile = $null }
984	        }
985	        if (-not $modelProfile) {
986	            $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
987	            $modelProfile = Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $model -Catalog $catalog
988	        }
989	        $roleBad = $false
990	        foreach ($role in 'fable', 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku') {
991	            $roleModel = $modelProfile[$role]
992	            if (-not $roleModel) {
993	                BAD "role $role" 'unset — Claude Code may choose its native default and get model_not_supported'
994	                $roleBad = $true
995	            }
996	            elseif ($served -notcontains $roleModel) {
997	                BAD "role $role" "$roleModel is not served"
998	                $roleBad = $true
999	            }
1000	        }
1001	        if (-not $roleBad) {
1002	            OK 'model roles' "fable=$($modelProfile.fable), opus=$($modelProfile.opus), sonnet=$($modelProfile.sonnet), haiku=$($modelProfile.haiku)"
1003	        } else {
1004	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # rewrite main + every Claude Code role alias'
1005	        }
1006	    } else {
1007	        BAD 'served' "could not fetch $(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models"
1008	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0) { HINT 'start with the proxy: copilot-proxy start   # attaches --proxy-env automatically' }
1009	    }
1010	
1011	    Write-Host "`nUpstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
1012	    foreach ($h in 'api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com', 'api.githubcopilot.com') {
1013	        try {
1014	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1015	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://$h/models" -TimeoutSec 12 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1016	            $sw.Stop()
1017	            OK $h "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
1018	        } catch { BAD $h 'no response within 12s'; HINT 'connection blocked or upstream unreachable' }
1019	    }
1020	    SKIP '' 'HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)'
1021	
1022	    Write-Host "`nCodex Apps (ChatGPT MCP)"
1023	    $appsUri = 'https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps'
1024	    SKIP 'route' "$appsUri — independent of localhost Copilot inference and Codex.app"
1025	    if (-not $Live) {
1026	        SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to compare direct and configured-proxy reachability'
1027	    } else {
1028	        $appsDirect = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via 'direct'
1029	        if ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1030	            OK 'direct' "HTTP $($appsDirect.Code) in $($appsDirect.Seconds)s (an auth rejection still proves reachability)"
1031	        } else {
1032	            NOTE 'direct' "$($appsDirect.Kind) failure after $($appsDirect.Seconds)s"
1033	            if ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'tls') { HINT 'inspect antivirus/corporate TLS interception and the Windows trust store' }
1034	            elseif ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'timeout') { HINT 'the ChatGPT Apps route is blocked or not entering the expected TUN path' }
1035	        }
1036	
1037	        if ($httpProxy) {
1038	            $appsVia = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via $httpProxy
1039	            if ($appsVia.Reached) {
1040	                OK 'via proxy' "HTTP $($appsVia.Code) in $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1041	                if (-not $appsDirect.Reached) {
1042	                    HINT "Codex Apps needs this route; launch Codex with HTTPS_PROXY=$httpProxy or repair TUN routing"
1043	                }
1044	            } elseif ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1045	                SKIP 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure — direct already works, so Apps need no explicit proxy"
1046	            } else {
1047	                NOTE 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure after $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1048	                HINT 'this does not invalidate GitHub Copilot inference; it only explains codex_apps startup failures'
1049	            }
1050	        } else {
1051	            SKIP 'via proxy' 'no explicit/system HTTP proxy detected; TUN may still carry direct traffic'
1052	        }
1053	    }
1054	
1055	    Write-Host "`nLive probe"
1056	    if (-not $Live) { SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)' }
1057	    elseif (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { SKIP 'skipped' 'proxy is not running' }
1058	    elseif (-not $served) { SKIP 'skipped' 'no served model to probe with' }
1059	    else {
1060	        $pm = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'embedding' -and $_ -notmatch '\[1m\]' })[0]
1061	        $body = @{ model = $pm; max_tokens = 1; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'hi' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
1062	        try {
1063	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1064	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotClientBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `
1065	                -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1066	            $sw.Stop()
1067	            if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300) { OK 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s" }
1068	            else { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode)"; HINT 'copilot-proxy logs 40' }
1069	        } catch { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> request failed ($_)" }
1070	    }
1071	
1072	    Write-Host ''
1073	    if ($script:fail -gt 0) { Write-Host "$($script:fail) failed, $($script:warn) warning(s)`n"; return }
1074	    Write-Host "all checks passed ($($script:warn) warning(s))`n"
1075	}

1077	# ------------------------------------------------------------- copilot-run ----
1078	function copilot-run {
1079	    [CmdletBinding()]
1080	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1081	    if (-not $Argv -or $Argv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]'; return }
1082	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1083	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) { Start-CopilotShim | Out-Null }
1084	
1085	    # Single source of truth — see Get-CopilotEnvBlock.
1086	    $inject = Get-CopilotEnvBlock
1087	    # Scope env to the child process: set, run, restore (equivalent to `env VAR=..`).
1088	    $saved = @{}
1089	    foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) { $saved[$k] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($k); Set-Item "env:$k" $inject[$k] }
1090	    try {
1091	        $exe = $Argv[0]; $rest = if ($Argv.Count -gt 1) { $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
1092	        & $exe @rest
1093	    } finally {
1094	        foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) {
1095	            if ($null -eq $saved[$k]) { Remove-Item "env:$k" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1096	            else { Set-Item "env:$k" $saved[$k] }
1097	        }
1098	    }
1099	}

1101	# Codex prefers a native Responses-capable OpenAI model. Claude/Gemini are
1102	# Responses Lite fallbacks only, unlike Select-CopilotBestModel (Claude Code),
1103	# where native Claude remains the first choice.
1104	function script:Select-CopilotBestCodexModel {
1105	    param([string[]] $Model)
1106	    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
1107	    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1108	
1109	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex',
1110	                           'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
1111	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1112	    }
1113	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1114	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1115	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1116	    }
1117	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' 'mini|nano|luna'
1118	    if ($r) { return $r }
1119	    $r = & $pick 'codex' $null
1120	    if ($r) { return $r }
1121	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' $null
1122	    if ($r) { return $r }
1123	
1124	    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
1125	                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
1126	                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
1127	                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
1128	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1129	    }
1130	    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
1131	    if ($r) { return $r }
1132	    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' 'flash'
1133	    if ($r) { return $r }
1134	    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' $null
1135	    if ($r) { return $r }
1136	    @($Model | Sort-Object)[-1]
1137	}

1139	function script:Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd {
1140	    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1141	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1142	        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1143	            if ($line -match '^\s*codex_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1144	                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1145	                if ($v) { return $v }
1146	            }
1147	        }
1148	    }
1149	    'codex'
1150	}

1155	        if ($a -in '-m', '--model' -or $a -match '^(?:-m|--model)=') { return $true }
1156	    }
1157	    $false
1158	}

1160	function codex-copilot {
1161	    [CmdletBinding()]
1162	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1163	    $ss = 'auto'
1164	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
1165	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
1166	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1167	        Write-Host 'Usage: codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]'
1168	        Write-Host '  One-off Codex session on the local Copilot Responses gateway.'
1169	        Write-Host '  Auto model: OpenAI/Codex > Claude > Gemini > other served chat models.'
1170	        Write-Host '  Alias: codex-copilot-once'
1171	        return
1172	    }
1173	
1174	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1175	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) {
1176	        if (-not (Start-CopilotShim)) { return }
1177	    }
1178	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1179	    if (-not $catalog) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: could not read the live gateway model catalog'; return }
1180	
1181	    $explicitModel = Test-CopilotExplicitCodexModel -Argv $Argv
1182	    $model = $null
1183	    if (-not $explicitModel) {
1184	        $models = @($catalog.data | Where-Object {
1185	            ($_.policy.state -ne 'disabled') -and ($_.model_picker_enabled -ne $false) -and
1186	            ($_.capabilities.type -ne 'embeddings')
1187	        } | ForEach-Object { $_.id } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1188	        $model = Select-CopilotBestCodexModel -Model $models
1189	        if (-not $model) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: no usable chat model in the live gateway catalog'; return }
1190	        $Argv = @('-m', $model) + @($Argv)
1191	        if ($model -like 'claude-*' -or $model -like 'gemini-*') {
1192	            Write-Warning "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model (Responses Lite; tool_search unavailable)"
1193	        } else { Write-Host "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model" }
1194	    }
1195	
1196	    $base = Get-CopilotClientBase
1197	    $providerArgs = @(
1198	        '-c', 'model_provider="copilot_api"',
1199	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.name="OpenAI"',
1200	        '-c', "model_providers.copilot_api.base_url=`"$base`"",
1201	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.env_key="GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY"',
1202	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.requires_openai_auth=true',
1203	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.supports_websockets=false',
1204	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.wire_api="responses"',
1205	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.request_max_retries=3',
1206	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_max_retries=1',
1207	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_idle_timeout_ms=300000',
1208	        '-c', 'features.remote_compaction_v2=true',
1209	        '-c', 'features.code_mode.excluded_tool_namespaces=["mcp__codex_apps__sites"]'
1210	    )
1211	    if ($model) {
1212	        $entry = $catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $model } | Select-Object -First 1
1213	        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) {
1214	            $Argv = @('-c', "model_context_window=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens)") + @($Argv)
1215	        }
1216	        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens) {
1217	            $Argv = @('-c', "model_auto_compact_token_limit=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens)") + @($Argv)
1218	        }
1219	    }
1220	
1221	    $savedKey = $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY
1222	    $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = 'dummy'
1223	    try {
1224	        if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1225	            $cc = Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd
1226	            foreach ($a in @($providerArgs) + @($Argv)) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
1227	            specstory run codex -c $cc
1228	        } else { codex @providerArgs @Argv }
1229	    } finally {
1230	        if ($null -eq $savedKey) { Remove-Item env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1231	        else { $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = $savedKey }
1232	    }
1233	}

1241	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ---
1242	#
1243	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1244	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1245	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1246	# `-c "claude $args"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1247	# claude-copilot has args to pass through, which made these two disagree:
1248	#
1249	#   claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
1250	#   claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"
1251	#
1252	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1253	# truth for BOTH branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it.
1254	
1255	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1256	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > `claude`
1257	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1258	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1259	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1260	function script:Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd {
1261	    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1262	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1263	        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1264	            if ($line -match '^\s*claude_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1265	                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1266	                if ($v) { return $v }
1267	            }
1268	        }
1269	    }
1270	    'claude'
1271	}
1272	
1273	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
1274	# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes, so quoting is both possible
1275	# and necessary — an unquoted join flattens `-p "two words"` into two arguments.
1276	# POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
1277	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote {
1278	    param([string] $Value)
1279	    "'" + ($Value -replace "'", "'\''") + "'"
1280	}
1281	
1282	# --------------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot -----
1283	function claude-copilot {
1284	    [CmdletBinding()]
1285	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1286	    $ss = 'auto'

1288	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1289	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1290	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1291	        Write-Host "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy. Sticky: copilot-here on"
1292	        Write-Host "  Runs claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions (hands-off proxy flow)."
1293	        return
1294	    }
1295	    if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1296	        if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -gt 0) {
1297	            # Rebuild what `-c` clobbers: the configured base command (ITS flags left
1298	            # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
1299	            $cc = Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd
1300	            foreach ($a in $Argv) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
1301	            copilot-run specstory run claude -c $cc
1302	        }
1303	        else { copilot-run specstory run claude }
1304	    } else {
1305	        # No specstory on PATH (the Windows default — no native CLI yet): run claude
1306	        # directly, still bypassing permission prompts so behaviour matches the
1307	        # specstory path regardless of whether specstory is installed.
1308	        copilot-run claude --dangerously-skip-permissions @Argv
1309	    }
1310	}

1312	# --------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot-once ------
1313	function claude-copilot-once {
1314	    [CmdletBinding()]
1315	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1316	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1317	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1318	        Write-Host "  Pin this project to the proxy, run one session, auto-unpin (even on Ctrl-C)."
1319	        return
1320	    }
1321	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) {
1322	        Write-Error "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(Get-CopilotPort). Start it: copilot-proxy start"; return
1323	    }
1324	    $wasOn = $false
1325	    if (Test-Path '.claude/settings.local.json') {
1326	        try { if ((Get-Content -Raw '.claude/settings.local.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { $wasOn = $true } } catch { $null = $_ }
1327	    }
1328	    if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here on }
1329	    else {
1330	        # Already pinned here. If the pin drifted from current defaults (model bump,
1331	        # proxy moved, a key added since), offer to refresh it in place; otherwise
1332	        # leave it untouched. Either way it was already ON, so it stays ON on exit.
1333	        $drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift
1334	        if ($drift) {
1335	            Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: this project's copilot-here pin looks stale:"
1336	            $drift | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
1337	            if (Confirm-CopilotAction '  override with current defaults? (keep = default) [y/N]') { copilot-here on }
1338	            else { Write-Host 'claude-copilot-once: kept the existing pin (stays ON on exit).' }
1339	        } else {
1340	            Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: copilot-here already ON here — leaving the pin in place on exit."
1341	        }
1342	    }
1343	    try {
1344	        claude-copilot @Argv
1345	    } finally {
1346	        if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here off }
1347	        Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: session ended. Proxy still running on $(Get-CopilotBase)."
1348	    }
1349	}

1354	    'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL',
1355	    'CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC', 'CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER',

1359	# y/N prompt. Returns $true only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive host
1360	# returns $false — the safe default (keep, don't override). Only called right
1361	# before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading input is fine.
1362	function script:Confirm-CopilotAction {
1363	    param([string] $Message = 'Proceed? [y/N]')
1364	    if (-not [Environment]::UserInteractive -or [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { return $false }
1365	    $ans = Read-Host -Prompt $Message
1366	    $ans -match '^\s*y(es)?\s*$'
1367	}
1368	
1369	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1370	# write now (default model bumped, proxy moved, a key added since the pin was
1371	# written)? Returns one "  KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key, or nothing.
1372	#
1373	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1374	# computed by diffing the live file against Get-CopilotEnvBlock — not a hand-picked
1375	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). The asymmetry is
1376	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1377	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1378	function script:Get-CopilotHereDrift {
1379	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1380	    if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { return @() }
1381	    try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return @() }
1382	    # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent -> nothing to do.
1383	    if (-not $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { return @() }
1384	
1385	    $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1386	    $out = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1387	    foreach ($k in $want.Keys) {
1388	        $cur = if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k } else { '(unset)' }
1389	        if ($cur -ne $want[$k]) { $out.Add("  $k : $cur -> $($want[$k])") }
1390	    }
1391	    $out
1392	}
1393

1395	    [CmdletBinding()]

1399	    switch ($action) {
1400	        'on' {
1401	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.claude' | Out-Null
1402	            $obj = if (Test-Path $settings) { try { Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { [pscustomobject]@{} } } else { [pscustomobject]@{} }
1403	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties['env']) { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }

1405	            $envSet = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1406	            $model = $envSet.ANTHROPIC_MODEL

1408	                if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k = $envSet[$k] }
1409	                else { $obj.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $envSet[$k] }

1412	            # Belt-and-braces gitignore via .git/info/exclude (un-anchored **/ form).
1413	            $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null

1419	                }

1422	            if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	A native PowerShell port of the `copilot-proxy` tool series. It runs the
4	[`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jeffreycao/copilot-api)
5	fork so a **GitHub Copilot subscription** can back **Claude Code** and other
6	Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible clients.
7	
8	The module is deployed to `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot` and imported by
9	the PowerShell profile. It requires Bun, Node/npm and a Copilot subscription.
10	
11	## Commands
12	
13	| Command | What it does |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | one-time GitHub device login (stores a token) |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | manage the local proxy (port 4141) |
17	| `copilot-proxy status` | show raw served count and Claude availability |
18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | diagnose package, auth, proxy, catalog, roles, upstream and Codex Apps |
19	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | tail the proxy log |
20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | toggle the throttle shim (port 4142) |
21	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | account / plan / quota |
22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | wipe and reinstall the pinned package |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | run a command with the proxy env injected |
24	| `claude-copilot` | one-off Claude Code session on the proxy |
25	| `claude-copilot-once` | pin this project, run once, then restore it |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | zero-persistence Codex session on the Responses proxy |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | sticky project pin in `.claude/settings.local.json` |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | switch or inspect the complete role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | embed text through `/v1/embeddings` |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | semantic search over local text |
31	
32	## Quick start
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # once
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # select from the live catalog
38	copilot-model -c                   # inspect Main/Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
39	copilot-here on                    # sticky project; or use claude-copilot-once
40	codex-copilot                     # Codex; live OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	Existing global and project pins are deliberately not migrated by `chezmoi
44	apply`. Run `copilot-model --auto` once after this upgrade. When `copilot-here`
45	is active, that command refreshes the local role set; otherwise it updates the
46	global one-line main-model state.
47	
48	## How routing works
49	
50	```text
51	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
52	                                          | Claude: native Messages path
53	                                          | GPT: Anthropic -> Responses translation
54	                                          v
55	                                  GitHub Copilot API
56	```
57	
58	The default package is `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`. For GPT ids it translates
59	Claude Code requests to Responses, including `output_config.effort` to
60	`reasoning.effort`. This is required for GPT-5.6 and Claude Code's `ultracode`
61	effort setting; the old `1.13.14` path could replace the requested effort with a
62	hard-coded fallback.
63	
64	The package is installed once under `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`. Windows
65	uses `npm.cmd` first because it understands the Azure Artifacts credential
66	provider in `~/.npmrc`; Bun remains the fallback/runtime. A package-version stamp
67	makes the 2.1.0 bump reinstall automatically. Warm starts do no package network
68	work.
69	
70	## Model selection and role profile
71	
72	`copilot-model --auto` requires the live `/v1/models` catalog. It prefers served
73	Claude families (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`), then ranks OpenAI by capability:
74	
75	```text
76	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
77	```
78	
79	Luna follows the older flagships because it is the lightweight tier. This role
80	intent follows OpenAI's [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model).
81	For the normal Claude-less Copilot catalog, the generated profile is:
82	
83	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
84	|---|---|
85	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
86	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
87	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
88	
89	A manually selected OpenAI main remains Main/Fable/Opus; Terra and Luna are used
90	for the lower roles when served. Missing tiers fall back to the selected main,
91	never to an unserved hard-coded id. Native Claude profiles select the strongest
92	served model in each Claude family.
93	
94	The `[1m]` suffix is a Claude Code-only context hint. It is derived from each
95	model's live `max_context_window_tokens` metadata when the value is at least one
96	million. Raw API clients must use the plain id. Offline manual discovery remains
97	available, but offline `--auto` refuses to write a potentially stale pin.
98	
99	Both `copilot-run` and `copilot-here on` inject the same variables:
100	
101	```text
102	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
103	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
104	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
105	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
106	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
107	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
108	```
109	
110	`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is intentionally left unset so workflow/frontmatter
111	routing remains authoritative. Restart Claude Code after changing the profile.
112	
113	## Claude Code feature compatibility
114	
115	The useful boundary is local orchestration versus Anthropic cloud services:
116	
117	| Feature | Through Copilot + GPT | Notes |
118	|---|---|---|
119	| CLI, tools, hooks, skills, memory, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing | Yes | Local Claude Code features; GPT behavior may differ after prompt/tool translation. |
120	| Subagents and dynamic workflows | Yes | Role variables are provided without overriding workflow-specific subagent routing. See [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows). |
121	| `ultracode` | Yes on 2.1.0 | It is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflows, not a separate model. |
122	| Thinking/reasoning | Translated | GPT uses Responses reasoning rather than Anthropic-native thinking semantics. |
123	| Web search, fast/auto mode, MCP tool search | Provider-dependent | Availability depends on the Copilot endpoint and gateway translation. |
124	| Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome, cloud Code Review, routines, web/mobile/Slack sessions | No | These require Claude.ai authentication/cloud identity; a local API gateway cannot provide it. |
125	
126	See Claude Code's [feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability),
127	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
128	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol), and
129	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview) references.
130	
131	## Network, entitlement and diagnostics
132	
133	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` reads the Windows System Proxy or an explicit proxy
134	  environment variable, scopes it to the child and passes `--proxy-env`. Node
135	  otherwise ignores the WinINET system setting.
136	- The model catalog is fetched once at proxy startup. `COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT`
137	  defaults to 45 seconds because a Clash/mihomo hop can make that refresh exceed
138	  the old 20-second budget.
139	- GitHub can vary the catalog by account, organization policy, rollout and egress.
140	  No Claude models is therefore a warning when a served OpenAI fallback exists;
141	  it is not by itself a broken proxy.
142	- `copilot-proxy doctor` compares direct and proxied upstream catalogs, validates
143	  the main model plus every role alias, and reports stale local pins. `--live`
144	  also compares direct/proxied reachability of remote ChatGPT `codex_apps`, then
145	  sends one real inference request. Only the latter consumes quota; timeout and
146	  TLS failures are reported separately.
147	- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`, never
148	  committed project settings. `off` removes every env key owned by the helper and
149	  preserves unrelated settings.
150	- `claude-copilot` and `claude-copilot-once` retain the Windows port's trusted
151	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and optional SpecStory behavior. Plain `claude`
152	  is unaffected.
153	- The throttle shim remains byte-identical to the macOS/Linux copy and retries
154	  403/429 bursts while limiting concurrent requests.
155	
156	State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; the GitHub token is stored at
157	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`.
158	
159	## Codex through the gateway
160	
161	`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
162	gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
163	Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
164	`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
165	catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
166	Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
167	embedding models are excluded.
168	
169	This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
170	remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
171	
172	SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
173	`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
174	provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
175	Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
176	`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
177	The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
178	`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
179	later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
180	
181	`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
182	Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
183	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
184	Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
185	`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
186	
187	There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
188	`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
189	auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
190	changing the user-wide default.
191	
192	### Experimental direct configuration
193	
194	The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
195	macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
196	the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
197	returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
198	the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
199	therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.
200
```

11	## 指令
12	
13	| 指令 | 作用 |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | 一次性的 GitHub device 登入（儲存 token） |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | 管理本機 proxy（port 4141） |

18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | 診斷套件、認證、proxy、catalog、roles、上游與 Codex Apps |

20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | 切換節流 shim（port 4142） |

22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | 清掉並重裝釘選套件 |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | 注入 proxy 環境變數後執行指令 |

25	| `claude-copilot-once` | 暫時釘住專案、執行一次、結束後還原 |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | 零持久化的 Codex Responses proxy session |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | 在 `.claude/settings.local.json` 做 sticky pin |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | 切換或檢查完整 role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | 透過 `/v1/embeddings` 產生向量 |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | 對本機文字做語意搜尋 |
31	
32	## 快速開始
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # 只需一次
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # 從 live catalog 選模型

40	codex-copilot                     # Codex；即時 OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	`chezmoi apply` 不會偷偷遷移既有 global/project pin。升級後請手動執行一次
44	`copilot-model --auto`。若 `copilot-here` 已開，它會刷新 local role set；否則只更新
45	global 的單行 main-model state。
46	
47	## Routing 原理
48	
49	```text
50	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
51	                                          | Claude：native Messages
52	                                          | GPT：Anthropic -> Responses 轉譯
53	                                          v
54	                                  GitHub Copilot API
55	```
56	
57	預設套件是 `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`。GPT id 會走 Responses translation，
58	包括把 Claude Code 的 `output_config.effort` 轉成 `reasoning.effort`。GPT-5.6 與
59	Claude Code `ultracode` 需要這條路徑；舊 `1.13.14` 可能用 hard-coded fallback 蓋掉
60	client 指定的 effort。
61	
62	套件只安裝一次到 `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`。Windows 優先用 `npm.cmd`，因為它
63	能使用 `~/.npmrc` 裡的 Azure Artifacts credential provider；Bun 仍作為 fallback/runtime。
64	版本戳記會讓 2.1.0 升級自動重裝，warm start 不需要套件網路。
65	
66	## 模型選擇與 role profile
67	
68	`copilot-model --auto` 必須讀到 live `/v1/models`。先選 served Claude 家族
69	（`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`），沒有 Claude 時依能力排序：
70	
71	```text
72	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
73	```
74	
75	Luna 雖是 5.6 世代，但屬於輕量 tier，所以排在舊旗艦後面。這個角色意圖依照 OpenAI 的
76	[current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model)。
77	一般沒有 Claude 的 Copilot catalog 會產生：
78	
79	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
80	|---|---|
81	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
82	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
83	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
84	
85	若手動選另一個 OpenAI main，Main/Fable/Opus 會保留該主模型；有 served Terra/Luna 時
86	分別供較低 role 使用。缺少 tier 時退回主模型，不會寫入不存在的硬編碼 id。原生 Claude
87	profile 則在每個 Claude 家族中選最強 served model。
88	
89	`[1m]` 是只給 Claude Code 的 context 提示；helper 依 live
90	`max_context_window_tokens >= 1,000,000` 決定。Raw API client 必須用 plain id。離線時仍
91	提供手動 discovery 清單，但 `--auto` 會拒絕寫入可能過期的 pin。
92	
93	`copilot-run` 與 `copilot-here on` 會注入同一組變數：
94	
95	```text
96	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
97	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
98	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
99	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
100	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
101	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
102	```
103	
104	刻意不設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`，讓 workflow/frontmatter routing 保持最高優先。
105	切換 profile 後需重開 Claude Code。
106	
107	## Claude Code 功能相容性
108	
109	關鍵分界是本機編排與 Anthropic cloud service：
110	
111	| 功能 | 透過 Copilot + GPT | 說明 |
112	|---|---|---|
113	| CLI、tools、hooks、skills、memory、plugins、MCP、checkpoints、sandboxing | 可以 | 都是本機功能；GPT 收到轉譯後的 prompt/tool schema，行為可能不同。 |
114	| subagents、dynamic workflows | 可以 | 提供 role variables，但不蓋掉 workflow-specific subagent routing。見 [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows)。 |
115	| `ultracode` | 2.1.0 可以 | 它是 xhigh effort + dynamic workflows，不是獨立模型。 |
116	| thinking/reasoning | 轉譯後可用 | GPT 使用 Responses reasoning，不是 Anthropic-native thinking semantics。 |
117	| Web Search、fast/auto mode、MCP tool search | 依 provider | 取決於 Copilot endpoint 與 gateway translation。 |
118	| Ultrareview、Remote Control、Chrome、cloud Code Review、routines、web/mobile/Slack session | 不可以 | 需要 Claude.ai auth/cloud identity，local gateway 無法提供。 |
119	
120	官方參考：[feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability)、
121	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config)、
122	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol)、
123	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview)。
124	
125	## 網路、entitlement 與診斷
126	
127	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` 會讀 Windows System Proxy 或明確的 proxy env，僅注入 child
128	  process 並帶 `--proxy-env`。Node 自己不會讀 WinINET system setting。
129	- Model catalog 只在 proxy 啟動時抓一次。`COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT` 預設 45 秒，因為
130	  Clash/mihomo hop 可能讓 refresh 超過舊版的 20 秒。
131	- GitHub 會依帳號、組織政策、rollout 與 egress 改變 catalog。因此在仍有 served OpenAI
132	  fallback 時，「沒有 Claude」是 warning，不代表 proxy 本身壞掉。
133	- `copilot-proxy doctor` 會比較 direct/proxied upstream catalog、驗證 main 與所有 role
134	  aliases，並找出 stale local pin。`--live` 也會比較遠端 ChatGPT `codex_apps`
135	  的 direct/proxied reachability，再送一個真實 inference request；只有後者消耗
136	  quota，timeout 與 TLS failure 會分開報告。
137	- `copilot-here` 只寫入 gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`，不碰 committed project
138	  settings；`off` 只移除 helper 擁有的 env keys，保留其他設定。
139	- `claude-copilot` / `claude-copilot-once` 保留 Windows port 的 trusted
140	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 與 optional SpecStory 行為，純 `claude` 不受影響。
141	- Throttle shim 仍與 macOS/Linux 版本 byte-identical，會限制並行並重試 403/429 burst。
142	
143	狀態放在 `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`；GitHub token 放在
144	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`。
145	
146	## Codex 走 gateway
147	
148	`codex-copilot` 與完全相同的 `codex-copilot-once` alias 會啟動本機
149	gateway/shim，並用本次啟動的 Codex `-c` overrides 傳入 `copilot_api`
150	Responses provider。它們不改 user/project Codex config，所以 plain `codex` 不受影響。
151	明確 `-m` / `--model` 永遠優先；否則從即時 raw catalog 依序選
152	OpenAI/Codex（`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini`），
153	再退到 Claude、Gemini 與其他 chat model；disabled/embedding model 會排除。
154	
155	這是與 Claude Code `copilot-model --auto` 分開的 picker：後者保持
156	Claude-first，只有 Codex launcher 是 OpenAI-first。
157	
158	有安裝 SpecStory 時自動整合。Wrapper 會保留生效的 `codex_cmd`（project config >
159	user config > 裸 `codex`），再附加 provider/model/user arguments；
160	`--no-specstory` 直接執行 Codex。Claude/Gemini fallback 經 Responses Lite，不支援
161	Responses `tool_search`，因此 native Responses OpenAI models 排在 Anthropic 前。
162	Launcher 也會啟用 gateway-backed remote compaction，並排除依賴不可用
163	`tool_search` 的 `mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace；後續明確傳入的 `-c`
164	仍可在單次呼叫覆寫這兩項。
165	
166	`codex_apps` 本身不是 localhost service，也不是 Apple-Silicon-only Codex Desktop
167	bridge；它是 `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps` 的遠端 MCP。因此即使
168	`localhost:4142` inference 正常，它仍可能啟動失敗。保留 Apps 啟用，並以
169	`copilot-proxy doctor --live` 獨立診斷這條路由。
170	
171	刻意不做 Codex 版 `copilot-here`：project `.codex/config.toml` 不能覆寫 provider
172	definition、provider selection 或 auth metadata。顯式 launcher 能提供 project/session
173	scope，同時不改 user-wide default。
174	
175	### 實驗性 direct 設定
176	
177	Direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` 範例只記錄在 macOS/Linux 完整指南，
178	不會安裝。它不是 localhost proxy 路徑，而且貼文中的 `gh auth token` flow 不具可攜性：
179	本次 EMU 帳號實測回 `421`/`403`；`copilot-proxy auth` 保存的 credential 加正常短效
180	Copilot token exchange 則可用。因此正式 launcher 使用已認證的本機 gateway。
181

1	#!/usr/bin/env bun
2	// copilot-throttle-shim.js — a tiny streaming reverse proxy that sits IN FRONT
3	// of the local copilot-api fork (default :4141). It exists to stop GitHub's
4	// enterprise Copilot backend from 403-ing ("Forbidden") on bursts of premium
5	// requests, WITHOUT adding latency to normal single-agent flow.
6	//
7	//   Claude Code ─▶ shim (:4142) ─▶ copilot-api fork (:4141) ─▶ Copilot backend
8	//                    │
9	//                    ├─ semaphore: at most MAX concurrent in-flight upstream
10	//                    │   POSTs; a burst queues instead of hitting the backend
11	//                    │   all at once (that simultaneity is what trips abuse
12	//                    │   detection). Under the cap there is ZERO added latency.
13	//                    │
14	//                    └─ transparent retry on 403/429/502/503/504 + network
15	//                        errors, jittered backoff, BEFORE any response body is
16	//                        streamed — so the agent never sees the transient 403
17	//                        ("Please run /login"). GET/HEAD (health, /v1/models)
18	//                        bypass both, so liveness checks stay instant.
19	//
20	// Managed by copilot-proxy (see 43_copilot_proxy.sh: `copilot-proxy shim on`).
21	// Config via env (all optional):
22	//   COPILOT_SHIM_PORT       listen port                    (default 4142)
23	//   COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM   upstream base URL              (default http://localhost:4141)
24	//   COPILOT_SHIM_MAX        max concurrent in-flight POSTs (default 4)
25	//   COPILOT_SHIM_RETRIES    retry attempts on transient    (default 3)
26	//   COPILOT_SHIM_BACKOFF_MS base backoff ms, doubles/try   (default 500)
27	
28	const PORT = Number(process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_PORT ?? 4142);
29	const UPSTREAM = (process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM ?? "http://localhost:4141").replace(/\/+$/, "");
30	const MAX = Math.max(1, Number(process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_MAX ?? 4));
31	const RETRIES = Math.max(0, Number(process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_RETRIES ?? 3));
32	const BACKOFF_MS = Math.max(0, Number(process.env.COPILOT_SHIM_BACKOFF_MS ?? 500));
33	const RETRY_STATUS = new Set([403, 429, 502, 503, 504]);
34	
35	const log = (...a) => console.log(new Date().toISOString(), "[shim]", ...a);
36	const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
37	
38	// ---- semaphore (at most MAX permits; hands a permit straight to a waiter) ----
39	let active = 0;
40	const waiters = [];
41	function acquire() {
42	  if (active < MAX) { active++; return Promise.resolve(); }
43	  return new Promise((res) => waiters.push(res));
44	}
45	function release() {
46	  active--;
47	  const next = waiters.shift();
48	  if (next) { active++; next(); }
49	}
50	
51	function backoffMs(attempt, retryAfter) {
52	  const ra = Number(retryAfter);
53	  if (Number.isFinite(ra) && ra > 0) return Math.min(ra * 1000, 30000);
54	  return BACKOFF_MS * 2 ** attempt + Math.floor(Math.random() * BACKOFF_MS); // + jitter
55	}
56	
57	function buildUpstream(req, bodyBuf) {
58	  const url = new URL(req.url);
59	  const target = UPSTREAM + url.pathname + url.search;
60	  const headers = new Headers(req.headers);
61	  headers.delete("host");
62	  headers.delete("content-length"); // fetch recomputes from body
63	  const init = { method: req.method, headers, signal: req.signal };
64	  if (bodyBuf !== undefined) init.body = bodyBuf;
65	  return { target, init };
66	}
67	
68	// Stream an upstream response to the client, holding the semaphore permit until
69	// the stream ends / errors / is cancelled (true in-flight accounting).
70	function streamThrough(resp, releaseOnce) {
71	  const headers = new Headers(resp.headers);
72	  headers.delete("content-encoding");  // Bun already decoded the upstream body
73	  headers.delete("content-length");
74	  headers.delete("transfer-encoding");
75	  if (!resp.body) { releaseOnce(); return new Response(null, { status: resp.status, headers }); }
76	
77	  const reader = resp.body.getReader();
78	  const stream = new ReadableStream({
79	    async pull(controller) {
80	      try {
81	        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
82	        if (done) { controller.close(); releaseOnce(); return; }
83	        controller.enqueue(value);
84	      } catch (err) { releaseOnce(); controller.error(err); }
85	    },
86	    cancel(reason) { releaseOnce(); try { reader.cancel(reason); } catch {} },
87	  });
88	  return new Response(stream, { status: resp.status, headers });
89	}
90	
91	const server = Bun.serve({
92	  port: PORT,
93	  idleTimeout: 255, // seconds — long opus streams (saw up to ~77s)
94	  async fetch(req) {
95	    const url = new URL(req.url);
96	    const method = req.method;
97	
98	    // Health / metadata reads: straight passthrough, no permit, no retry.
99	    if (method === "GET" || method === "HEAD") {
100	      try {
101	        const { target, init } = buildUpstream(req, undefined);
102	        return streamThrough(await fetch(target, init), () => {});
103	      } catch (err) {
104	        return new Response(`shim: upstream unreachable: ${err}`, { status: 502 });
105	      }
106	    }
107	
108	    // Mutating requests (POST /v1/messages …): buffer body so we can resend on
109	    // retry, then throttle + retry.
110	    const bodyBuf = await req.arrayBuffer();
111	    const { target, init } = buildUpstream(req, bodyBuf);
112	
113	    const willQueue = active >= MAX;
114	    await acquire();
115	    if (willQueue) log(`queued ${method} ${url.pathname} (${active} in-flight, ${waiters.length} waiting)`);
116	    let released = false;
117	    const releaseOnce = () => { if (!released) { released = true; release(); } };
118	
119	    try {
120	      for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= RETRIES; attempt++) {
121	        let resp;
122	        try {
123	          resp = await fetch(target, init);
124	        } catch (err) {
125	          if (req.signal?.aborted) { releaseOnce(); return new Response("client aborted", { status: 499 }); }
126	          if (attempt < RETRIES) {
127	            const d = backoffMs(attempt);
128	            log(`${method} ${url.pathname} network error (${err}); retry ${attempt + 1}/${RETRIES} in ${d}ms`);
129	            await sleep(d);
130	            continue;
131	          }
132	          releaseOnce();
133	          return new Response(`shim: upstream unreachable: ${err}`, { status: 502 });
134	        }
135	
136	        // Retryable status and attempts left → back off and try again. The 403
137	        // arrives fast (<2s, before any body), so retrying here is safe.
138	        if (RETRY_STATUS.has(resp.status) && attempt < RETRIES) {
139	          const d = backoffMs(attempt, resp.headers.get("retry-after"));
140	          log(`${method} ${url.pathname} -> ${resp.status}; retry ${attempt + 1}/${RETRIES} in ${d}ms`);
141	          try { await resp.body?.cancel(); } catch {}
142	          await sleep(d);
143	          continue;
144	        }
145	
146	        // Commit: stream this response (2xx, or the real error after retries).
147	        if (attempt > 0) log(`${method} ${url.pathname} -> ${resp.status} after ${attempt} retr${attempt === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}`);
148	        return streamThrough(resp, releaseOnce);
149	      }
150	      releaseOnce(); // unreachable (last attempt always commits) — safety net
151	      return new Response("shim: retries exhausted", { status: 502 });
152	    } catch (err) {
153	      releaseOnce();
154	      return new Response(`shim: ${err}`, { status: 500 });
155	    }
156	  },
157	});
158	
159	log(`listening on :${server.port} -> ${UPSTREAM} (max=${MAX}, retries=${RETRIES}, backoff=${BACKOFF_MS}ms)`);
