 `./pitfalls/copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module.md`

```text
1	# `copilot-proxy` install dies with `error: ConnectionRefused downloading package manifest`
2	
3	**Symptoms** (grep this section): `copilot-proxy start` / `copilot-proxy reinstall`
4	prints
5	
6	```
7	Resolving dependencies
8	Resolved, downloaded and extracted [6]
9	error: ConnectionRefused downloading package manifest @jeffreycao/copilot-api
10	WARNING: copilot-proxy: install stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ...
11	Resolving dependencies
12	Resolved, downloaded and extracted [6]
13	error: ConnectionRefused downloading package manifest @jeffreycao/copilot-api
14	Write-Error: copilot-proxy: could not install @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'.
15	```
16	
17	Both attempts fail identically (with and without the proxy env), so it looks
18	like a hard network block. `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg` stays empty and
19	`.installed-spec` is never written. Meanwhile plain `npm` works fine —
20	`npm view @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 version` returns the version, and
21	other global npm CLIs install without complaint. That mismatch is the tell.
22	**First seen**: 2026-07-29
23	**Affects**: corp/managed Windows boxes where the npm registry is an internal
24	mirror (here `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io`) and `registry.npmjs.org` is
25	blocked, **and** the deployed Copilot module predates the npm-install branch.
26	**Status**: fixed — `chezmoi apply`.
27	
28	## Root cause
29	
30	Two things compound:
31	
32	1. **Bun does not use the corp npm registry.** `Resolving dependencies` /
33	   `Resolved, downloaded and extracted [N]` / `error: ConnectionRefused` is
34	   **Bun's** output format, not npm's. Bun reaches for `registry.npmjs.org`,
35	   which the corp network blocks, hence `ConnectionRefused`. npm, by contrast,
36	   honours the `registry=` line in `~/.npmrc` (and the machine-level npmrc), so
37	   the same package resolves instantly.
38	2. **The deployed module was stale.** `Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry` prefers npm
39	   when `npm.cmd` is on PATH and only falls back to Bun otherwise — but that
40	   npm branch was added in commit `5351411`. The copy at
41	   `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1` still had the
42	   **Bun-only** version, because `chezmoi apply` had not been run since. The
43	   source tree was correct; the deployed file was not.
44	
45	So the error says "network", the real answer is "your deployed module is behind
46	your source tree". `chezmoi status` had been flagging it the whole time:
47	
48	```
49	 M .config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
50	```
51	
52	## Workaround
53	
54	```powershell
55	chezmoi status                 # look for a modified Copilot.psm1
56	chezmoi apply ~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
57	copilot-proxy reinstall        # now uses npm
58	# copilot-proxy: installed @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 -> ...\copilot-api\pkg
59	```
60	
61	Successful run takes ~22s and reports `added 149 packages`.
62	
63	A full `chezmoi apply` also works but runs the `run_onchange` package installers
64	(scoop/winget/npm), which can take many minutes; target the single file when
65	you only need the module refreshed.
66	
67	## Prevention
68	
69	- **Check `chezmoi status` before debugging any behaviour of a chezmoi-managed
70	  script.** A stale deployed copy reproduces bugs that no longer exist in the
71	  source, and nothing warns you.
72	- Do **not** conclude "the registry is broken" from a Bun error. Confirm with
73	  npm first — `npm view <pkg> version` uses the configured registry, Bun does
74	  not. See
75	  [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
76	  for how to probe the registry correctly.
77	- This is why `Copilot.psm1` carries the warning
78	  `npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm)`
79	  — if you see that line, the Bun path is about to be taken and will fail on a
80	  corp network.
81	
82	## Related
83	
84	- [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
85	  — the companion trap: probing the internal registry the wrong way and
86	  concluding it is broken.
87	- `docs/copilot-proxy.md` — module overview; note it lists **bun** as the only
88	  prerequisite, which is true for *running* the proxy but not for *installing*
89	  the package on a corp feed.
90
```

1	# copilot-proxy global apply mode for Claude Code and Codex
2	
3	**Status**: deferred (2026-08-12)
4	**Effort**: L
5	**Related**: `TODO.md` · `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1`
6	
7	## Context
8	
9	A user-wide mode would make ordinary `claude` and `codex` convenient, but also
10	couple both to a local daemon and mutate runtime-owned settings. Today the
11	one-shot launchers are intentionally zero-persistence.
12	
13	## Investigation
14	
15	Proposed command: `copilot-global on|off|status claude|codex|all`. `on` must
16	require a healthy login-start supervisor, snapshot exact files/keys with hashes,
17	write validated temp files atomically, and mark ownership. Claude receives the
18	full role profile; Codex preserves all unrelated TOML. `off` restores exactly
19	but stops on manual drift. Operations must be idempotent and crash-safe.
20	
21	Test fresh/existing config, repeated cycles, interruption between stages,
22	malformed input, manual drift, state migration, and supervised-proxy failure.
23	Keep the Windows implementation native PowerShell.
24	
25	## Options considered
26	
27	| Option | Pros | Cons |
28	|---|---|---|
29	| Keep one-shot/project launchers | Safe and shipped | Repeated opt-in |
30	| Chezmoi-managed permanent provider | Declarative | Fights runtime state; dead-daemon risk |
31	| Stateful global switch | Good UX with exact restore | Requires supervisor, transactions and ownership semantics |
32	
33	## Current blocker / open questions
34	
35	Windows has no login-start, auto-restarting proxy supervisor yet. A global
36	config without that prerequisite can strand both CLIs after reboot.
37	
38	## Decision (if any)
39	
40	2026-08-12 deferred. Keep one-shot launchers as the supported path; implement
41	only after supervisor/service work lands on both platforms.
42	
43	## References
44	
45	- `docs/copilot-proxy.md`
46	- Parent repo: `backlog/copilot-proxy-global-apply-mode.md`
47
```
</details></tool-use>

1463	function script:Select-CopilotBestModel {

1467	
1468	    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
1469	                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
1470	                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
1471	                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
1472	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1473	    }
1474	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1475	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1476	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1477	    }
1478	    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
1479	    if ($r) { return $r }
1480	
1481	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex') {

1496	        if ($r) { return $r }

1559	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog

1561	    $resolved = ''

1632	function copilot-embed {
1633	    [CmdletBinding()]

1640	            '^(-m|--model)$' { $model = $Argv[++$i] }
1641	            '^--model=' { $model = $Argv[$i] -replace '^--model=', '' }
1642	            '^--json$' { $wantJson = $true }
1643	            '^(-l|--list)$' { $doList = $true }
1644	            '^(-h|--help)$' { Write-Host "Usage: copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT | -]`n       copilot-embed -l"; return }
1645	            default { $rest.Add($Argv[$i]) }
1646	        }
1647	    }
1648	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1649	
1650	    if ($doList) {

1654	
1655	    $text = if ($rest.Count -gt 0 -and $rest[0] -ne '-') { $rest -join ' ' } elseif (-not [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: no text — pass an arg or pipe stdin"; return } else { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }
1656	    if (-not $text) { Write-Error "copilot-embed: empty input"; return }
1657

1659	    $payload = if ($model) { @{ model = $model; input = @($text) } } else { @{ input = @($text) } }

1661	        $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/embeddings" -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' `
1662	            -Body ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -TimeoutSec 60 -ErrorAction Stop
1663	    } catch { Write-Error "copilot-embed: request failed — is the proxy up? ($_)"; return }

Author:     Da-Wei Lee <daviddwlee84@gmail.com>

    feat(copilot): sync the pwsh port up to the parent repo's 2026-07-26 state
    
    The PowerShell Copilot module was ported from the parent repo's
    43_copilot_proxy.sh on 2026-07-09 and never caught up. Eight upstream
    commits landed after that cut, none of them Windows-specific, so the
    module still defaulted to claude-opus-4-8[1m], re-resolved the package
    on every launch, and shipped three bugs already fixed on the unix side.
    Port all eight (copilot-raycast is macOS-only and deliberately skipped):
    
    - default model -> claude-opus-5[1m], and the offline fallback list gains
      opus-5 / opus-4-6 / sonnet-4-6 to match upstream (cbf5b6d).
    - install the pinned copilot-api ONCE into $XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg
      and run it from there; `bunx <pkg> start` re-resolved on every launch and
      bun stalls forever resolving through a socks proxy, wedging `start` at
      "Resolving dependencies" while holding bun's global cache lock so every
      retry hung too. Bounded install attempts (45s ambient env, then 90s with
      the proxy stripped) that kill what they spawn, a .installed-spec stamp so
      a version bump re-installs, `copilot-proxy reinstall`, and start now reaps
      the server it spawned on timeout instead of leaving an orphan (c6e0a8b).
    - doctor: Package section + wedged-installer detection (74464fb), and the
      direct-vs-via-proxy catalog A/B that separates a geo-filtered egress from
      an entitlement problem (1a2be50) — this needed Get-CopilotUpstreamModel,
      which the original port had left behind.
    - COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY (auto|always|never|URL): Node ignores the Windows
      System Proxy, so resolve it from the WinINET registry (what Clash Verge /
      mihomo / v2rayN write) and pass --proxy-env explicitly, or copilot-api
      caches a Claude-less /models list for its whole lifetime (1a2be50).
    - Get-CopilotEnvBlock is now the single source of truth for copilot-run,
      `copilot-here on` and the drift check; the old drift check compared 4 of
      the 8 keys `on` writes, so a partial pin reported "no drift" (0b91e3b).
      claude-copilot-once and `copilot-here status` surface drift and offer to
      refresh in place (62e254f).
    - specstory's -c REPLACES claude_cmd rather than appending, so rebuild it
      from the effective config (project > user > bare `claude`, uncommented
      assignments only) and single-quote each passthrough arg (47014a7).
    - copilot-model --auto: Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini from the live catalog,
      hinted by doctor when the pin is not served (bb5f2a8).
    
    Two Windows-specific corrections the shell original has no analogue for:
    
    - the launch path never puts the install prefix in an argument array.
      Start-Process joins -ArgumentList with spaces and does no quoting, so
      `bun run --cwd <prefix>` would split under a $HOME containing a space
      ("C:\Users\Da-Wei Lee\..."). -WorkingDirectory takes it as a parameter.
    - install success is judged from the filesystem, not $p.ExitCode: a
      Start-Process -PassThru object reports ExitCode 0 for a child that exited
      non-zero (the .Handle-caching workaround does not help), which would have
      let a failed install write the stamp and pin a broken prefix.
    
    Verified: parse + PSScriptAnalyzer clean; Pester 27/27 (was 7 — new cases
    cover the scoped-spec package-name trap, the --auto picker, drift incl. the
    4-of-8 regression, claude_cmd resolution and -c quoting); `bun run --cwd`
    confirmed functional; a real `bun add` end-to-end into a temp XDG_DATA_HOME
    installs in 23.5s / warm re-runs in 36ms with no network, and the resulting
    launch actually executes copilot-api; copilot-here on/status round trip
    writes opus-5 and reports no drift; mkdocs build --strict clean.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

    --dangerously-skip-permissions on every path — the specstory args path (which
    `-c` had been overriding away from claude_cmd) and the no-specstory Windows
    fallback — so the hands-off proxy flow bypasses permission prompts whether or
    not the SpecStory CLI is on PATH. Global permissions.defaultMode stays `auto`;
    bypass is scoped to the proxy wrappers, not all of claude.
    
    New `installSpecstoryBuild` init toggle builds the experimental SpecStory
    Windows CLI from the still-unmerged getspecstory PR #191 at apply time, inline
    in the packages run_onchange (fault-tolerant: needs git + go, Register-Failure
    never aborts the apply). Per invariant 1 the windows.yml init flags are updated
    in the same commit; CI sets the toggle true so the render+parse step covers the
    new block (chezmoi apply --exclude scripts means it never actually builds in CI).

    refactor: native/scoop runtimes instead of mise on Windows
    
    mise's activate/shims are unreliable on Windows (global tools don't land on
    PATH) and it has no windows-arm64 bun build, so runtimes were flaky. Go native:
    
    - node via scoop `nodejs-lts`, bun via scoop (already), Python via uv
      (`uv python install --default`); drop the `mise use -g` provisioning.
    - Extra runtimes (go/rust/ruby) via scoop: go, rustup, ruby.
    - Remove mise from the install and its shims from the profile PATH; strip the
      mise activate/shims commentary (10_tools) and mise error hints in the Copilot
      module (now `scoop install bun`/`uv`).
    - Rename the init prompt "extra mise runtimes" -> "extra runtimes" (+ matching
      CI flag, per invariant #1).
    
    Rationale + tradeoffs documented in a follow-up docs commit.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

3	# every unrelated live setting (providers, projects, plugins, feature flags).

5	# unchanged: config recovery must be explicit, never an accidental overwrite.
6	
7	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
8	
9	function Write-StdoutBytes {
10	    param([byte[]] $Bytes)
11	    $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
12	    $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
13	    $out.Flush()
14	}

16	$utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
17	$overlayText = @'

22	# Empty input is a fresh install and the overlay itself is already valid TOML.

24	    Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($overlayText)
25	    return
26	}
27

29	$stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()
30	$overlayFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-overlay-$stamp.toml"
31	$liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-live-$stamp.toml"
32	$pyFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-merge-$stamp.py"
33	$outFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-out-$stamp.toml"
34	
35	try {
36	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($overlayFile, $overlayText, $utf8)
37	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($liveFile, $liveText, $utf8)
38	
39	    $py = $null
40	    if (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
41	        $py = @('uv', 'run', '--no-project', '--quiet', '--with', 'tomlkit', '--python', '>=3.11', 'python')
42	    } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
43	        $py = @('python')
44	    } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
45	        $py = @('python3')
46	    }
47	
48	    if (-not $py) {
49	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('modify_config.toml: no uv/python found; preserving live config unchanged')
50	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($liveText)
51	        return
52	    }
53	
54	    $pySource = @'
55	import os
56	import sys
57	
58	import tomlkit
59	
60	overlay_path = os.environ["CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE"]
61	live_path = os.environ["CODEX_LIVE_FILE"]
62	out_path = os.environ["CODEX_OUT_FILE"]
63	
64	with open(overlay_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
65	    overlay_text = fh.read()
66	with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
67	    live_text = fh.read()
68	
69	try:
70	    live = tomlkit.parse(live_text)
71	    overlay = tomlkit.parse(overlay_text)
72	except Exception as exc:
73	    print(f"modify_config.toml: invalid TOML; preserving live config unchanged: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
74	    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
75	        fh.write(live_text)
76	    sys.exit(0)
77	
78	if "tui" not in live or not isinstance(live["tui"], dict):
79	    live["tui"] = tomlkit.table()
80	live["tui"]["status_line"] = overlay["tui"]["status_line"]
81	
82	with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
83	    fh.write(tomlkit.dumps(live))
84	'@

86

88	    $env:CODEX_LIVE_FILE = $liveFile
89	    $env:CODEX_OUT_FILE = $outFile
90	    $exe = $py[0]
91	    $rest = if ($py.Count -gt 1) { @($py[1..($py.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
92	    $rest += $pyFile
93	    & $exe @rest
94	    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
95	
96	    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile)) {
97	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: merge failed (exit $rc); preserving live config unchanged")
98	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($liveText)
99	        return

106	    }

```text
1	# Copilot.psm1 — GitHub Copilot agent gateway for Claude Code and Codex, native
2	# PowerShell port of the POSIX 43_copilot_proxy.sh / 44_copilot_embed.sh.
3	#
4	# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (npm @jeffreycao/copilot-api) via `bunx`
5	# so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code and Codex. The optional Bun
6	# throttle shim (copilot-throttle-shim.js) is reused verbatim from the unix side.
7	#
8	# Public commands (exported with their original hyphenated names for muscle
9	# memory — PSUseApprovedVerbs is intentionally waived):
10	#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]
11	#   copilot-run <cmd...>            run a command with the proxy env injected
12	#   claude-copilot [args...]        one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
13	#   claude-copilot-once [args...]   pinned one-shot session, auto-reverted
14	#   codex-copilot [args...]         one-off Codex session on Responses proxy
15	#   codex-copilot-once [args...]    identical zero-persistence alias
16	# (claude-copilot / -once run claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions — the
17	#  proxy flow is the trusted, hands-off path; plain `claude` is unaffected.)
18	#   copilot-here [on|off|status]    per-project pin via ./.claude/settings.local.json
19	#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]  switch the pinned model
20	#   copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT|-] | -l
21	#   semsearch index [PATH...] | semsearch <QUERY> [-k N] [--corpus PATH]
22	#
23	# Contract preserved from the unix version: token at
24	# ~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token, ports 4141 (proxy) / 4142 (shim),
25	# state under $XDG_STATE_HOME/copilot-proxy, per-project ./.claude/settings.local.json
26	# pin, default model gpt-5.6-sol[1m], and the ANTHROPIC_* env block.
27	#
28	# The pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into $XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg and the
29	# proxy runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
30	# bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever resolving
31	# through a socks proxy — which wedged `start` at "Resolving dependencies" AND kept
32	# bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too. Force a re-install with
33	# `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
34	#
35	# Env knobs:
36	#   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default 4141    - port the proxy listens on
37	#   COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT default 45 - seconds allowed for model refresh
38	#   COPILOT_SHIM_PORT    default 4142    - throttle shim port
39	#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0 - spec to install
40	#                                          (changing it re-installs via the stamp)
41	#   COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL                 - override the pinned model
42	#   COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET  1               - add the telemetry-suppressing env keys
43	#   COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY 1            - skip straight to the no-proxy install try
44	#   COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY   default auto    - Node->GitHub /models egress:
45	#                          auto   = use the Windows System Proxy (WinINET registry)
46	#                                   or HTTPS_PROXY when either is set; Node ignores
47	#                                   the system setting unless it is passed the env.
48	#                          always = same, but warn when no proxy is found
49	#                          never  = never pass --proxy-env
50	#                          http://127.0.0.1:PORT = force that URL
51	
52	Set-StrictMode -Off
53	
54	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers ---
55	function script:Get-CopilotPort { if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_PORT) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_PORT } else { '4141' } }
56	function script:Get-CopilotPkg  { if ($env:COPILOT_API_PKG)   { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG }   else { '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' } }
57	function script:Get-CopilotPkgFlavor {
58	    switch -Regex (Get-CopilotPkg) { '^copilot-api(@.*)?$' { 'original' } default { 'fork' } }
59	}
60	function script:Get-CopilotBase    { "http://localhost:$(Get-CopilotPort)" }
61	function script:Get-CopilotTmp     { if ($env:TEMP) { $env:TEMP } else { [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath() } }
62	function script:Get-CopilotLogFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).log" }
63	function script:Get-CopilotPidFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).pid" }
64	function script:Get-CopilotToken   { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share/copilot-api/github_token' }
65	
66	function script:Get-XdgState { if ($env:XDG_STATE_HOME) { $env:XDG_STATE_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/state' } }
67	function script:Get-XdgConfig { if ($env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME) { $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.config' } }
68	function script:Get-XdgData { if ($env:XDG_DATA_HOME) { $env:XDG_DATA_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share' } }
69	
70	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -----------
71	#
72	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
73	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
74	# proxy (a browser/curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
75	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so
76	# every retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and
77	# running the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm
78	# start does zero network before it binds the port.
79	
80	# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
81	# The naive "split on @" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
82	# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
83	function script:Get-CopilotPkgName {
84	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
85	    if ($spec.TrimStart('@') -match '@') { $spec -replace '@[^@]*$', '' } else { $spec }
86	}
87	
88	function script:Get-CopilotPkgPrefix { Join-Path (Get-XdgData) 'copilot-api/pkg' }
89	# Records the spec the prefix currently holds, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the
90	# pinned default) re-installs instead of silently running the old version.
91	function script:Get-CopilotPkgStamp { Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) '.installed-spec' }
92	
93	# The binlink bun wrote, if any. Bun on Windows writes node_modules/.bin/<name>.exe
94	# (plus a .bunx sidecar); the other extensions cover an npm/yarn-populated prefix.
95	# Returns $null when no directly-runnable shim exists — Get-CopilotPkgLaunch then
96	# falls back to `bun run`, which resolves from the local node_modules offline.
97	function script:Get-CopilotPkgBin {
98	    $binDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/.bin'
99	    foreach ($ext in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat', '', '.ps1') {
100	        $p = Join-Path $binDir "copilot-api$ext"
101	        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { return $p }
102	    }
103	    $null
104	}
105	
106	# How to invoke the installed proxy: @{ Exe; Pre; Cwd }. Cwd is non-null only for
107	# the `bun run` fallback, which must resolve node_modules/.bin from the prefix.
108	#
109	# The prefix is deliberately NOT passed as an argument (`bun run --cwd <path>`):
110	# Start-Process joins -ArgumentList with spaces and does no quoting, so a prefix
111	# under a $HOME containing a space ("C:\Users\Da-Wei Lee\...") would arrive split
112	# across two argv entries. -WorkingDirectory takes the path as a real parameter.
113	function script:Get-CopilotPkgLaunch {
114	    $bin = Get-CopilotPkgBin
115	    # .ps1 can't be Start-Process'd directly, and a bare extensionless shim is a
116	    # shell script — route both through `bun run`, which finds node_modules/.bin.
117	    if ($bin -and [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($bin) -in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat') {
118	        return @{ Exe = $bin; Pre = @(); Cwd = $null }
119	    }
120	    if (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
121	        return @{ Exe = 'bun'; Pre = @('run', 'copilot-api'); Cwd = (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) }
122	    }
123	    $null
124	}
125	
126	# Did the package actually land in the prefix? This is the postcondition every
127	# install path is checked against — see Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry for why the
128	# process exit code is not trusted.
129	function script:Test-CopilotPkgPresent {
130	    if (Get-CopilotPkgBin) { return $true }
131	    Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) "node_modules/$(Get-CopilotPkgName)")
132	}
133	
134	# Is the CURRENTLY pinned spec installed and runnable?
135	function script:Test-CopilotPkgReady {
136	    $stamp = Get-CopilotPkgStamp
137	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stamp)) { return $false }
138	    if ((Get-Content -First 1 $stamp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne (Get-CopilotPkg)) { return $false }
139	    Test-CopilotPkgPresent
140	}
141	
142	# One package-install attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. npm is preferred
143	# because it supports Azure Artifacts' credential-provider token in ~/.npmrc;
144	# Bun does not. -NoProxy strips the proxy env for the child. Returns $true only
145	# when the package is actually present afterwards.
146	#
147	# Success is judged from the FILESYSTEM, not $p.ExitCode: a Start-Process -PassThru
148	# object reports ExitCode 0 even for a child that exited non-zero (verified — the
149	# .Handle-caching workaround does not help either), so trusting it would let a
150	# failed install write the .installed-spec stamp and silently pin a broken prefix.
151	#
152	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
153	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
154	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
155	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry {
156	    param([string] $Dir, [switch] $NoProxy, [int] $BudgetSeconds)
157	
158	    $proxyVars = 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy'
159	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
160	    $installer = if ($npm) {
161	        @{ File = $npm.Source; Args = @('install', '--no-save', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', (Get-CopilotPkg)) }
162	    } else {
163	        Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm).'
164	        @{ File = 'bun'; Args = @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') }
165	    }
166	    $saved = @{}
167	    if ($NoProxy) {
168	        foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
169	    }
170	    try {
171	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $installer.File -ArgumentList $installer.Args `
172	            -WorkingDirectory $Dir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
173	        if ($p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) { return (Test-CopilotPkgPresent) }
174	        Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
175	        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the install lock.
176	        $name = [regex]::Escape((Get-CopilotPkgName))
177	        Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
178	            Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'bun.exe', 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match '\b(add|install)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
179	            ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
180	        return $false
181	    } catch {
182	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch package installer ($_)"; return $false
183	    } finally {
184	        if ($NoProxy) {
185	            foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { if ($null -ne $saved[$v]) { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] } }
186	        }
187	    }
188	}
189	
190	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
191	function script:Install-CopilotPkg {
192	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) { return $true }
193	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
194	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return $false
195	    }
196	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg; $prefix = Get-CopilotPkgPrefix
197	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $prefix | Out-Null
198	    # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
199	    $pkgJson = Join-Path $prefix 'package.json'
200	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pkgJson)) {
201	        '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' | Set-Content -Path $pkgJson -Encoding utf8
202	    }
203	
204	    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
205	    # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
206	    # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
207	    # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
208	    # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
209	    $skipFirst = ($env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY -eq '1')
210	    if ($skipFirst -or -not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -BudgetSeconds 45)) {
211	        if (-not $skipFirst) {
212	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: install stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..."
213	            # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
214	            # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
215	            $bunHome = if ($env:BUN_INSTALL) { $env:BUN_INSTALL } else { Join-Path $HOME '.bun' }
216	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $bunHome 'install/cache/.tmp') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
217	        }
218	        if (-not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -NoProxy -BudgetSeconds 90)) {
219	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'."; return $false
220	        }
221	    }
222	
223	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgPresent) -or -not (Get-CopilotPkgLaunch)) {
224	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: install finished but no runnable copilot-api under $prefix."; return $false
225	    }
226	    $spec | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotPkgStamp) -Encoding utf8
227	    $true
228	}

230	# Run a copilot-api subcommand (auth / check-usage / debug) in the foreground.
231	# Honours $launch.Cwd so the `bun run` fallback resolves node_modules/.bin.
232	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand {
233	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argument)
234	    if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
235	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
236	    if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api — try 'copilot-proxy reinstall'"; return }
237	    if ($launch.Cwd) { Push-Location $launch.Cwd }
238	    try { & $launch.Exe @($launch.Pre + $Argument) }
239	    finally { if ($launch.Cwd) { Pop-Location } }
240	}

242	# Live `bun add … copilot-api` processes. Install is a one-shot, so a match at
243	# rest is a clean stale-installer signal: a stalled one keeps bun's global
244	# install-cache lock, which wedges every later install too. Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry
245	# bounds and kills its own attempts, so this should stay empty — it remains as a
246	# safety net for a stall we didn't spawn (e.g. a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`).
247	function script:Get-CopilotStaleInstaller {
248	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
249	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '\badd\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'copilot-api' }
250	}

254	function script:Get-CopilotShimPort   { if ($env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT) { $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT } else { '4142' } }
255	function script:Get-CopilotShimBase   { "http://localhost:$(Get-CopilotShimPort)" }
256	function script:Get-CopilotShimScript { Join-Path (Get-XdgConfig) 'powershell/copilot-throttle-shim.js' }
257	function script:Get-CopilotShimLog    { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-shim-$(Get-CopilotShimPort).log" }
258	function script:Get-CopilotShimPid    { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-shim-$(Get-CopilotShimPort).pid" }

262	# --- egress: which proxy should Node use for the GitHub /models fetch? --------
263	#
264	# copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for the whole process
265	# lifetime, and GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog on some egress paths. Node
266	# does NOT honour the Windows System Proxy on its own — it only sees HTTP(S)_PROXY
267	# — so a host whose browser reaches the unfiltered catalog could still have the
268	# proxy cache a Claude-less list, which then looks exactly like an entitlement
269	# problem. Resolve the URL here and hand it to the child explicitly.
270	#
271	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY: auto|always|never|<url>. Returns a URL or $null.
272	function script:Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy {
273	    $mode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
274	    switch -Regex ($mode) {
275	        '^(never|off|0|false|no)$' { return $null }
276	        '^(http|https|socks5h?)://' { return $mode }
277	        '^(always|auto|on|1|true|yes)$' { break }
278	        default {
279	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)"
280	            return $null
281	        }
282	    }
283	
284	    # The Windows System Proxy (WinINET). This is what Clash Verge / mihomo /
285	    # v2rayN write when their "System Proxy" toggle is on, so reading it covers
286	    # the same ground the unix side gets from its Clash detector.
287	    try {
288	        $key = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction Stop
289	        if ($key.ProxyEnable -eq 1 -and $key.ProxyServer) {
290	            # ProxyServer is either "host:port" or "http=host:port;https=host:port".
291	            $server = $key.ProxyServer
292	            if ($server -match '(?:^|;)\s*https?=([^;]+)') { $server = $Matches[1] }
293	            elseif ($server -match ';') { $server = ($server -split ';')[0] }
294	            if ($server) { return "http://$($server -replace '^https?://', '')" }
295	        }
296	    } catch { $null = $_ }
297	
298	    # Fallback: an explicit env proxy in this shell.
299	    foreach ($v in $env:HTTPS_PROXY, $env:https_proxy, $env:HTTP_PROXY, $env:http_proxy) {
300	        if ($v) { return $v }
301	    }
302	    $null
303	}
304	
305	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW, for the direct-vs-proxied
306	# A/B in doctor. -Via: 'direct' forces no proxy, a URL forces that proxy, absent
307	# uses .NET defaults. Returns sorted-unique ids, or $null on any failure.
308	#
309	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens only ever travel in request headers — never in
310	# a command line, never echoed.
311	function script:Get-CopilotUpstreamModel {
312	    param([string] $Via)
313	
314	    $tokFile = Get-CopilotToken
315	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokFile)) { return $null }
316	    $ghu = Get-Content -First 1 $tokFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
317	    if (-not $ghu) { return $null }
318	
319	    $transport = @{}
320	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
321	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
322	
323	    try {
324	        $ex = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token' -TimeoutSec 10 `
325	            -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "token $ghu"; 'user-agent' = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' } `
326	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
327	    } catch { return $null }
328	
329	    $api = if ($ex.endpoints.api) { $ex.endpoints.api } else { 'https://api.githubcopilot.com' }
330	    if (-not $ex.token) { return $null }
331	
332	    try {
333	        $up = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$api/models" -TimeoutSec 12 `
334	            -Headers @{
335	                'Authorization'            = "Bearer $($ex.token)"
336	                'user-agent'               = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7'
337	                'copilot-integration-id'   = 'vscode-chat'
338	            } @transport -ErrorAction Stop
339	    } catch { return $null }
340	
341	    @($up.data.id | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
342	}
343	
344	# Optional ChatGPT Apps reachability. This is deliberately separate from the
345	# Copilot inference probes: codex_apps is a remote MCP served by chatgpt.com,
346	# not a localhost bridge to Codex.app and not part of GitHub Copilot.
347	function script:Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind {
348	    param($ErrorRecord)
349	
350	    $message = if ($ErrorRecord -is [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]) {
351	        $ErrorRecord.Exception.ToString()
352	    } else { [string]$ErrorRecord }
353	
354	    if ($message -match '(?i)timed?\s*out|timeout|operation.*canceled|deadline') { return 'timeout' }
355	    if ($message -match '(?i)certificate|authenticationexception|ssl|tls|secure channel') { return 'tls' }
356	    'network'
357	}

359	function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
360	    param(
361	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
362	        [string] $Via = 'direct'
363	    )
364	
365	    $transport = @{}
366	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
367	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
368	
369	    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
370	    try {
371	        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12 `
372	            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `
373	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
374	        $sw.Stop()
375	        [pscustomobject]@{
376	            Reached = $true
377	            Code    = [int]$response.StatusCode
378	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
379	            Kind    = $null
380	            Error   = $null
381	        }
382	    } catch {
383	        $sw.Stop()
384	        [pscustomobject]@{
385	            Reached = $false
386	            Code    = 0
387	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
388	            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
389	            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
390	        }
391	    }
392	}

418	# Resolve the model: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
419	#
420	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude Code
421	#     only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to a legacy
422	#     "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
423	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
424	#     window. ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel derives it from live /v1/models metadata
425	#     for every provider. Claude Code-only: raw API clients use the plain id.
426	function script:Get-CopilotDefaultModel {
427	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL }
428	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
429	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return (Get-Content -First 1 $sf) }
430	    'gpt-5.6-sol[1m]'
431	}

433	# Every model id the proxy accepts: .id plus the .claude_model_id alias.
434	function script:Get-CopilotServedModels {
435	    try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop } catch { return @() }
436	    $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
437	    foreach ($m in $r.data) {

439	        if ($m.claude_model_id) { $ids.Add($m.claude_model_id) }
440	    }
441	    $ids | Sort-Object -Unique
442	}

462	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
463	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
464	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
465	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
466	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
467	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
468	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
469	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
470	    if ($Catalog) {
471	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
472	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
473	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
474	        return $raw
475	    }
476	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
477	    $raw
478	}

483	    $null

486	# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
487	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
488	# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
489	function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
490	    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
491	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
492	    $models = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $Catalog
493	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
494	    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
495	
496	    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
497	    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
498	        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
499	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
500	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
501	
502	        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
503	            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
504	        )
505	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
506	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
507	
508	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
509	            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
510	        )
511	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
512	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
513	
514	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
515	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
516	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
517	    }
518	    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
519	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
520	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
521	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
522	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
523	    }
524	
525	    [ordered]@{
526	        main   = $main
527	        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
528	        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
529	        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
530	        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
531	    }
532	}

543	# "<model>|<source>" — the model Claude Code would send from this directory.
544	function script:Get-CopilotEffectiveModel {
545	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
546	    if (Test-Path $settings) {
547	        try {
548	            $j = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
549	            if ($j.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
550	                $m = $j.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
551	                if ($m) { return "$m|project pin: $settings" }
552	            }
553	        } catch { $null = $_ }
554	    }
555	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return "$($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL)|`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" }
556	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
557	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return "$(Get-Content -First 1 $sf)|state file: $sf" }
558	    "$(Get-CopilotDefaultModel)|built-in default"
559	}

561	# The EXACT env block `copilot-here on` / `copilot-run` would apply right now.
562	#
563	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for three callers: copilot-run (process env),
564	# `copilot-here on` (what it merges into settings.local.json) and
565	# Get-CopilotHereDrift (what it compares against). These used to be hand-maintained
566	# copies and they diverged — the drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `on` writes,
567	# so a pin missing ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
568	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC reported "no drift" while `on` would
569	# still have changed it. Add a key here and all three follow.
570	#
571	# -Pinned uses the shim base when the shim is enabled but not yet up (what a
572	# written-to-disk pin should say); copilot-run wants the live base instead.
573	function script:Get-CopilotEnvBlock {
574	    param([switch] $Pinned, [string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
575	    $modelProfile = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) {
576	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
577	    } else {
578	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model
579	    }
580	    $block = [ordered]@{
581	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = if ($Pinned) { Get-CopilotPinnedBase } else { Get-CopilotClientBase }
582	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
583	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $modelProfile.main
584	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL  = $modelProfile.fable
585	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $modelProfile.opus
586	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = $modelProfile.sonnet
587	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = $modelProfile.haiku
588	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = $modelProfile.haiku
589	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
590	    }
591	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
592	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
593	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
594	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
595	        $block.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
596	    }
597	    $block
598	}

600	# --- shim start/stop ---
601	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
602	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
603	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
604	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
605	    }
606	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
607	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
608	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
609	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
610	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
611	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
612	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
613	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
614	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
615	}
616	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
617	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
618	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
619	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
620	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
621	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
622	    }
623	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
624	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
625	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
626	}

628	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
629	function copilot-proxy {
630	    [CmdletBinding()]
631	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
632	
633	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
634	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
635	    }
636	
637	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
638	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
639	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
640	
641	    switch ($action) {
642	        'start' {
643	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
644	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
645	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
646	            }
647	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
648	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
649	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
650	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
651	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
652	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
653	            }
654	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
655	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
656	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
657	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
658	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
659	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
660	
661	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
662	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
663	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
664	            if ($httpProxy) {
665	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
666	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
667	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
668	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
669	            }
670	
671	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
672	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
673	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
674	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
675	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
676	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
677	            } else {
678	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
679	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
680	            }
681	
682	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
683	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
684	            $saved = @{}
685	            if ($httpProxy) {
686	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
687	            }
688	            try {
689	                $spArgs = @{
690	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
691	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
692	                    PassThru                = $true
693	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
694	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
695	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
696	                }
697	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
698	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
699	            } finally {
700	                if ($httpProxy) {
701	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
702	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
703	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
704	                    }
705	                }
706	            }
707	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
708	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
709	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
710	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
711	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
712	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
713	                    }
714	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
715	                    return
716	                }
717	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
718	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
719	                if ($p.HasExited) {
720	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
721	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
722	                }
723	                Start-Sleep 1
724	            }
725	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
726	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
727	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
728	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
729	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
730	        }
731	        'stop' {
732	            Stop-CopilotShim
733	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
734	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
735	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
736	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
737	            }
738	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
739	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
740	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
741	            Start-Sleep 1
742	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
743	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
744	        }
745	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
746	        'status' {
747	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
748	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
749	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
750	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
751	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
752	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
753	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
754	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
755	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
756	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
757	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
758	            } else {
759	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
760	            }
761	        }
762	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
763	        'logs' {
764	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
765	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
766	            } else {
767	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
768	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
769	            }
770	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
771	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
772	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
773	        }
774	        'auth' {
775	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
776	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
777	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
778	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth --provider copilot }
779	        }
780	        'reinstall' {
781	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
782	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
783	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
784	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
785	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
786	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $(Get-CopilotPkg) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
787	        }
788	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
789	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
790	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
791	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
792	            }
793	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
794	                try {
795	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
796	                    [pscustomobject]@{
797	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
798	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
799	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
800	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
801	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
802	            } else {
803	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
804	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
805	            }
806	        }
807	        'shim' {
808	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
809	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
810	            switch ($sub) {
811	                'on' {
812	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
813	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
814	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
815	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
816	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
817	                }
818	                'off' {
819	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
820	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
821	                }
822	                default {
823	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
824	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
825	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
826	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
827	                }
828	            }
829	        }
830	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
831	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
832	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
833	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
834	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
835	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
836	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
837	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
838	        }
839	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
840	    }
841	}
842	
843	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
844	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
845	    param([switch] $Live)
846	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
847	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
848	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
849	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
850	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
851	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
852	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
853	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
854	
855	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
856	
857	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
858	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
859	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
860	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
861	    }
862	
863	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
864	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
865	    # network at all. An un-installed prefix is not a fault: the next start installs it.
866	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
867	        OK 'installed' $pkg
868	        $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
869	        if ($launch) {
870	            $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()
871	            if ($launch.Cwd) { $how += "   (cwd: $($launch.Cwd))" }
872	            SKIP 'runs via' $how
873	        } else { BAD 'runs via' 'no runnable binary'; HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall' }
874	    } else {
875	        NOTE 'not installed' "$pkg — the next 'copilot-proxy start' installs it (one-time)"
876	        HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now'
877	    }
878	
879	    Write-Host "`nAuthentication"
880	    if (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken)) { OK 'token file' (Get-CopilotToken) } else { BAD 'token file' 'absent'; HINT 'copilot-proxy auth' }
881	
882	    Write-Host "`nProxy"
883	    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { OK 'listening' (Get-CopilotBase) } else { BAD 'listening' "nothing on port $port"; HINT 'copilot-proxy start' }
884	    # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds the
885	    # port: `start` just says "did not come up in time" and the log shows only
886	    # "Resolving dependencies". Hard failure when nothing is listening (that IS the
887	    # fault), softer when the proxy is up (a leftover still holding bun's cache lock,
888	    # which will hang the next restart).
889	    $stale = @(Get-CopilotStaleInstaller)
890	    if ($stale.Count -gt 0) {
891	        if (Test-CopilotAlive) { NOTE 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)" }
892	        else { BAD 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at `"Resolving dependencies`", never binds port $port" }
893	        HINT "kill just those: Stop-Process -Id $($stale.ProcessId -join ',') -Force"
894	        HINT 'then: copilot-proxy reinstall'
895	        HINT 're-hangs? bun is stalling on the proxy — $env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1; copilot-proxy reinstall'
896	    } else {
897	        SKIP 'installer' "no wedged 'bun add' process"
898	    }
899	    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
900	        if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { OK 'throttle shim' "up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)" } else { BAD 'throttle shim' 'enabled but DOWN'; HINT 'copilot-proxy shim on' }
901	    } else { SKIP 'throttle shim' 'off' }
902	
903	    Write-Host "`nModels"
904	    $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
905	    $proxyMode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
906	    if ($httpProxy) { NOTE 'http proxy' "$httpProxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this" }
907	    else { SKIP 'http proxy' "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode)" }
908	
909	    # A/B: true-direct vs via the local proxy. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog
910	    # on some egress, and .NET/curl follow the System Proxy by default — so a single
911	    # "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as an entitlement problem.
912	    $dirClaude = 0; $viaClaude = 0; $anyUpstream = $false
913	    $upDirect = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via 'direct'
914	    if ($upDirect) {
915	        $anyUpstream = $true
916	        $dirClaude = @($upDirect | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
917	        OK 'upstream direct' "$($upDirect.Count) ids, $dirClaude claude (no proxy)"
918	    } else {
919	        SKIP 'upstream direct' 'could not query GitHub direct (need a token, or blocked)'
920	    }
921	    if ($httpProxy) {
922	        $upVia = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via $httpProxy
923	        if ($upVia) {
924	            $anyUpstream = $true
925	            $viaClaude = @($upVia | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
926	            OK 'upstream via proxy' "$($upVia.Count) ids, $viaClaude claude ($httpProxy)"
927	        } else {
928	            BAD 'upstream via proxy' "no response through $httpProxy"
929	            HINT 'the Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another selection'
930	        }
931	    }
932	
933	    $served = Get-CopilotServedModels
934	    if ($served -and $served.Count -gt 0) {
935	        $claude = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' })
936	        OK 'served' "$($served.Count) model ids"
937	        if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { OK 'claude models' "$($claude.Count) ids available" }
938	        else { NOTE 'claude models' "0 of $($served.Count) — Anthropic unavailable; role-aware OpenAI fallback will be used" }
939	
940	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0) {
941	            NOTE 'egress geo' 'Claude appears ONLY via the local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct egress'
942	            if ($claude.Count -eq 0) {
943	                BAD 'MISSING --proxy-env' 'copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog'
944	                HINT 'copilot-proxy restart   # auto attaches --proxy-env when a proxy is detected'
945	                HINT '$env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7897"; copilot-proxy restart'
946	            }
947	        } elseif ($viaClaude -eq 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0 -and $anyUpstream) {
948	            NOTE 'entitlement' 'neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude'
949	            HINT 'org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help'
950	        } elseif ($claude.Count -eq 0 -and $viaClaude -gt 0) {
951	            BAD 'STALE CACHE' 'via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not'
952	            HINT 'copilot-proxy restart'
953	        } elseif ($claude.Count -gt 0) {
954	            OK 'cache' 'the served Claude list looks healthy'
955	        }
956	
957	        $pin = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
958	        $model = $pin[0]; $src = $pin[1]
959	        if ($served -contains $model) { OK 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)" }
960	        else {
961	            BAD 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)"
962	            HINT 'not served -> requests return 400 model_not_supported'
963	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # Claude; else capability-ranked OpenAI, then Gemini'
964	            HINT 'copilot-model -l       # list served ids'
965	        }
966	
967	        # Validate every alias Claude Code may select for background/subagent
968	        # work. A stale Sonnet/Haiku id can fail with 400 while main chat works.
969	        $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
970	        $modelProfile = $null
971	        if (Test-Path $settings) {
972	            try {
973	                $localEnv = (Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env
974	                if ($localEnv.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
975	                    $modelProfile = [ordered]@{
976	                        main   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
977	                        fable  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
978	                        opus   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
979	                        sonnet = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
980	                        haiku  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
981	                    }
982	                }
983	            } catch { $modelProfile = $null }
984	        }
985	        if (-not $modelProfile) {
986	            $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
987	            $modelProfile = Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $model -Catalog $catalog
988	        }
989	        $roleBad = $false
990	        foreach ($role in 'fable', 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku') {
991	            $roleModel = $modelProfile[$role]
992	            if (-not $roleModel) {
993	                BAD "role $role" 'unset — Claude Code may choose its native default and get model_not_supported'
994	                $roleBad = $true
995	            }
996	            elseif ($served -notcontains $roleModel) {
997	                BAD "role $role" "$roleModel is not served"
998	                $roleBad = $true
999	            }
1000	        }
1001	        if (-not $roleBad) {
1002	            OK 'model roles' "fable=$($modelProfile.fable), opus=$($modelProfile.opus), sonnet=$($modelProfile.sonnet), haiku=$($modelProfile.haiku)"
1003	        } else {
1004	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # rewrite main + every Claude Code role alias'
1005	        }
1006	    } else {
1007	        BAD 'served' "could not fetch $(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models"
1008	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0) { HINT 'start with the proxy: copilot-proxy start   # attaches --proxy-env automatically' }
1009	    }
1010	
1011	    Write-Host "`nUpstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
1012	    foreach ($h in 'api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com', 'api.githubcopilot.com') {
1013	        try {
1014	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1015	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://$h/models" -TimeoutSec 12 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1016	            $sw.Stop()
1017	            OK $h "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
1018	        } catch { BAD $h 'no response within 12s'; HINT 'connection blocked or upstream unreachable' }
1019	    }
1020	    SKIP '' 'HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)'
1021	
1022	    Write-Host "`nCodex Apps (ChatGPT MCP)"
1023	    $appsUri = 'https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps'
1024	    SKIP 'route' "$appsUri — independent of localhost Copilot inference and Codex.app"
1025	    if (-not $Live) {
1026	        SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to compare direct and configured-proxy reachability'
1027	    } else {
1028	        $appsDirect = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via 'direct'
1029	        if ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1030	            OK 'direct' "HTTP $($appsDirect.Code) in $($appsDirect.Seconds)s (an auth rejection still proves reachability)"
1031	        } else {
1032	            NOTE 'direct' "$($appsDirect.Kind) failure after $($appsDirect.Seconds)s"
1033	            if ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'tls') { HINT 'inspect antivirus/corporate TLS interception and the Windows trust store' }
1034	            elseif ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'timeout') { HINT 'the ChatGPT Apps route is blocked or not entering the expected TUN path' }
1035	        }
1036	
1037	        if ($httpProxy) {
1038	            $appsVia = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via $httpProxy
1039	            if ($appsVia.Reached) {
1040	                OK 'via proxy' "HTTP $($appsVia.Code) in $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1041	                if (-not $appsDirect.Reached) {
1042	                    HINT "Codex Apps needs this route; launch Codex with HTTPS_PROXY=$httpProxy or repair TUN routing"
1043	                }
1044	            } elseif ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1045	                SKIP 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure — direct already works, so Apps need no explicit proxy"
1046	            } else {
1047	                NOTE 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure after $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1048	                HINT 'this does not invalidate GitHub Copilot inference; it only explains codex_apps startup failures'
1049	            }
1050	        } else {
1051	            SKIP 'via proxy' 'no explicit/system HTTP proxy detected; TUN may still carry direct traffic'
1052	        }
1053	    }
1054	
1055	    Write-Host "`nLive probe"
1056	    if (-not $Live) { SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)' }
1057	    elseif (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { SKIP 'skipped' 'proxy is not running' }
1058	    elseif (-not $served) { SKIP 'skipped' 'no served model to probe with' }
1059	    else {
1060	        $pm = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'embedding' -and $_ -notmatch '\[1m\]' })[0]
1061	        $body = @{ model = $pm; max_tokens = 1; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'hi' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
1062	        try {
1063	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1064	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotClientBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `
1065	                -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1066	            $sw.Stop()
1067	            if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300) { OK 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s" }
1068	            else { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode)"; HINT 'copilot-proxy logs 40' }
1069	        } catch { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> request failed ($_)" }
1070	    }
1071	
1072	    Write-Host ''
1073	    if ($script:fail -gt 0) { Write-Host "$($script:fail) failed, $($script:warn) warning(s)`n"; return }
1074	    Write-Host "all checks passed ($($script:warn) warning(s))`n"
1075	}

1077	# ------------------------------------------------------------- copilot-run ----
1078	function copilot-run {
1079	    [CmdletBinding()]
1080	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1081	    if (-not $Argv -or $Argv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]'; return }
1082	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1083	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) { Start-CopilotShim | Out-Null }
1084	
1085	    # Single source of truth — see Get-CopilotEnvBlock.
1086	    $inject = Get-CopilotEnvBlock
1087	    # Scope env to the child process: set, run, restore (equivalent to `env VAR=..`).
1088	    $saved = @{}
1089	    foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) { $saved[$k] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($k); Set-Item "env:$k" $inject[$k] }
1090	    try {
1091	        $exe = $Argv[0]; $rest = if ($Argv.Count -gt 1) { $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
1092	        & $exe @rest
1093	    } finally {
1094	        foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) {
1095	            if ($null -eq $saved[$k]) { Remove-Item "env:$k" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1096	            else { Set-Item "env:$k" $saved[$k] }
1097	        }
1098	    }
1099	}
