1101	# Codex prefers a native Responses-capable OpenAI model. Claude/Gemini are
1102	# Responses Lite fallbacks only, unlike Select-CopilotBestModel (Claude Code),
1103	# where native Claude remains the first choice.
1104	function script:Select-CopilotBestCodexModel {
1105	    param([string[]] $Model)
1106	    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
1107	    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1108	
1109	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex',
1110	                           'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
1111	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1112	    }
1113	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1114	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1115	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1116	    }
1117	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' 'mini|nano|luna'
1118	    if ($r) { return $r }
1119	    $r = & $pick 'codex' $null
1120	    if ($r) { return $r }
1121	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' $null
1122	    if ($r) { return $r }
1123	
1124	    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
1125	                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
1126	                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
1127	                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
1128	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1129	    }
1130	    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
1131	    if ($r) { return $r }
1132	    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' 'flash'
1133	    if ($r) { return $r }
1134	    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' $null
1135	    if ($r) { return $r }
1136	    @($Model | Sort-Object)[-1]
1137	}

1139	function script:Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd {
1140	    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1141	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1142	        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1143	            if ($line -match '^\s*codex_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1144	                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1145	                if ($v) { return $v }
1146	            }
1147	        }
1148	    }
1149	    'codex'
1150	}

1156	    }
1157	    $false

1160	function codex-copilot {
1161	    [CmdletBinding()]
1162	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1163	    $ss = 'auto'
1164	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
1165	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
1166	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1167	        Write-Host 'Usage: codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]'
1168	        Write-Host '  One-off Codex session on the local Copilot Responses gateway.'
1169	        Write-Host '  Auto model: OpenAI/Codex > Claude > Gemini > other served chat models.'
1170	        Write-Host '  Alias: codex-copilot-once'
1171	        return
1172	    }
1173	
1174	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1175	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) {
1176	        if (-not (Start-CopilotShim)) { return }
1177	    }
1178	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1179	    if (-not $catalog) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: could not read the live gateway model catalog'; return }
1180	
1181	    $explicitModel = Test-CopilotExplicitCodexModel -Argv $Argv
1182	    $model = $null
1183	    if (-not $explicitModel) {
1184	        $models = @($catalog.data | Where-Object {
1185	            ($_.policy.state -ne 'disabled') -and ($_.model_picker_enabled -ne $false) -and
1186	            ($_.capabilities.type -ne 'embeddings')
1187	        } | ForEach-Object { $_.id } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1188	        $model = Select-CopilotBestCodexModel -Model $models
1189	        if (-not $model) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: no usable chat model in the live gateway catalog'; return }
1190	        $Argv = @('-m', $model) + @($Argv)
1191	        if ($model -like 'claude-*' -or $model -like 'gemini-*') {
1192	            Write-Warning "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model (Responses Lite; tool_search unavailable)"
1193	        } else { Write-Host "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model" }
1194	    }
1195	
1196	    $base = Get-CopilotClientBase
1197	    $providerArgs = @(
1198	        '-c', 'model_provider="copilot_api"',
1199	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.name="OpenAI"',
1200	        '-c', "model_providers.copilot_api.base_url=`"$base`"",
1201	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.env_key="GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY"',
1202	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.requires_openai_auth=true',
1203	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.supports_websockets=false',
1204	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.wire_api="responses"',
1205	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.request_max_retries=3',
1206	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_max_retries=1',
1207	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_idle_timeout_ms=300000',
1208	        '-c', 'features.remote_compaction_v2=true',
1209	        '-c', 'features.code_mode.excluded_tool_namespaces=["mcp__codex_apps__sites"]'
1210	    )
1211	    if ($model) {
1212	        $entry = $catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $model } | Select-Object -First 1
1213	        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) {
1214	            $Argv = @('-c', "model_context_window=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens)") + @($Argv)
1215	        }
1216	        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens) {
1217	            $Argv = @('-c', "model_auto_compact_token_limit=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens)") + @($Argv)
1218	        }
1219	    }
1220	
1221	    $savedKey = $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY
1222	    $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = 'dummy'
1223	    try {
1224	        if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1225	            $cc = Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd
1226	            foreach ($a in @($providerArgs) + @($Argv)) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
1227	            specstory run codex -c $cc
1228	        } else { codex @providerArgs @Argv }
1229	    } finally {
1230	        if ($null -eq $savedKey) { Remove-Item env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1231	        else { $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = $savedKey }
1232	    }
1233	}

1241	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ---
1242	#
1243	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1244	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1245	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1246	# `-c "claude $args"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1247	# claude-copilot has args to pass through, which made these two disagree:
1248	#
1249	#   claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
1250	#   claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"
1251	#
1252	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1253	# truth for BOTH branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it.
1254	
1255	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1256	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > `claude`
1257	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1258	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1259	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1260	function script:Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd {
1261	    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1262	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1263	        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1264	            if ($line -match '^\s*claude_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1265	                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1266	                if ($v) { return $v }
1267	            }
1268	        }
1269	    }
1270	    'claude'
1271	}
1272	
1273	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
1274	# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes, so quoting is both possible
1275	# and necessary — an unquoted join flattens `-p "two words"` into two arguments.
1276	# POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
1277	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote {
1278	    param([string] $Value)
1279	    "'" + ($Value -replace "'", "'\''") + "'"
1280	}
1281	
1282	# --------------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot -----
1283	function claude-copilot {
1284	    [CmdletBinding()]
1285	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1286	    $ss = 'auto'
1287	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1288	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1289	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1290	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1291	        Write-Host "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy. Sticky: copilot-here on"
1292	        Write-Host "  Runs claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions (hands-off proxy flow)."
1293	        return
1294	    }
1295	    if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1296	        if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -gt 0) {
1297	            # Rebuild what `-c` clobbers: the configured base command (ITS flags left
1298	            # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
1299	            $cc = Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd
1300	            foreach ($a in $Argv) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
1301	            copilot-run specstory run claude -c $cc
1302	        }
1303	        else { copilot-run specstory run claude }

1312	# --------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot-once ------
1313	function claude-copilot-once {
1314	    [CmdletBinding()]
1315	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1316	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1317	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1318	        Write-Host "  Pin this project to the proxy, run one session, auto-unpin (even on Ctrl-C)."
1319	        return
1320	    }
1321	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) {
1322	        Write-Error "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(Get-CopilotPort). Start it: copilot-proxy start"; return
1323	    }
1324	    $wasOn = $false
1325	    if (Test-Path '.claude/settings.local.json') {
1326	        try { if ((Get-Content -Raw '.claude/settings.local.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { $wasOn = $true } } catch { $null = $_ }
1327	    }
1328	    if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here on }
1329	    else {
1330	        # Already pinned here. If the pin drifted from current defaults (model bump,
1331	        # proxy moved, a key added since), offer to refresh it in place; otherwise
1332	        # leave it untouched. Either way it was already ON, so it stays ON on exit.
1333	        $drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift
1334	        if ($drift) {
1335	            Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: this project's copilot-here pin looks stale:"
1336	            $drift | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
1337	            if (Confirm-CopilotAction '  override with current defaults? (keep = default) [y/N]') { copilot-here on }
1338	            else { Write-Host 'claude-copilot-once: kept the existing pin (stays ON on exit).' }
1339	        } else {
1340	            Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: copilot-here already ON here — leaving the pin in place on exit."
1341	        }
1342	    }
1343	    try {
1344	        claude-copilot @Argv
1345	    } finally {
1346	        if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here off }
1347	        Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: session ended. Proxy still running on $(Get-CopilotBase)."
1348	    }
1349	}

1354	    'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL',
1355	    'CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC', 'CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER',

1357	)

1359	# y/N prompt. Returns $true only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive host
1360	# returns $false — the safe default (keep, don't override). Only called right
1361	# before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading input is fine.
1362	function script:Confirm-CopilotAction {
1363	    param([string] $Message = 'Proceed? [y/N]')
1364	    if (-not [Environment]::UserInteractive -or [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { return $false }
1365	    $ans = Read-Host -Prompt $Message
1366	    $ans -match '^\s*y(es)?\s*$'
1367	}
1368	
1369	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1370	# write now (default model bumped, proxy moved, a key added since the pin was
1371	# written)? Returns one "  KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key, or nothing.
1372	#
1373	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1374	# computed by diffing the live file against Get-CopilotEnvBlock — not a hand-picked
1375	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). The asymmetry is
1376	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1377	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1378	function script:Get-CopilotHereDrift {
1379	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1380	    if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { return @() }
1381	    try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return @() }
1382	    # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent -> nothing to do.
1383	    if (-not $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { return @() }
1384	
1385	    $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1386	    $out = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1387	    foreach ($k in $want.Keys) {
1388	        $cur = if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k } else { '(unset)' }
1389	        if ($cur -ne $want[$k]) { $out.Add("  $k : $cur -> $($want[$k])") }
1390	    }
1391	    $out
1392	}
1393	
1394	function copilot-here {
1395	    [CmdletBinding()]
1396	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1397	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1398	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1399	    switch ($action) {
1400	        'on' {
1401	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.claude' | Out-Null
1402	            $obj = if (Test-Path $settings) { try { Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { [pscustomobject]@{} } } else { [pscustomobject]@{} }
1403	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties['env']) { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
1404	            # Single source of truth, shared with copilot-run and the drift check.
1405	            $envSet = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1406	            $model = $envSet.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
1407	            foreach ($k in $envSet.Keys) {
1408	                if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k = $envSet[$k] }
1409	                else { $obj.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $envSet[$k] }
1410	            }
1411	            $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
1412	            # Belt-and-braces gitignore via .git/info/exclude (un-anchored **/ form).
1413	            $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null
1414	            if ($gitDir) {
1415	                git check-ignore -q $settings 2>$null
1416	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
1417	                    $exclude = Join-Path $gitDir 'info/exclude'
1418	                    Add-Content -Path $exclude -Value '**/.claude/settings.local.json'
1419	                }
1420	            }
1421	            Write-Host "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $(Get-CopilotBase) (model: $model)"
1422	            if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }
1423	        }
1424	        'off' {

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..26586a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
+# chezmoi modify_ script: enforce only Codex's native footer while preserving
+# every unrelated live setting (providers, projects, plugins, feature flags).
+# Runs under [interpreters.ps1]. A malformed live file is passed through
+# unchanged: config recovery must be explicit, never an accidental overwrite.
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+function Write-StdoutBytes {
+    param([byte[]] $Bytes)
+    $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
+    $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
+    $out.Flush()
+}
+
+$utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
+$overlayText = @'
+{{ include (joinPath .chezmoi.sourceDir ".chezmoitemplates/agents/codex.config.overlay.toml") }}
+'@
+$liveText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
+
+# Empty input is a fresh install and the overlay itself is already valid TOML.
+if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($liveText)) {
+    Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($overlayText)
+    return
+}
+
+$tmpDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
+$stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()
+$overlayFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-overlay-$stamp.toml"
+$liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-live-$stamp.toml"
+$pyFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-merge-$stamp.py"
+$outFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-out-$stamp.toml"
+
+try {
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($overlayFile, $overlayText, $utf8)
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($liveFile, $liveText, $utf8)
+
+    $py = $null
+    if (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
+        $py = @('uv', 'run', '--no-project', '--quiet', '--with', 'tomlkit', '--python', '>=3.11', 'python')
+    } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
+        $py = @('python')
+    } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
+        $py = @('python3')
+    }
+
+    if (-not $py) {
+        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('modify_config.toml: no uv/python found; preserving live config unchanged')
+        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($liveText)
+        return
+    }
+
+    $pySource = @'
+import os
+import sys
+
+import tomlkit
+
+overlay_path = os.environ["CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE"]
+live_path = os.environ["CODEX_LIVE_FILE"]
+out_path = os.environ["CODEX_OUT_FILE"]
+
+with open(overlay_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+    overlay_text = fh.read()
+with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+    live_text = fh.read()
+
+try:
+    live = tomlkit.parse(live_text)
+    overlay = tomlkit.parse(overlay_text)
+except Exception as exc:
+    print(f"modify_config.toml: invalid TOML; preserving live config unchanged: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
+        fh.write(live_text)
+    sys.exit(0)
+
+if "tui" not in live or not isinstance(live["tui"], dict):
+    live["tui"] = tomlkit.table()
+live["tui"]["status_line"] = overlay["tui"]["status_line"]
+
+with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
+    fh.write(tomlkit.dumps(live))
+'@
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($pyFile, $pySource, $utf8)
+
+    $env:CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE = $overlayFile
+    $env:CODEX_LIVE_FILE = $liveFile
+    $env:CODEX_OUT_FILE = $outFile
+    $exe = $py[0]
+    $rest = if ($py.Count -gt 1) { @($py[1..($py.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
+    $rest += $pyFile
+    & $exe @rest
+    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
+
+    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile)) {
+        [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: merge failed (exit $rc); preserving live config unchanged")
+        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($liveText)
+        return
+    }
+
+    Write-StdoutBytes ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($outFile))
+} finally {
+    foreach ($f in $overlayFile, $liveFile, $pyFile, $outFile) {
+        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    }
+    foreach ($v in 'CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE', 'CODEX_LIVE_FILE', 'CODEX_OUT_FILE') {
+        Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    }
+}

+# Optional ChatGPT Apps reachability. This is deliberately separate from the
+# Copilot inference probes: codex_apps is a remote MCP served by chatgpt.com,
+# not a localhost bridge to Codex.app and not part of GitHub Copilot.
+function script:Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind {
+    param($ErrorRecord)
+
+    $message = if ($ErrorRecord -is [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]) {
+        $ErrorRecord.Exception.ToString()
+    } else { [string]$ErrorRecord }
+
+    if ($message -match '(?i)timed?\s*out|timeout|operation.*canceled|deadline') { return 'timeout' }
+    if ($message -match '(?i)certificate|authenticationexception|ssl|tls|secure channel') { return 'tls' }
+    'network'
+}
+
+function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
+        [string] $Via = 'direct'
+    )
+
+    $transport = @{}
+    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
+    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
+
+    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
+    try {
+        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12 `
+            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `
+            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
+        $sw.Stop()
+        [pscustomobject]@{
+            Reached = $true
+            Code    = [int]$response.StatusCode
+            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
+            Kind    = $null
+            Error   = $null
+        }
+    } catch {
+        $sw.Stop()
+        [pscustomobject]@{
+            Reached = $false
+            Code    = 0
+            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
+            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
+            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
+        }
+    }
+}
+

+# Codex prefers a native Responses-capable OpenAI model. Claude/Gemini are
+# Responses Lite fallbacks only, unlike Select-CopilotBestModel (Claude Code),
+# where native Claude remains the first choice.
+function script:Select-CopilotBestCodexModel {
+    param([string[]] $Model)
+    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
+    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
+
+    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex',
+                           'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
+        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
+    }
+    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
+        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
+        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
+    }
+    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' 'mini|nano|luna'
+    if ($r) { return $r }
+    $r = & $pick 'codex' $null
+    if ($r) { return $r }
+    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' $null
+    if ($r) { return $r }
+
+    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
+                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
+                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
+        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
+    }
+    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
+    if ($r) { return $r }
+    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' 'flash'
+    if ($r) { return $r }
+    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' $null
+    if ($r) { return $r }
+    @($Model | Sort-Object)[-1]
+}
+
+function script:Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd {
+    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
+        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
+            if ($line -match '^\s*codex_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
+                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
+                if ($v) { return $v }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    'codex'
+}
+
+function script:Test-CopilotExplicitCodexModel {
+    param([string[]] $Argv)
+    foreach ($a in $Argv) {
+        if ($a -in '-m', '--model' -or $a -match '^(?:-m|--model)=') { return $true }
+    }
+    $false
+}
+
+function codex-copilot {
+    [CmdletBinding()]
+    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
+    $ss = 'auto'
+    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
+    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
+    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
+        Write-Host 'Usage: codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]'
+        Write-Host '  One-off Codex session on the local Copilot Responses gateway.'
+        Write-Host '  Auto model: OpenAI/Codex > Claude > Gemini > other served chat models.'
+        Write-Host '  Alias: codex-copilot-once'
+        return
+    }
+
+    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
+    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) {
+        if (-not (Start-CopilotShim)) { return }
+    }
+    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
+    if (-not $catalog) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: could not read the live gateway model catalog'; return }
+
+    $explicitModel = Test-CopilotExplicitCodexModel -Argv $Argv
+    $model = $null
+    if (-not $explicitModel) {
+        $models = @($catalog.data | Where-Object {
+            ($_.policy.state -ne 'disabled') -and ($_.model_picker_enabled -ne $false) -and
+            ($_.capabilities.type -ne 'embeddings')
+        } | ForEach-Object { $_.id } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
+        $model = Select-CopilotBestCodexModel -Model $models
+        if (-not $model) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: no usable chat model in the live gateway catalog'; return }
+        $Argv = @('-m', $model) + @($Argv)
+        if ($model -like 'claude-*' -or $model -like 'gemini-*') {
+            Write-Warning "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model (Responses Lite; tool_search unavailable)"
+        } else { Write-Host "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model" }
+    }
+
+    $base = Get-CopilotClientBase
+    $providerArgs = @(
+        '-c', 'model_provider="copilot_api"',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.name="OpenAI"',
+        '-c', "model_providers.copilot_api.base_url=`"$base`"",
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.env_key="GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY"',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.requires_openai_auth=true',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.supports_websockets=false',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.wire_api="responses"',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.request_max_retries=3',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_max_retries=1',
+        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_idle_timeout_ms=300000',
+        '-c', 'features.remote_compaction_v2=true',
+        '-c', 'features.code_mode.excluded_tool_namespaces=["mcp__codex_apps__sites"]'
+    )
+    if ($model) {
+        $entry = $catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $model } | Select-Object -First 1
+        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) {
+            $Argv = @('-c', "model_context_window=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens)") + @($Argv)
+        }
+        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens) {
+            $Argv = @('-c', "model_auto_compact_token_limit=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens)") + @($Argv)
+        }
+    }
+
+    $savedKey = $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY
+    $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = 'dummy'
+    try {
+        if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
+            $cc = Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd
+            foreach ($a in @($providerArgs) + @($Argv)) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
+            specstory run codex -c $cc
+        } else { codex @providerArgs @Argv }
+    } finally {
+        if ($null -eq $savedKey) { Remove-Item env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
+        else { $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = $savedKey }
+    }
+}
+
+function codex-copilot-once {
+    [CmdletBinding()]
+    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
+    codex-copilot @Argv
+}

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/CodexConfig.Tests.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+BeforeAll {
+    $RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
+    $TemplatePath = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl'
+    $RenderedPath = Join-Path $TestDrive 'modify_config.toml.ps1'
+    $rendered = & chezmoi execute-template --source $RepoRoot --file $TemplatePath
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to render Codex modifier' }
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($RenderedPath, ($rendered -join "`n"), [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+
+    function Invoke-CodexModifier([string] $Live) {
+        $stdout = $Live | & pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File $RenderedPath 2>$null
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Codex modifier failed with exit $LASTEXITCODE" }
+        $stdout -join "`n"
+    }
+}
+
+Describe 'Codex config overlay' {
+    It 'creates the native provider-neutral status line from empty input' {
+        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier ''
+        $result | Should -Match '(?s)status_line\s*=.*model-with-reasoning.*fast-mode.*git-branch.*context-remaining.*task-progress.*current-dir'
+        $result | Should -Not -Match 'five-hour-limit|weekly-limit'
+    }
+
+    It 'preserves providers and nested TUI keymaps while enforcing status_line' {
+        $live = @'
+model = "custom-model"
+
+[model_providers.copilot]
+base_url = "http://localhost:4142"
+
+[tui]
+status_line = ["current-dir"]
+
+[tui.keymap.editor]
+insert_newline = ["ctrl-j"]
+'@
+        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier $live
+        $result | Should -Match 'model = "custom-model"'
+        $result | Should -Match 'base_url = "http://localhost:4142"'
+        $result | Should -Match '(?s)status_line\s*=.*model-with-reasoning.*current-dir'
+        $result | Should -Match '(?s)\[tui\.keymap\.editor\].*insert_newline'
+    }
+
+    It 'fails closed by preserving malformed live TOML' {
+        $live = "model = [`n"
+        Invoke-CodexModifier $live | Should -Be $live
+    }
+}

I searched the web for: tomlkit "Empty key at line 1 col 0" BOM U+FEFF and found several relevant results (issues, docs, and guidance about the UTF‑8 BOM and how it breaks parsers).

Summary of the most relevant findings
- Several tomlkit / poetry-related GitHub issues report “empty key” parse errors when parsing pyproject.toml / TOML files; these discussions show the parser raising errors for empty / unexpected keys and that tomlkit’s behavior around empty keys has been discussed/fixed in the project history. ([github.com](https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/issues/143))  
- The Byte Order Mark (BOM), U+FEFF (UTF‑8 bytes 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF), is an invisible character that many editors or Windows tools can add to the start of a file and that commonly causes “invisible” parsing problems in JSON/TOML/etc. — parsers may see that leading character as an unexpected/empty key. ([unicodefyi.com](https://unicodefyi.com/guide/byte-order-mark-guide/))  
- Several troubleshooting threads (e.g., pipenv/tomlkit-related errors and Stack Overflow posts) show that malformed leading bytes/invisible BOM characters can produce tomlkit parse errors and that removing the BOM or re-saving the file as “UTF‑8 without BOM” resolves the problem. ([stackoverflow.com](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/58503128/getting-pipenv-internal-error-while-trying-to-run-this-command-pipenv-lock-w))  
- Official tomlkit docs / code are available if you want to inspect the parser behavior or check versions. ([tomlkit.readthedocs.io](https://tomlkit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/))

Quick recommended fixes (what to try)
1. Check whether the file starts with a UTF‑8 BOM. For example: hexdump -C pyproject.toml | head -n1 — if you see EF BB BF at the start, there’s a UTF‑8 BOM. (Guides on BOM byte patterns explain this.) ([stackoverflow.com](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/45240387/how-can-i-remove-the-bom-from-a-utf-8-file))  
2. Remove the BOM / re-save without BOM:
   - Open the file in a capable editor and “Save As” / choose “UTF‑8 (without BOM)”.
   - Or remove it on the command line (examples shown in community answers). Re-saving/removing the BOM is a common fix. ([stackoverflow.com](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/45240387/how-can-i-remove-the-bom-from-a-utf-8-file))  
3. Re-run the tool (poetry/pipenv/your script) after the file is saved without BOM; the tomlkit parse error usually disappears. Community reports show this resolves the “Empty key …” failures. ([stackoverflow.com](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/58503128/getting-pipenv-internal-error-while-trying-to-run-this-command-pipenv-lock-w))

commit 6525d0310d1b6093d96b10d44f617b95d9dad70c
Author: Hanru Zhou <hanruzhou@microsoft.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 29 17:54:19 2026 +0800

    fix(copilot): install proxy through authenticated npm

diff --git a/dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1 b/dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
index 8b6864c..10b7794 100644
--- a/dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
+++ b/dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
@@ -136,9 +136,10 @@ function script:Test-CopilotPkgReady {
     Test-CopilotPkgPresent
 }
 
-# One `bun add` attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. -NoProxy strips the
-# proxy env for the child. Returns $true only when the package is actually present
-# afterwards.
+# One package-install attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. npm is preferred
+# because it supports Azure Artifacts' credential-provider token in ~/.npmrc;
+# Bun does not. -NoProxy strips the proxy env for the child. Returns $true only
+# when the package is actually present afterwards.
 #
 # Success is judged from the FILESYSTEM, not $p.ExitCode: a Start-Process -PassThru
 # object reports ExitCode 0 even for a child that exited non-zero (verified — the
@@ -152,23 +153,29 @@ function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry {
     param([string] $Dir, [switch] $NoProxy, [int] $BudgetSeconds)
 
     $proxyVars = 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy'
+    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    $installer = if ($npm) {
+        @{ File = $npm.Source; Args = @('install', '--no-save', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', (Get-CopilotPkg)) }
+    } else {
+        @{ File = 'bun'; Args = @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') }
+    }
     $saved = @{}
     if ($NoProxy) {
         foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
     }
     try {
-        $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') `
+        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $installer.File -ArgumentList $installer.Args `
             -WorkingDirectory $Dir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
         if ($p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) { return (Test-CopilotPkgPresent) }
         Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
-        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the cache lock.
+        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the install lock.
         $name = [regex]::Escape((Get-CopilotPkgName))
-        Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
-            Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '\badd\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
+        Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
+            Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'bun.exe', 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match '\b(add|install)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
             ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
         return $false
     } catch {
-        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch 'bun add' ($_)"; return $false
+        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch package installer ($_)"; return $false
     } finally {
         if ($NoProxy) {
             foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { if ($null -ne $saved[$v]) { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] } }

+# The full live catalog is the source of truth for raw ids, Claude aliases and
+# context limits. Callers that need several views fetch it once and pass it on.
+function script:Get-CopilotModelCatalog {
+    try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop }
+    catch { $null }
+}
+
+function script:Get-CopilotCatalogIds {
+    param($Catalog)
+    if (-not $Catalog) { return @() }
+    @($Catalog.data | ForEach-Object { $_.id } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
+}
+
+function script:Remove-CopilotContextHint {
+    param([string] $Model)
+    $Model -replace '\[1m\]$', ''
+}
+
+# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
+# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
+# stored suffix but do not invent one.
+function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
+    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
+    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
+    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
+    if ($Catalog) {
+        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
+        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
+        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
+        return $raw
+    }
+    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
+    $raw
+}
+
+function script:Select-CopilotFirstServed {
+    param([string[]] $Model, [string[]] $Candidate)
+    foreach ($c in $Candidate) { if ($Model -contains $c) { return $c } }
+    $null
+}
+
+# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
+# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
+# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
+function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
+    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
+    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
+    $models = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $Catalog
+    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
+    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
+
+    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
+    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
+        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
+        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
+        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
+
+        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
+            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
+        )
+        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
+        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
+
+        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
+            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
+        )
+        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
+        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
+
+        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
+        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
+        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
+    }
+    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
+        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
+        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
+        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
+        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
+    }
+
+    [ordered]@{
+        main   = $main
+        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
+        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
+        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
+        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
+    }
+}
+

+    Write-Host ("  opus   : {0}" -f $ModelProfile.opus)
+    Write-Host ("  sonnet : {0}" -f $ModelProfile.sonnet)
+    Write-Host ("  haiku  : {0}" -f $ModelProfile.haiku)

1	# Codex status line
2	
3	The Windows profile uses Codex's built-in TUI footer. Chezmoi enforces only
4	this list and preserves all unrelated live TOML, including providers, project
5	trust, plugins, feature flags, and nested keymaps:
6	
7	```toml
8	[tui]
9	status_line = [
10	  "model-with-reasoning",
11	  "fast-mode",
12	  "git-branch",
13	  "context-remaining",
14	  "task-progress",
15	  "current-dir",
16	]
17	```
18	
19	The modifier fails closed: malformed live TOML is left unchanged. The file is
20	deployed only when **Install coding agents** is enabled.
21	
22	Use `/status` as the routing proof. A `codex-copilot` session should show the
23	localhost provider even though the Account line can still show the logged-in
24	ChatGPT account. The managed footer omits `five-hour-limit` and `weekly-limit`
25	because those may remain ChatGPT-account counters while inference uses Copilot.
26	
27	No Claude-HUD-style extension is installed. Stock Codex accepts only fixed
28	built-in item IDs, while `@jiawang1209/codex-hud` patches and compiles an older
29	Codex tree and adds a PATH shim. The maintenance and supply-chain cost is too
30	high for a footer.
31	
32	`codex_apps` is a separate remote ChatGPT MCP at
33	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, not an Apple Silicon Desktop bridge.
34	Use `copilot-proxy doctor --live` to compare its direct and HTTP-proxy routes.
35	
36	See [copilot-proxy](copilot-proxy.md) and the
37	[Codex config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference).
38
```

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	A native PowerShell port of the `copilot-proxy` tool series. It runs the
4	[`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jeffreycao/copilot-api)
5	fork so a **GitHub Copilot subscription** can back **Claude Code** and other
6	Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible clients.
7	
8	The module is deployed to `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot` and imported by
9	the PowerShell profile. It requires Bun, Node/npm and a Copilot subscription.
10	
11	## Commands
12	
13	| Command | What it does |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | one-time GitHub device login (stores a token) |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | manage the local proxy (port 4141) |
17	| `copilot-proxy status` | show raw served count and Claude availability |
18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | diagnose package, auth, proxy, catalog, roles, upstream and Codex Apps |
19	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | tail the proxy log |
20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | toggle the throttle shim (port 4142) |
21	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | account / plan / quota |
22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | wipe and reinstall the pinned package |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | run a command with the proxy env injected |
24	| `claude-copilot` | one-off Claude Code session on the proxy |
25	| `claude-copilot-once` | pin this project, run once, then restore it |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | zero-persistence Codex session on the Responses proxy |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | sticky project pin in `.claude/settings.local.json` |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | switch or inspect the complete role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | embed text through `/v1/embeddings` |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | semantic search over local text |
31	
32	## Quick start
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # once
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # select from the live catalog
38	copilot-model -c                   # inspect Main/Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
39	copilot-here on                    # sticky project; or use claude-copilot-once
40	codex-copilot                     # Codex; live OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	Existing global and project pins are deliberately not migrated by `chezmoi
44	apply`. Run `copilot-model --auto` once after this upgrade. When `copilot-here`
45	is active, that command refreshes the local role set; otherwise it updates the
46	global one-line main-model state.
47	
48	## How routing works
49	
50	```text
51	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
52	                                          | Claude: native Messages path
53	                                          | GPT: Anthropic -> Responses translation
54	                                          v
55	                                  GitHub Copilot API
56	```
57	
58	The default package is `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`. For GPT ids it translates
59	Claude Code requests to Responses, including `output_config.effort` to
60	`reasoning.effort`. This is required for GPT-5.6 and Claude Code's `ultracode`
61	effort setting; the old `1.13.14` path could replace the requested effort with a
62	hard-coded fallback.
63	
64	The package is installed once under `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`. Windows
65	uses `npm.cmd` first because it understands the Azure Artifacts credential
66	provider in `~/.npmrc`; Bun remains the fallback/runtime. A package-version stamp
67	makes the 2.1.0 bump reinstall automatically. Warm starts do no package network
68	work.
69	
70	## Model selection and role profile
71	
72	`copilot-model --auto` requires the live `/v1/models` catalog. It prefers served
73	Claude families (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`), then ranks OpenAI by capability:
74	
75	```text
76	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
77	```
78	
79	Luna follows the older flagships because it is the lightweight tier. This role
80	intent follows OpenAI's [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model).
81	For the normal Claude-less Copilot catalog, the generated profile is:
82	
83	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
84	|---|---|
85	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
86	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
87	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
88	
89	A manually selected OpenAI main remains Main/Fable/Opus; Terra and Luna are used
90	for the lower roles when served. Missing tiers fall back to the selected main,
91	never to an unserved hard-coded id. Native Claude profiles select the strongest
92	served model in each Claude family.
93	
94	The `[1m]` suffix is a Claude Code-only context hint. It is derived from each
95	model's live `max_context_window_tokens` metadata when the value is at least one
96	million. Raw API clients must use the plain id. Offline manual discovery remains
97	available, but offline `--auto` refuses to write a potentially stale pin.
98	
99	Both `copilot-run` and `copilot-here on` inject the same variables:
100	
101	```text
102	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
103	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
104	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
105	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
106	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
107	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
108	```
109	
110	`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is intentionally left unset so workflow/frontmatter
111	routing remains authoritative. Restart Claude Code after changing the profile.
112	
113	## Claude Code feature compatibility
114	
115	The useful boundary is local orchestration versus Anthropic cloud services:
116	
117	| Feature | Through Copilot + GPT | Notes |
118	|---|---|---|
119	| CLI, tools, hooks, skills, memory, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing | Yes | Local Claude Code features; GPT behavior may differ after prompt/tool translation. |
120	| Subagents and dynamic workflows | Yes | Role variables are provided without overriding workflow-specific subagent routing. See [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows). |
121	| `ultracode` | Yes on 2.1.0 | It is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflows, not a separate model. |
122	| Thinking/reasoning | Translated | GPT uses Responses reasoning rather than Anthropic-native thinking semantics. |
123	| Web search, fast/auto mode, MCP tool search | Provider-dependent | Availability depends on the Copilot endpoint and gateway translation. |
124	| Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome, cloud Code Review, routines, web/mobile/Slack sessions | No | These require Claude.ai authentication/cloud identity; a local API gateway cannot provide it. |
125	
126	See Claude Code's [feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability),
127	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
128	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol), and
129	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview) references.
130	
131	## Network, entitlement and diagnostics
132	
133	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` reads the Windows System Proxy or an explicit proxy
134	  environment variable, scopes it to the child and passes `--proxy-env`. Node
135	  otherwise ignores the WinINET system setting.
136	- The model catalog is fetched once at proxy startup. `COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT`
137	  defaults to 45 seconds because a Clash/mihomo hop can make that refresh exceed
138	  the old 20-second budget.
139	- GitHub can vary the catalog by account, organization policy, rollout and egress.
140	  No Claude models is therefore a warning when a served OpenAI fallback exists;
141	  it is not by itself a broken proxy.
142	- `copilot-proxy doctor` compares direct and proxied upstream catalogs, validates
143	  the main model plus every role alias, and reports stale local pins. `--live`
144	  also compares direct/proxied reachability of remote ChatGPT `codex_apps`, then
145	  sends one real inference request. Only the latter consumes quota; timeout and
146	  TLS failures are reported separately.
147	- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`, never
148	  committed project settings. `off` removes every env key owned by the helper and
149	  preserves unrelated settings.
150	- `claude-copilot` and `claude-copilot-once` retain the Windows port's trusted
151	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and optional SpecStory behavior. Plain `claude`
152	  is unaffected.
153	- The throttle shim remains byte-identical to the macOS/Linux copy and retries
154	  403/429 bursts while limiting concurrent requests.
155	
156	State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; the GitHub token is stored at
157	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`.
158	
159	## Codex through the gateway
160	
161	`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
162	gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
163	Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
164	`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
165	catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
166	Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
167	embedding models are excluded.
168	
169	This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
170	remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
171	
172	SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
173	`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
174	provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
175	Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
176	`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
177	The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
178	`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
179	later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
180	
181	`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
182	Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
183	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
184	Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
185	`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
186	
187	There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
188	`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
189	auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
190	changing the user-wide default.
191	
192	### Experimental direct configuration
193	
194	The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
195	macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
196	the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
197	returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
198	the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
199	therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.
200

The baseline body is `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (identity from the existing `.name`/`.email` init prompts); the merge engine is `scripts/gitconfig-merge.ps1`, inlined via `{{ include }}` (the `editors/` idiom) and dot-sourced by `tests/GitConfig.Tests.ps1`. The model is **key-level pull-through**: the baseline owns a fixed set of `section.key` pairs and every other live key is carried over untouched — the inverse of the parent repo's allowlist, which would silently drop `[otel]` and future corp sections. Two hard rules: `core.hooksPath` is **never** emitted (git honours it *instead of* `.git/hooks/`, silently disarming `pre-commit`), and the carry dictionary is **case-sensitive** (`[ordered]@{}` collapses `azrepos:org/O365Exchange` into `azrepos:org/o365exchange`, merging two credential contexts).

--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/codex-status-line.md
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+# Codex status line
+
+The Windows profile uses Codex's built-in TUI footer. Chezmoi enforces only
+this list and preserves all unrelated live TOML, including providers, project
+trust, plugins, feature flags, and nested keymaps:
+
+```toml
+[tui]
+status_line = [
+  "model-with-reasoning",
+  "fast-mode",
+  "git-branch",
+  "context-remaining",
+  "task-progress",
+  "current-dir",
+]
+```
+
+The modifier fails closed: malformed live TOML is left unchanged. The file is
+deployed only when **Install coding agents** is enabled.
+
+Use `/status` as the routing proof. A `codex-copilot` session should show the
+localhost provider even though the Account line can still show the logged-in
+ChatGPT account. The managed footer omits `five-hour-limit` and `weekly-limit`
+because those may remain ChatGPT-account counters while inference uses Copilot.
+
+No Claude-HUD-style extension is installed. Stock Codex accepts only fixed
+built-in item IDs, while `@jiawang1209/codex-hud` patches and compiles an older
+Codex tree and adds a PATH shim. The maintenance and supply-chain cost is too
+high for a footer.
+
+`codex_apps` is a separate remote ChatGPT MCP at
+`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, not an Apple Silicon Desktop bridge.
+Use `copilot-proxy doctor --live` to compare its direct and HTTP-proxy routes.
+
+See [copilot-proxy](copilot-proxy.md) and the
+[Codex config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference).

 `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`.
+
+## Codex through the gateway
+
+`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
+gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
+Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
+`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
+catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
+Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
+embedding models are excluded.
+
+This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
+remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
+
+SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
+`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
+provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
+Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
+`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
+The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
+`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
+later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
+
+`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
+Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
+`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
+Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
+`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
+
+There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
+`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
+auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
+changing the user-wide default.
+
+### Experimental direct configuration
+
+The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
+macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
+the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
+returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
+the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
+therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.

The reported sequence confirms a concrete installer bug rather than merely stale state: the npm child prints ETARGET, yet the same `Install-CopilotPkg` call continues into server launch and writes a successful-looking 2.1.0 stamp because success is judged only by whether any matching package tree/bin exists after npm exits. The 402 is a separate runtime entitlement failure: `/v1/models` advertising Claude proves catalog visibility, not that inference billing is enabled, and the current doctor treats the first alphabetically returned chat ID as a representative health probe.

accb173c (Da-Wei Lee 2026-07-27 14:28:40 +0800 221)     }
accb173c (Da-Wei Lee 2026-07-27 14:28:40 +0800 222)

10	# file clobbers all of that on every `chezmoi apply`, which can re-trigger

15	# MERGE MODEL — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
16	#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
17	#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.

21	#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins).
22	#   - FORCED single keys are re-asserted INTO a pulled-through table, so the table
23	#     keeps herdr's own bookkeeping. Windows needs exactly one: update.channel
24	#     must stay "preview" (the installer rejects "stable" on Windows builds), but

30	# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees >=3.11 -> stdlib tomllib), fall back to
31	# system python, then to emitting the raw template (a fresh host with neither
32	# still gets a full config — note we emit the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a
33	# fresh host stdin is empty).

35	# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
36	# Validate the result with `herdr server reload-config` (empty diagnostics).

96

99	        fh.write(text)

101	
102	try:
103	    import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
104	except ModuleNotFoundError:
105	    try:
106	        import tomli as tomllib
107	    except ModuleNotFoundError:
108	        # No TOML reader -> can't safely merge; ship the managed template as-is.
109	        emit(template_text)

123	# Tables the template owns outright.
124	MANAGED = {"theme", "ui", "terminal", "keys"}
125	# Single keys re-asserted into an otherwise pulled-through table.

144	        # let the template win only on the keys it actually sets.
145	        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(doc[key], dict):
146	            for sub_key, sub_value in value.items():
147	                if sub_key not in doc[key]:
148	                    doc[key][sub_key] = sub_value
149	        continue

23711	28	## Root cause
23712	29	
23713	30	Two things compound:
23714	31	
23715	32	1. **Bun does not use the corp npm registry.** `Resolving dependencies` /
23716	33	   `Resolved, downloaded and extracted [N]` / `error: ConnectionRefused` is
23717	34	   **Bun's** output format, not npm's. Bun reaches for `registry.npmjs.org`,
23718	35	   which the corp network blocks, hence `ConnectionRefused`. npm, by contrast,
23719	36	   honours the `registry=` line in `~/.npmrc` (and the machine-level npmrc), so
23720	37	   the same package resolves instantly.
23721	38	2. **The deployed module was stale.** `Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry` prefers npm
23722	39	   when `npm.cmd` is on PATH and only falls back to Bun otherwise — but that
23723	40	   npm branch was added in commit `5351411`. The copy at
23724	41	   `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1` still had the
23725	42	   **Bun-only** version, because `chezmoi apply` had not been run since. The
23726	43	   source tree was correct; the deployed file was not.
23727	44

23729	46	your source tree". `chezmoi status` had been flagging it the whole time:

23747	64	(scoop/winget/npm), which can take many minutes; target the single file when
23748	65	you only need the module refreshed.

## Version and release information

- The supplied page contains no concrete references to versions **2.1.0, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.1.3, or 2.1.4**.
- It shows the `dev` branch, a tags link, and a GitHub Releases link, but provides no tag names, release dates, or release notes for that range.
- The npm package referenced is `@jeffreycao/copilot-api`; the page does not expose a specific package version.

## Installation

- Quick start uses `"npx @jeffreycao/copilot-api@latest start"`.
- The default server address is `http://localhost:4141`.
- Source installation requires Bun version 1.2 or newer and uses `"bun install"`.
- Source commands are `"bun run dev start"` for development and `"bun run start start"` for production.
- Node.js 22.13 or newer is required for token-usage storage when using `npx`; Bun can provide that storage on older Node installations.
- Docker usage maps host data to `/root/.local/share/copilot-api` so authentication and provider configuration persist.

## Model routing behavior

- The gateway exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible interfaces from one local server.
- Provider aliases use the `provider/model` form. The gateway removes the provider prefix before forwarding the request upstream.
- Configured providers may use `anthropic`, `openai-compatible`, or `openai-responses` protocols.
- Top-level routing supports `/v1/messages`, `/v1/messages/count_tokens`, `/v1/responses`, and `/v1/chat/completions`; provider-scoped routes use a `/:provider/` prefix.
- Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible providers use a Responses-to-Messages adapter for `/v1/responses`; OpenAI-compatible providers then translate Messages traffic to Chat Completions.
- Claude-family Copilot models use the native Messages API when supported and when `useMessagesApi` is enabled.
- `modelMappings` can rewrite an incoming model name to another model or provider alias before provider selection.
- Codex-compatible model listings merge native Codex models with adaptable provider models; adaptable entries advertise Responses Lite support.
- Claude Code should use plain model names with `modelMappings` for Codex routing, because the page warns that a `codex/` prefix triggers degraded client behavior.
```
</details></tool-use>

+
+## Codex through the gateway
+
+`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
+gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
+Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
+`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
+catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
+Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
+embedding models are excluded.
+
+This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
+remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
+
+SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
+`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
+provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
+Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
+`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
+The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
+`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
+later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
+
+`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
+Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
+`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
+Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
+`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
+
+There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
+`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
+auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
+changing the user-wide default.
+
+### Experimental direct configuration
+
+The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
+macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
+the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
+returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
+the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
+therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.

# Pester tests for the Copilot module. Runtime behaviour (proxy start, live
# HTTP) can't be exercised without Windows + copilot-api, so these cover the
# pure logic: package-flavor detection, model resolution/normalisation, served-
# model parsing, and the effective-model precedence — with HTTP mocked.

BeforeAll {
    $ModulePath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..' 'dot_config' 'powershell' 'modules' 'Copilot' 'Copilot.psd1'
    Import-Module $ModulePath -Force
}

Describe 'Copilot module' {

    Context 'package flavor detection' {
        It 'treats the bare original package as "original"' {
            InModuleScope Copilot { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = 'copilot-api@0.7.0'; Get-CopilotPkgFlavor | Should -Be 'original' }
        }
        It 'treats the scoped fork as "fork"' {
            InModuleScope Copilot { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0'; Get-CopilotPkgFlavor | Should -Be 'fork' }
        }
        AfterEach { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = $null }
    }

    Context 'default model resolution' {
        It 'falls back to the built-in default' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL = $null
                Mock Get-CopilotModelState { Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) 'does-not-exist-copilot-model' }
                Get-CopilotDefaultModel | Should -Be 'gpt-5.6-sol[1m]'
            }
        }
        It 'honors $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL = 'claude-sonnet-5'
                Get-CopilotDefaultModel | Should -Be 'claude-sonnet-5'
                $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL = $null
            }
        }
    }

    Context 'package name parsing (the scoped-spec trap)' {
        # A naive "split on @" empties a scoped spec that carries no version,
        # which would degrade the stale-installer reap pattern to `bun add.*`
        # and match every bun install on the box.
        It 'keeps the @scope while stripping the version' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0'
                Get-CopilotPkgName | Should -Be '@jeffreycao/copilot-api'
            }
        }
        It 'returns a scoped spec with no version unchanged' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = '@jeffreycao/copilot-api'
                Get-CopilotPkgName | Should -Be '@jeffreycao/copilot-api'
            }
        }
        It 'strips the version from an unscoped spec' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = 'copilot-api@0.7.0'
                Get-CopilotPkgName | Should -Be 'copilot-api'
            }
        }
        AfterEach { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG = $null }
    }

    Context 'best-model picker (--auto)' {

                    Should -Be 'claude-fable-5'

        }

        }
        It 'keeps older flagship and coding models ahead of lightweight models' {

                $script:authArgs = @()

                Mock Get-CopilotPkgFlavor { 'fork' }

            InModuleScope Copilot {

                Get-CopilotHereDrift | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
            }
        }

            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
                $want.ANTHROPIC_MODEL = 'claude-opus-4-8[1m]'
                @{ env = $want } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content '.claude/settings.local.json'
                $drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift
                $drift | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty
                ($drift -join "`n") | Should -Match 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL : claude-opus-4-8\[1m\] ->'
            }
        }
        It 'catches keys missing from an older pin (the 4-of-8 bug)' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {
                $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
                $partial = [ordered]@{}
                foreach ($k in 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL', 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL') {
                    $partial[$k] = $want[$k]
                }
                @{ env = $partial } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content '.claude/settings.local.json'
                ($drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift) | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty
                ($drift -join "`n") | Should -Match 'ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL : \(unset\) ->'
            }

        It 'reads an uncommented double-quoted claude_cmd' {

            }

        It 'ignores the commented example that ships in the default config' {
            InModuleScope Copilot {

                # the very bug the resolver exists to fix, so it must be skipped and
                # the real assignment below it used instead.

        It 'reads a single-quoted claude_cmd' {

```text
## “Manage part, but not all, of a file”

- **Input:** A `modify_` script receives the file’s current contents through stdin. The documentation says: “A `modify_` script receives the current contents of the file on the standard input”.
- **Output:** chezmoi uses the script’s stdout as the resulting target file: “chezmoi reads the target contents of the file from the script's standard output.”
- **Missing target:** When no target exists, stdin is empty: “If the file does not exist then the standard input to the `modify_` script will be empty”. The script must then emit the entire file.
- **Existing empty target:** The page gives no separate rule, but an empty file’s current contents mean empty stdin. Unlike the missing-file case, the documentation does not explicitly impose a complete-file requirement.
- **Modify templates:** A script containing `chezmoi:modify-template` has those marker lines removed; “the rest of the file will be interpreted as a template.” Its input is available as `.chezmoi.stdin`, and “the result of the template execution becomes the new contents of the file.”
- **Extension restriction:** “Modify templates **must not** have a `.tmpl` extension.”
```

- **Symptom:** `kimi` fails during startup with: “Invalid TOML in configuration file ~/.kimi/config.toml: Empty key at line 1 col 0”
- **Parser:** Yes. The failure occurs when `tomlkit.loads()` processes text beginning with the UTF-8 BOM (`\ufeff`).
- **Normalization fix:** After reading the file as UTF-8, remove one leading `\ufeff` if present, then pass the normalized text to `tomlkit.loads()`. The page describes this as a proposed fix.

# Copilot.psm1 — GitHub Copilot -> Anthropic proxy for Claude Code, native
# PowerShell port of the POSIX 43_copilot_proxy.sh / 44_copilot_embed.sh.
#
# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (npm @jeffreycao/copilot-api) via `bunx`
# so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code. The optional Bun
# throttle shim (copilot-throttle-shim.js) is reused verbatim from the unix side.
#
# Public commands (exported with their original hyphenated names for muscle
# memory — PSUseApprovedVerbs is intentionally waived):
#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]
#   copilot-run <cmd...>            run a command with the proxy env injected
#   claude-copilot [args...]        one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
#   claude-copilot-once [args...]   pinned one-shot session, auto-reverted
# (claude-copilot / -once run claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions — the
#  proxy flow is the trusted, hands-off path; plain `claude` is unaffected.)
#   copilot-here [on|off|status]    per-project pin via ./.claude/settings.local.json
#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]  switch the pinned model
#   copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT|-] | -l
#   semsearch index [PATH...] | semsearch <QUERY> [-k N] [--corpus PATH]
#
# Contract preserved from the unix version: token at
