710	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
711	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
712	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
713	                    }
714	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
715	                    return
716	                }
717	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
718	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
719	                if ($p.HasExited) {
720	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
721	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
722	                }
723	                Start-Sleep 1
724	            }
725	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
726	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
727	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
728	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
729	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
730	        }
731	        'stop' {
732	            Stop-CopilotShim
733	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
734	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
735	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
736	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
737	            }
738	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
739	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
740	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
741	            Start-Sleep 1
742	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
743	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
744	        }
745	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
746	        'status' {
747	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
748	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
749	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
750	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
751	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
752	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
753	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
754	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
755	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
756	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
757	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
758	            } else {
759	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
760	            }
761	        }
762	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
763	        'logs' {
764	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
765	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
766	            } else {
767	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
768	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
769	            }
770	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
771	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
772	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
773	        }
774	        'auth' {
775	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
776	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
777	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
778	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth --provider copilot }
779	        }
780	        'reinstall' {
781	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
782	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
783	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
784	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
785	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
786	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $(Get-CopilotPkg) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
787	        }
788	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
789	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
790	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
791	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
792	            }
793	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
794	                try {
795	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
796	                    [pscustomobject]@{
797	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
798	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
799	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
800	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
801	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
802	            } else {
803	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
804	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
805	            }
806	        }
807	        'shim' {
808	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
809	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
810	            switch ($sub) {
811	                'on' {
812	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
813	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
814	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
815	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
816	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
817	                }
818	                'off' {
819	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
820	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
821	                }
822	                default {
823	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
824	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
825	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
826	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
827	                }
828	            }
829	        }
830	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
831	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
832	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
833	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
834	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
835	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
836	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
837	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
838	        }
839	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
840	    }
841	}
842	
843	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
844	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
845	    param([switch] $Live)
846	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
847	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
848	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
849	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
850	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
851	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
852	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
853	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
854	
855	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
856	
857	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
858	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
859	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
860	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
861	    }
862	
863	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
864	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
865	    # network at all. An un-installed prefix is not a fault: the next start installs it.
866	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
867	        OK 'installed' $pkg
868	        $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
869	        if ($launch) {
870	            $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()
871	            if ($launch.Cwd) { $how += "   (cwd: $($launch.Cwd))" }
872	            SKIP 'runs via' $how
873	        } else { BAD 'runs via' 'no runnable binary'; HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall' }
874	    } else {
875	        NOTE 'not installed' "$pkg — the next 'copilot-proxy start' installs it (one-time)"
876	        HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now'
877	    }
878	
879	    Write-Host "`nAuthentication"
880	    if (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken)) { OK 'token file' (Get-CopilotToken) } else { BAD 'token file' 'absent'; HINT 'copilot-proxy auth' }
881	
882	    Write-Host "`nProxy"
883	    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { OK 'listening' (Get-CopilotBase) } else { BAD 'listening' "nothing on port $port"; HINT 'copilot-proxy start' }
884	    # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds the
885	    # port: `start` just says "did not come up in time" and the log shows only
886	    # "Resolving dependencies". Hard failure when nothing is listening (that IS the
887	    # fault), softer when the proxy is up (a leftover still holding bun's cache lock,
888	    # which will hang the next restart).
889	    $stale = @(Get-CopilotStaleInstaller)
890	    if ($stale.Count -gt 0) {
891	        if (Test-CopilotAlive) { NOTE 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)" }
892	        else { BAD 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at `"Resolving dependencies`", never binds port $port" }
893	        HINT "kill just those: Stop-Process -Id $($stale.ProcessId -join ',') -Force"
894	        HINT 'then: copilot-proxy reinstall'
895	        HINT 're-hangs? bun is stalling on the proxy — $env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1; copilot-proxy reinstall'
896	    } else {
897	        SKIP 'installer' "no wedged 'bun add' process"
898	    }
899	    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
900	        if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { OK 'throttle shim' "up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)" } else { BAD 'throttle shim' 'enabled but DOWN'; HINT 'copilot-proxy shim on' }
901	    } else { SKIP 'throttle shim' 'off' }
902	
903	    Write-Host "`nModels"
904	    $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
905	    $proxyMode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
906	    if ($httpProxy) { NOTE 'http proxy' "$httpProxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this" }
907	    else { SKIP 'http proxy' "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode)" }
908	
909	    # A/B: true-direct vs via the local proxy. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog
910	    # on some egress, and .NET/curl follow the System Proxy by default — so a single
911	    # "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as an entitlement problem.
912	    $dirClaude = 0; $viaClaude = 0; $anyUpstream = $false
913	    $upDirect = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via 'direct'
914	    if ($upDirect) {
915	        $anyUpstream = $true
916	        $dirClaude = @($upDirect | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
917	        OK 'upstream direct' "$($upDirect.Count) ids, $dirClaude claude (no proxy)"
918	    } else {
919	        SKIP 'upstream direct' 'could not query GitHub direct (need a token, or blocked)'
920	    }
921	    if ($httpProxy) {
922	        $upVia = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via $httpProxy
923	        if ($upVia) {
924	            $anyUpstream = $true
925	            $viaClaude = @($upVia | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
926	            OK 'upstream via proxy' "$($upVia.Count) ids, $viaClaude claude ($httpProxy)"
927	        } else {
928	            BAD 'upstream via proxy' "no response through $httpProxy"
929	            HINT 'the Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another selection'
930	        }
931	    }
932	
933	    $served = Get-CopilotServedModels
934	    if ($served -and $served.Count -gt 0) {
935	        $claude = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' })
936	        OK 'served' "$($served.Count) model ids"
937	        if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { OK 'claude models' "$($claude.Count) ids available" }
938	        else { NOTE 'claude models' "0 of $($served.Count) — Anthropic unavailable; role-aware OpenAI fallback will be used" }
939	
940	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0) {
941	            NOTE 'egress geo' 'Claude appears ONLY via the local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct egress'
942	            if ($claude.Count -eq 0) {
943	                BAD 'MISSING --proxy-env' 'copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog'
944	                HINT 'copilot-proxy restart   # auto attaches --proxy-env when a proxy is detected'
945	                HINT '$env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7897"; copilot-proxy restart'
946	            }
947	        } elseif ($viaClaude -eq 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0 -and $anyUpstream) {
948	            NOTE 'entitlement' 'neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude'
949	            HINT 'org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help'
950	        } elseif ($claude.Count -eq 0 -and $viaClaude -gt 0) {
951	            BAD 'STALE CACHE' 'via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not'
952	            HINT 'copilot-proxy restart'
953	        } elseif ($claude.Count -gt 0) {
954	            OK 'cache' 'the served Claude list looks healthy'
955	        }
956	
957	        $pin = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
958	        $model = $pin[0]; $src = $pin[1]
959	        if ($served -contains $model) { OK 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)" }
960	        else {
961	            BAD 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)"
962	            HINT 'not served -> requests return 400 model_not_supported'
963	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # Claude; else capability-ranked OpenAI, then Gemini'
964	            HINT 'copilot-model -l       # list served ids'
965	        }
966	
967	        # Validate every alias Claude Code may select for background/subagent
968	        # work. A stale Sonnet/Haiku id can fail with 400 while main chat works.
969	        $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
970	        $modelProfile = $null
971	        if (Test-Path $settings) {
972	            try {
973	                $localEnv = (Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env
974	                if ($localEnv.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
975	                    $modelProfile = [ordered]@{
976	                        main   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
977	                        fable  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
978	                        opus   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
979	                        sonnet = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
980	                        haiku  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
981	                    }
982	                }
983	            } catch { $modelProfile = $null }
984	        }
985	        if (-not $modelProfile) {
986	            $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
987	            $modelProfile = Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $model -Catalog $catalog
988	        }
989	        $roleBad = $false
990	        foreach ($role in 'fable', 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku') {
991	            $roleModel = $modelProfile[$role]
992	            if (-not $roleModel) {
993	                BAD "role $role" 'unset — Claude Code may choose its native default and get model_not_supported'
994	                $roleBad = $true
995	            }
996	            elseif ($served -notcontains $roleModel) {
997	                BAD "role $role" "$roleModel is not served"
998	                $roleBad = $true
999	            }
1000	        }
1001	        if (-not $roleBad) {
1002	            OK 'model roles' "fable=$($modelProfile.fable), opus=$($modelProfile.opus), sonnet=$($modelProfile.sonnet), haiku=$($modelProfile.haiku)"
1003	        } else {
1004	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # rewrite main + every Claude Code role alias'
1005	        }
1006	    } else {
1007	        BAD 'served' "could not fetch $(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models"
1008	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0) { HINT 'start with the proxy: copilot-proxy start   # attaches --proxy-env automatically' }
1009	    }
1010	
1011	    Write-Host "`nUpstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
1012	    foreach ($h in 'api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com', 'api.githubcopilot.com') {
1013	        try {
1014	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1015	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://$h/models" -TimeoutSec 12 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1016	            $sw.Stop()
1017	            OK $h "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
1018	        } catch { BAD $h 'no response within 12s'; HINT 'connection blocked or upstream unreachable' }
1019	    }
1020	    SKIP '' 'HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)'
1021	
1022	    Write-Host "`nCodex Apps (ChatGPT MCP)"
1023	    $appsUri = 'https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps'
1024	    SKIP 'route' "$appsUri — independent of localhost Copilot inference and Codex.app"
1025	    if (-not $Live) {
1026	        SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to compare direct and configured-proxy reachability'
1027	    } else {
1028	        $appsDirect = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via 'direct'
1029	        if ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1030	            OK 'direct' "HTTP $($appsDirect.Code) in $($appsDirect.Seconds)s (an auth rejection still proves reachability)"
1031	        } else {
1032	            NOTE 'direct' "$($appsDirect.Kind) failure after $($appsDirect.Seconds)s"
1033	            if ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'tls') { HINT 'inspect antivirus/corporate TLS interception and the Windows trust store' }
1034	            elseif ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'timeout') { HINT 'the ChatGPT Apps route is blocked or not entering the expected TUN path' }
1035	        }
1036	
1037	        if ($httpProxy) {
1038	            $appsVia = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via $httpProxy
1039	            if ($appsVia.Reached) {
1040	                OK 'via proxy' "HTTP $($appsVia.Code) in $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1041	                if (-not $appsDirect.Reached) {
1042	                    HINT "Codex Apps needs this route; launch Codex with HTTPS_PROXY=$httpProxy or repair TUN routing"
1043	                }
1044	            } elseif ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1045	                SKIP 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure — direct already works, so Apps need no explicit proxy"
1046	            } else {
1047	                NOTE 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure after $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1048	                HINT 'this does not invalidate GitHub Copilot inference; it only explains codex_apps startup failures'
1049	            }
1050	        } else {
1051	            SKIP 'via proxy' 'no explicit/system HTTP proxy detected; TUN may still carry direct traffic'
1052	        }
1053	    }
1054	
1055	    Write-Host "`nLive probe"
1056	    if (-not $Live) { SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)' }
1057	    elseif (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { SKIP 'skipped' 'proxy is not running' }
1058	    elseif (-not $served) { SKIP 'skipped' 'no served model to probe with' }
1059	    else {
1060	        $pm = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'embedding' -and $_ -notmatch '\[1m\]' })[0]
1061	        $body = @{ model = $pm; max_tokens = 1; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'hi' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
1062	        try {
1063	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1064	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotClientBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `
1065	                -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1066	            $sw.Stop()
1067	            if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300) { OK 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s" }
1068	            else { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode)"; HINT 'copilot-proxy logs 40' }
1069	        } catch { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> request failed ($_)" }
1070	    }
1071	
1072	    Write-Host ''
1073	    if ($script:fail -gt 0) { Write-Host "$($script:fail) failed, $($script:warn) warning(s)`n"; return }
1074	    Write-Host "all checks passed ($($script:warn) warning(s))`n"
1075	}
1076	
1077	# ------------------------------------------------------------- copilot-run ----
1078	function copilot-run {
1079	    [CmdletBinding()]
1080	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1081	    if (-not $Argv -or $Argv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]'; return }
1082	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1083	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) { Start-CopilotShim | Out-Null }
1084	
1085	    # Single source of truth — see Get-CopilotEnvBlock.
1086	    $inject = Get-CopilotEnvBlock
1087	    # Scope env to the child process: set, run, restore (equivalent to `env VAR=..`).
1088	    $saved = @{}
1089	    foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) { $saved[$k] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($k); Set-Item "env:$k" $inject[$k] }
1090	    try {
1091	        $exe = $Argv[0]; $rest = if ($Argv.Count -gt 1) { $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
1092	        & $exe @rest
1093	    } finally {
1094	        foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) {
1095	            if ($null -eq $saved[$k]) { Remove-Item "env:$k" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1096	            else { Set-Item "env:$k" $saved[$k] }
1097	        }
1098	    }
1099	}
1100	
1101	# Codex prefers a native Responses-capable OpenAI model. Claude/Gemini are
1102	# Responses Lite fallbacks only, unlike Select-CopilotBestModel (Claude Code),
1103	# where native Claude remains the first choice.
1104	function script:Select-CopilotBestCodexModel {
1105	    param([string[]] $Model)
1106	    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
1107	    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1108	
1109	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex',
1110	                           'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
1111	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1112	    }
1113	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1114	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1115	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1116	    }
1117	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' 'mini|nano|luna'
1118	    if ($r) { return $r }
1119	    $r = & $pick 'codex' $null

1	#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
2	# chezmoi modify_ script: enforce only Codex's native footer while preserving
3	# every unrelated live setting (providers, projects, plugins, feature flags).
4	# Runs under [interpreters.ps1]. A malformed live file is passed through
5	# unchanged: config recovery must be explicit, never an accidental overwrite.
6	
7	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
8	
9	function Write-StdoutBytes {
10	    param([byte[]] $Bytes)
11	    $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
12	    $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
13	    $out.Flush()
14	}
15	
16	$utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
17	$overlayText = @'
18	{{ include (joinPath .chezmoi.sourceDir ".chezmoitemplates/agents/codex.config.overlay.toml") }}
19	'@
20	$liveText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
21	
22	# Empty input is a fresh install and the overlay itself is already valid TOML.
23	if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($liveText)) {
24	    Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($overlayText)
25	    return
26	}
27	
28	$tmpDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
29	$stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()
30	$overlayFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-overlay-$stamp.toml"
31	$liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-live-$stamp.toml"
32	$pyFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-merge-$stamp.py"
33	$outFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-out-$stamp.toml"
34	
35	try {
36	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($overlayFile, $overlayText, $utf8)
37	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($liveFile, $liveText, $utf8)
38	
39	    $py = $null
40	    if (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
41	        $py = @('uv', 'run', '--no-project', '--quiet', '--with', 'tomlkit', '--python', '>=3.11', 'python')
42	    } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
43	        $py = @('python')
44	    } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
45	        $py = @('python3')
46	    }
47	
48	    if (-not $py) {
49	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('modify_config.toml: no uv/python found; preserving live config unchanged')
50	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($liveText)
51	        return
52	    }
53	
54	    $pySource = @'
55	import os
56	import sys
57	
58	import tomlkit
59	
60	overlay_path = os.environ["CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE"]
61	live_path = os.environ["CODEX_LIVE_FILE"]
62	out_path = os.environ["CODEX_OUT_FILE"]
63	
64	with open(overlay_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
65	    overlay_text = fh.read()
66	with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
67	    live_text = fh.read()
68	
69	try:
70	    live = tomlkit.parse(live_text)
71	    overlay = tomlkit.parse(overlay_text)
72	except Exception as exc:
73	    print(f"modify_config.toml: invalid TOML; preserving live config unchanged: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
74	    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
75	        fh.write(live_text)
76	    sys.exit(0)
77	
78	if "tui" not in live or not isinstance(live["tui"], dict):
79	    live["tui"] = tomlkit.table()
80	live["tui"]["status_line"] = overlay["tui"]["status_line"]
81	
82	with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
83	    fh.write(tomlkit.dumps(live))
84	'@
85	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($pyFile, $pySource, $utf8)
86	
87	    $env:CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE = $overlayFile
88	    $env:CODEX_LIVE_FILE = $liveFile
89	    $env:CODEX_OUT_FILE = $outFile
90	    $exe = $py[0]
91	    $rest = if ($py.Count -gt 1) { @($py[1..($py.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
92	    $rest += $pyFile
93	    & $exe @rest
94	    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
95	
96	    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile)) {
97	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: merge failed (exit $rc); preserving live config unchanged")
98	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($liveText)
99	        return
100	    }
101	
102	    Write-StdoutBytes ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($outFile))
103	} finally {
104	    foreach ($f in $overlayFile, $liveFile, $pyFile, $outFile) {
105	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
106	    }
107	    foreach ($v in 'CODEX_OVERLAY_FILE', 'CODEX_LIVE_FILE', 'CODEX_OUT_FILE') {
108	        Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
109	    }
110	}

1	# Copilot.psm1 — GitHub Copilot agent gateway for Claude Code and Codex, native
2	# PowerShell port of the POSIX 43_copilot_proxy.sh / 44_copilot_embed.sh.
3	#
4	# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (npm @jeffreycao/copilot-api) via `bunx`
5	# so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code and Codex. The optional Bun
6	# throttle shim (copilot-throttle-shim.js) is reused verbatim from the unix side.
7	#
8	# Public commands (exported with their original hyphenated names for muscle
9	# memory — PSUseApprovedVerbs is intentionally waived):
10	#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]
11	#   copilot-run <cmd...>            run a command with the proxy env injected
12	#   claude-copilot [args...]        one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
13	#   claude-copilot-once [args...]   pinned one-shot session, auto-reverted
14	#   codex-copilot [args...]         one-off Codex session on Responses proxy
15	#   codex-copilot-once [args...]    identical zero-persistence alias
16	# (claude-copilot / -once run claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions — the
17	#  proxy flow is the trusted, hands-off path; plain `claude` is unaffected.)
18	#   copilot-here [on|off|status]    per-project pin via ./.claude/settings.local.json
19	#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]  switch the pinned model
20	#   copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT|-] | -l
21	#   semsearch index [PATH...] | semsearch <QUERY> [-k N] [--corpus PATH]
22	#
23	# Contract preserved from the unix version: token at
24	# ~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token, ports 4141 (proxy) / 4142 (shim),
25	# state under $XDG_STATE_HOME/copilot-proxy, per-project ./.claude/settings.local.json
26	# pin, default model gpt-5.6-sol[1m], and the ANTHROPIC_* env block.
27	#
28	# The pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into $XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg and the
29	# proxy runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
30	# bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever resolving
31	# through a socks proxy — which wedged `start` at "Resolving dependencies" AND kept
32	# bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too. Force a re-install with
33	# `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
34	#
35	# Env knobs:
36	#   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default 4141    - port the proxy listens on
37	#   COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT default 45 - seconds allowed for model refresh
38	#   COPILOT_SHIM_PORT    default 4142    - throttle shim port
39	#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0 - spec to install
40	#                                          (changing it re-installs via the stamp)
41	#   COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL                 - override the pinned model
42	#   COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET  1               - add the telemetry-suppressing env keys
43	#   COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY 1            - skip straight to the no-proxy install try
44	#   COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY   default auto    - Node->GitHub /models egress:
45	#                          auto   = use the Windows System Proxy (WinINET registry)
46	#                                   or HTTPS_PROXY when either is set; Node ignores
47	#                                   the system setting unless it is passed the env.
48	#                          always = same, but warn when no proxy is found
49	#                          never  = never pass --proxy-env
50	#                          http://127.0.0.1:PORT = force that URL
51	
52	Set-StrictMode -Off
53	
54	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers ---
55	function script:Get-CopilotPort { if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_PORT) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_PORT } else { '4141' } }
56	function script:Get-CopilotPkg  { if ($env:COPILOT_API_PKG)   { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG }   else { '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' } }
57	function script:Get-CopilotPkgFlavor {
58	    switch -Regex (Get-CopilotPkg) { '^copilot-api(@.*)?$' { 'original' } default { 'fork' } }
59	}
60	function script:Get-CopilotBase    { "http://localhost:$(Get-CopilotPort)" }
61	function script:Get-CopilotTmp     { if ($env:TEMP) { $env:TEMP } else { [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath() } }
62	function script:Get-CopilotLogFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).log" }
63	function script:Get-CopilotPidFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).pid" }
64	function script:Get-CopilotToken   { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share/copilot-api/github_token' }
65	
66	function script:Get-XdgState { if ($env:XDG_STATE_HOME) { $env:XDG_STATE_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/state' } }
67	function script:Get-XdgConfig { if ($env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME) { $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.config' } }
68	function script:Get-XdgData { if ($env:XDG_DATA_HOME) { $env:XDG_DATA_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share' } }
69	
70	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -----------
71	#
72	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
73	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
74	# proxy (a browser/curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
75	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so
76	# every retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and
77	# running the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm
78	# start does zero network before it binds the port.
79	
80	# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
81	# The naive "split on @" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
82	# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
83	function script:Get-CopilotPkgName {
84	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
85	    if ($spec.TrimStart('@') -match '@') { $spec -replace '@[^@]*$', '' } else { $spec }
86	}
87	
88	function script:Get-CopilotPkgPrefix { Join-Path (Get-XdgData) 'copilot-api/pkg' }
89	# Records the spec the prefix currently holds, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the
90	# pinned default) re-installs instead of silently running the old version.
```

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	A native PowerShell port of the `copilot-proxy` tool series. It runs the
4	[`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jeffreycao/copilot-api)
5	fork so a **GitHub Copilot subscription** can back **Claude Code** and other
6	Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible clients.
7	
8	The module is deployed to `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot` and imported by
9	the PowerShell profile. It requires Bun, Node/npm and a Copilot subscription.
10	
11	## Commands
12	
13	| Command | What it does |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | one-time GitHub device login (stores a token) |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | manage the local proxy (port 4141) |
17	| `copilot-proxy status` | show raw served count and Claude availability |
18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | diagnose package, auth, proxy, catalog, roles, upstream and Codex Apps |
19	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | tail the proxy log |
20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | toggle the throttle shim (port 4142) |
21	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | account / plan / quota |
22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | wipe and reinstall the pinned package |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | run a command with the proxy env injected |
24	| `claude-copilot` | one-off Claude Code session on the proxy |
25	| `claude-copilot-once` | pin this project, run once, then restore it |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | zero-persistence Codex session on the Responses proxy |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | sticky project pin in `.claude/settings.local.json` |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | switch or inspect the complete role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | embed text through `/v1/embeddings` |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | semantic search over local text |
31	
32	## Quick start
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # once
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # select from the live catalog
38	copilot-model -c                   # inspect Main/Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
39	copilot-here on                    # sticky project; or use claude-copilot-once
40	codex-copilot                     # Codex; live OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	Existing global and project pins are deliberately not migrated by `chezmoi
44	apply`. Run `copilot-model --auto` once after this upgrade. When `copilot-here`
45	is active, that command refreshes the local role set; otherwise it updates the
46	global one-line main-model state.
47	
48	## How routing works
49	
50	```text
51	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
52	                                          | Claude: native Messages path
53	                                          | GPT: Anthropic -> Responses translation
54	                                          v
55	                                  GitHub Copilot API
56	```
57	
58	The default package is `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`. For GPT ids it translates
59	Claude Code requests to Responses, including `output_config.effort` to
60	`reasoning.effort`. This is required for GPT-5.6 and Claude Code's `ultracode`
61	effort setting; the old `1.13.14` path could replace the requested effort with a
62	hard-coded fallback.
63	
64	The package is installed once under `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`. Windows
65	uses `npm.cmd` first because it understands the Azure Artifacts credential
66	provider in `~/.npmrc`; Bun remains the fallback/runtime. A package-version stamp
67	makes the 2.1.0 bump reinstall automatically. Warm starts do no package network
68	work.
69	
70	## Model selection and role profile
71	
72	`copilot-model --auto` requires the live `/v1/models` catalog. It prefers served
73	Claude families (`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`), then ranks OpenAI by capability:
74	
75	```text
76	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
77	```
78	
79	Luna follows the older flagships because it is the lightweight tier. This role
80	intent follows OpenAI's [current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model).
81	For the normal Claude-less Copilot catalog, the generated profile is:
82	
83	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
84	|---|---|
85	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
86	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
87	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
88	
89	A manually selected OpenAI main remains Main/Fable/Opus; Terra and Luna are used
90	for the lower roles when served. Missing tiers fall back to the selected main,
91	never to an unserved hard-coded id. Native Claude profiles select the strongest
92	served model in each Claude family.
93	
94	The `[1m]` suffix is a Claude Code-only context hint. It is derived from each
95	model's live `max_context_window_tokens` metadata when the value is at least one
96	million. Raw API clients must use the plain id. Offline manual discovery remains
97	available, but offline `--auto` refuses to write a potentially stale pin.
98	
99	Both `copilot-run` and `copilot-here on` inject the same variables:
100	
101	```text
102	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
103	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
104	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
105	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
106	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
107	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
108	```
109	
110	`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is intentionally left unset so workflow/frontmatter
111	routing remains authoritative. Restart Claude Code after changing the profile.
112	
113	## Claude Code feature compatibility
114	
115	The useful boundary is local orchestration versus Anthropic cloud services:
116	
117	| Feature | Through Copilot + GPT | Notes |
118	|---|---|---|
119	| CLI, tools, hooks, skills, memory, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing | Yes | Local Claude Code features; GPT behavior may differ after prompt/tool translation. |
120	| Subagents and dynamic workflows | Yes | Role variables are provided without overriding workflow-specific subagent routing. See [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows). |
121	| `ultracode` | Yes on 2.1.0 | It is xhigh effort plus dynamic workflows, not a separate model. |
122	| Thinking/reasoning | Translated | GPT uses Responses reasoning rather than Anthropic-native thinking semantics. |
123	| Web search, fast/auto mode, MCP tool search | Provider-dependent | Availability depends on the Copilot endpoint and gateway translation. |
124	| Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome, cloud Code Review, routines, web/mobile/Slack sessions | No | These require Claude.ai authentication/cloud identity; a local API gateway cannot provide it. |
125	
126	See Claude Code's [feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability),
127	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
128	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol), and
129	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview) references.
130	
131	## Network, entitlement and diagnostics
132	
133	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` reads the Windows System Proxy or an explicit proxy
134	  environment variable, scopes it to the child and passes `--proxy-env`. Node
135	  otherwise ignores the WinINET system setting.
136	- The model catalog is fetched once at proxy startup. `COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT`
137	  defaults to 45 seconds because a Clash/mihomo hop can make that refresh exceed
138	  the old 20-second budget.
139	- GitHub can vary the catalog by account, organization policy, rollout and egress.
140	  No Claude models is therefore a warning when a served OpenAI fallback exists;
141	  it is not by itself a broken proxy.
142	- `copilot-proxy doctor` compares direct and proxied upstream catalogs, validates
143	  the main model plus every role alias, and reports stale local pins. `--live`
144	  also compares direct/proxied reachability of remote ChatGPT `codex_apps`, then
145	  sends one real inference request. Only the latter consumes quota; timeout and
146	  TLS failures are reported separately.
147	- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`, never
148	  committed project settings. `off` removes every env key owned by the helper and
149	  preserves unrelated settings.
150	- `claude-copilot` and `claude-copilot-once` retain the Windows port's trusted
151	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and optional SpecStory behavior. Plain `claude`
152	  is unaffected.
153	- The throttle shim remains byte-identical to the macOS/Linux copy and retries
154	  403/429 bursts while limiting concurrent requests.
155	
156	State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; the GitHub token is stored at
157	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`.
158	
159	## Codex through the gateway
160	
161	`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
162	gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
163	Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
164	`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
165	catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
166	Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
167	embedding models are excluded.
168	
169	Codex always uses the shim on `localhost:4142`, even when the persisted
170	throttling toggle is off. Besides throttling, that boundary normalizes blank
171	descriptions in Codex `mcp_list_tools` Responses items. GitHub Copilot rejects
172	those with `Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string`, while MCP
173	servers and the native Codex path may omit them. The shim fills only those tool
174	definition fields and leaves prompts, schemas, and tool names unchanged.
175	Codex currently zstd-compresses these requests; the shim decodes only the
176	Responses body it must repair, forwards ordinary JSON, and removes the stale
177	`content-encoding` header.
178	
179	This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
180	remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	`copilot-proxy` 工具系列的原生 PowerShell 版本。它執行
4	[`@jeffreycao/copilot-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jeffreycao/copilot-api)
5	fork，讓 **GitHub Copilot 訂閱**可作為 **Claude Code** 與其他 Anthropic/OpenAI
6	相容 client 的後端。
7	
8	模組部署在 `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`，由 PowerShell profile 自動匯入。
9	需要 Bun、Node/npm 與 Copilot 訂閱。
10	
11	## 指令
12	
13	| 指令 | 作用 |
14	|---|---|
15	| `copilot-proxy auth` | 一次性的 GitHub device 登入（儲存 token） |
16	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | 管理本機 proxy（port 4141） |
17	| `copilot-proxy status` | 顯示 raw served 數量與 Claude 可用性 |
18	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | 診斷套件、認證、proxy、catalog、roles、上游與 Codex Apps |
19	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | 查看 proxy log |
20	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | 切換節流 shim（port 4142） |
21	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | 帳號 / 方案 / 額度 |
22	| `copilot-proxy reinstall` | 清掉並重裝釘選套件 |
23	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | 注入 proxy 環境變數後執行指令 |
24	| `claude-copilot` | 在 proxy 上開一次 Claude Code session |
25	| `claude-copilot-once` | 暫時釘住專案、執行一次、結束後還原 |
26	| `codex-copilot` / `codex-copilot-once` | 零持久化的 Codex Responses proxy session |
27	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | 在 `.claude/settings.local.json` 做 sticky pin |
28	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c\|--auto]` | 切換或檢查完整 role profile |
29	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | 透過 `/v1/embeddings` 產生向量 |
30	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | 對本機文字做語意搜尋 |
31	
32	## 快速開始
33	
34	```powershell
35	copilot-proxy auth                 # 只需一次
36	copilot-proxy start
37	copilot-model --auto              # 從 live catalog 選模型
38	copilot-model -c                   # 查看 Main/Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
39	copilot-here on                    # 固定本專案；或用 claude-copilot-once
40	codex-copilot                     # Codex；即時 OpenAI-first model selection
41	```
42	
43	`chezmoi apply` 不會偷偷遷移既有 global/project pin。升級後請手動執行一次
44	`copilot-model --auto`。若 `copilot-here` 已開，它會刷新 local role set；否則只更新
45	global 的單行 main-model state。
46	
47	## Routing 原理
48	
49	```text
50	Claude Code --Anthropic /v1/messages--> copilot-api (localhost:4141)
51	                                          | Claude：native Messages
52	                                          | GPT：Anthropic -> Responses 轉譯
53	                                          v
54	                                  GitHub Copilot API
55	```
56	
57	預設套件是 `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0`。GPT id 會走 Responses translation，
58	包括把 Claude Code 的 `output_config.effort` 轉成 `reasoning.effort`。GPT-5.6 與
59	Claude Code `ultracode` 需要這條路徑；舊 `1.13.14` 可能用 hard-coded fallback 蓋掉
60	client 指定的 effort。
61	
62	套件只安裝一次到 `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`。Windows 優先用 `npm.cmd`，因為它
63	能使用 `~/.npmrc` 裡的 Azure Artifacts credential provider；Bun 仍作為 fallback/runtime。
64	版本戳記會讓 2.1.0 升級自動重裝，warm start 不需要套件網路。
65	
66	## 模型選擇與 role profile
67	
68	`copilot-model --auto` 必須讀到 live `/v1/models`。先選 served Claude 家族
69	（`Fable > Opus > Sonnet > Haiku`），沒有 Claude 時依能力排序：
70	
71	```text
72	Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini > Gemini
73	```
74	
75	Luna 雖是 5.6 世代，但屬於輕量 tier，所以排在舊旗艦後面。這個角色意圖依照 OpenAI 的
76	[current model guidance](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model)。
77	一般沒有 Claude 的 Copilot catalog 會產生：
78	
79	| Claude Code role | Copilot model |
80	|---|---|
81	| Main / Fable / Opus | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
82	| Sonnet | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
83	| Haiku / background / legacy small-fast | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
84	
85	若手動選另一個 OpenAI main，Main/Fable/Opus 會保留該主模型；有 served Terra/Luna 時
86	分別供較低 role 使用。缺少 tier 時退回主模型，不會寫入不存在的硬編碼 id。原生 Claude
87	profile 則在每個 Claude 家族中選最強 served model。
88	
89	`[1m]` 是只給 Claude Code 的 context 提示；helper 依 live
90	`max_context_window_tokens >= 1,000,000` 決定。Raw API client 必須用 plain id。離線時仍
91	提供手動 discovery 清單，但 `--auto` 會拒絕寫入可能過期的 pin。
92	
93	`copilot-run` 與 `copilot-here on` 會注入同一組變數：
94	
95	```text
96	ANTHROPIC_MODEL
97	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
98	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
99	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
100	ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
101	ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
102	```
103	
104	刻意不設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`，讓 workflow/frontmatter routing 保持最高優先。
105	切換 profile 後需重開 Claude Code。
106	
107	## Claude Code 功能相容性
108	
109	關鍵分界是本機編排與 Anthropic cloud service：
110	
111	| 功能 | 透過 Copilot + GPT | 說明 |
112	|---|---|---|
113	| CLI、tools、hooks、skills、memory、plugins、MCP、checkpoints、sandboxing | 可以 | 都是本機功能；GPT 收到轉譯後的 prompt/tool schema，行為可能不同。 |
114	| subagents、dynamic workflows | 可以 | 提供 role variables，但不蓋掉 workflow-specific subagent routing。見 [workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows)。 |
115	| `ultracode` | 2.1.0 可以 | 它是 xhigh effort + dynamic workflows，不是獨立模型。 |
116	| thinking/reasoning | 轉譯後可用 | GPT 使用 Responses reasoning，不是 Anthropic-native thinking semantics。 |
117	| Web Search、fast/auto mode、MCP tool search | 依 provider | 取決於 Copilot endpoint 與 gateway translation。 |
118	| Ultrareview、Remote Control、Chrome、cloud Code Review、routines、web/mobile/Slack session | 不可以 | 需要 Claude.ai auth/cloud identity，local gateway 無法提供。 |
119	
120	官方參考：[feature availability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability)、
121	[model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config)、
122	[gateway protocol](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol)、
123	[Ultrareview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview)。
124	
125	## 網路、entitlement 與診斷
126	
127	- `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=auto` 會讀 Windows System Proxy 或明確的 proxy env，僅注入 child
128	  process 並帶 `--proxy-env`。Node 自己不會讀 WinINET system setting。
129	- Model catalog 只在 proxy 啟動時抓一次。`COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT` 預設 45 秒，因為
130	  Clash/mihomo hop 可能讓 refresh 超過舊版的 20 秒。
131	- GitHub 會依帳號、組織政策、rollout 與 egress 改變 catalog。因此在仍有 served OpenAI
132	  fallback 時，「沒有 Claude」是 warning，不代表 proxy 本身壞掉。
133	- `copilot-proxy doctor` 會比較 direct/proxied upstream catalog、驗證 main 與所有 role
134	  aliases，並找出 stale local pin。`--live` 也會比較遠端 ChatGPT `codex_apps`
135	  的 direct/proxied reachability，再送一個真實 inference request；只有後者消耗
136	  quota，timeout 與 TLS failure 會分開報告。
137	- `copilot-here` 只寫入 gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`，不碰 committed project
138	  settings；`off` 只移除 helper 擁有的 env keys，保留其他設定。
139	- `claude-copilot` / `claude-copilot-once` 保留 Windows port 的 trusted
140	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 與 optional SpecStory 行為，純 `claude` 不受影響。
141	- Throttle shim 仍與 macOS/Linux 版本 byte-identical，會限制並行並重試 403/429 burst。
142	
143	狀態放在 `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`；GitHub token 放在
144	`~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`。
145	
146	## Codex 走 gateway
147	
148	`codex-copilot` 與完全相同的 `codex-copilot-once` alias 會啟動本機
149	gateway/shim，並用本次啟動的 Codex `-c` overrides 傳入 `copilot_api`
150	Responses provider。它們不改 user/project Codex config，所以 plain `codex` 不受影響。
151	明確 `-m` / `--model` 永遠優先；否則從即時 raw catalog 依序選
152	OpenAI/Codex（`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3 Codex > Luna > mini`），
153	再退到 Claude、Gemini 與其他 chat model；disabled/embedding model 會排除。
154	
155	Codex 一律走 `localhost:4142` shim，即使持久化的 throttling 開關是 off。
156	這一層除了限流，也會正規化 Codex `mcp_list_tools` Responses item 裡的空白
157	description。MCP server 與原生 Codex path 可以省略描述，但 GitHub Copilot 會以
158	`Invalid 'input[0].tools[0].description': empty string` 拒絕請求。shim 只補這些
159	tool definition 欄位，不改 prompt、schema 或 tool name。
160	目前 Codex 會以 zstd 壓縮這些請求；shim 只解壓需要修補的 Responses body，改以
161	普通 JSON 轉送，並移除已不適用的 `content-encoding` header。
162	
163	這是與 Claude Code `copilot-model --auto` 分開的 picker：後者保持
164	Claude-first，只有 Codex launcher 是 OpenAI-first。
165	
166	有安裝 SpecStory 時自動整合。Wrapper 會保留生效的 `codex_cmd`（project config >
167	user config > 裸 `codex`），再附加 provider/model/user arguments；
168	`--no-specstory` 直接執行 Codex。Claude/Gemini fallback 經 Responses Lite，不支援
169	Responses `tool_search`，因此 native Responses OpenAI models 排在 Anthropic 前。
170	Launcher 也會啟用 gateway-backed remote compaction，並排除依賴不可用
171	`tool_search` 的 `mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace；後續明確傳入的 `-c`
172	仍可在單次呼叫覆寫這兩項。
173	
174	`codex_apps` 本身不是 localhost service，也不是 Apple-Silicon-only Codex Desktop
175	bridge；它是 `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps` 的遠端 MCP。因此即使
```

1	# Codex status line
2	
3	The Windows profile uses Codex's built-in TUI footer. Chezmoi enforces only
4	this list and preserves all unrelated live TOML, including providers, project
5	trust, plugins, feature flags, and nested keymaps:
6	
7	```toml
8	[tui]
9	status_line = [
10	  "model-with-reasoning",
11	  "fast-mode",
12	  "git-branch",
13	  "context-remaining",
14	  "task-progress",
15	  "current-dir",
16	]
17	```
18	
19	The modifier fails closed: malformed live TOML is left unchanged. The file is
20	deployed only when **Install coding agents** is enabled.
21	
22	Use `/status` as the routing proof. A `codex-copilot` session should show the
23	localhost provider even though the Account line can still show the logged-in
24	ChatGPT account. The managed footer omits `five-hour-limit` and `weekly-limit`
25	because those may remain ChatGPT-account counters while inference uses Copilot.
26	
27	No Claude-HUD-style extension is installed. Stock Codex accepts only fixed
28	built-in item IDs, while `@jiawang1209/codex-hud` patches and compiles an older
29	Codex tree and adds a PATH shim. The maintenance and supply-chain cost is too
30	high for a footer.
31	
32	`codex_apps` is a separate remote ChatGPT MCP at
33	`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, not an Apple Silicon Desktop bridge.
34	Use `copilot-proxy doctor --live` to compare its direct and HTTP-proxy routes.
35	
36	See [copilot-proxy](copilot-proxy.md) and the
37	[Codex config reference](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference).
38

1	# Pitfalls
2	
3	Past traps we've stepped on. **Symptoms-first** knowledge base — when a
4	problem recurs (on a new machine, after an upgrade, with a new tool combo),
5	grepping the symptom here lands you on the root cause and workaround in
6	seconds, instead of re-debugging from scratch.
7	
8	This folder is excluded from <DEPLOYMENT/PACKAGING MECHANISM, e.g. chezmoi via
9	.chezmoiignore.tmpl, Python via MANIFEST.in, npm via .npmignore> — it is repo
10	metadata for maintainers, not user-facing config to deploy.
11	
12	## Pitfalls vs the rest
13	
14	| Surface | Time direction | Question it answers | Access pattern |
15	|---|---|---|---|
16	| `docs/<tool>.md` | Present | "How does this tool work / how do I configure it?" | Read top to bottom |
17	| `pitfalls/<slug>.md` | **Past** | **"I see error X — has this happened before?"** | **Grep symptoms** |
18	| `backlog/<slug>.md` | Future | "We thought about doing Y — what was the analysis?" | Index in `TODO.md` |
19	| `AGENTS.md` Hard invariants | Present | "What rules MUST agents follow?" | Read top to bottom |
20	
21	A pitfall **graduates** to a Hard invariant when the trap is serious enough
22	that you can't rely on memory or grep — typically when (a) it recurs across
23	machines, (b) it silently corrupts state, or (c) the workaround is non-obvious
24	and easy to undo by accident. When graduating, leave a `pitfalls/<slug>.md`
25	as historical record and link to it from the new invariant.
26	
27	## When to add a pitfall doc
28	
29	Add `pitfalls/<slug>.md` when you've spent more than ~15 minutes on something
30	that wasn't googleable, AND any of:
31	
32	- The symptom is non-obvious from the root cause (silent state, weird side
33	  effect, behaviour change without error)
34	- The fix is "do nothing different but in a specific order"
35	- The same trap could be hit by a new agent / new machine / new contributor
36	- An upstream bug exists with no ETA — workaround needs to outlive memory
37	- A specific tool version is required (or forbidden) and failure at the
38	  wrong version is silent / confusing
39	
40	## When NOT to add a pitfall doc
41	
42	- Trivially googleable (next person solves in 30 seconds)
43	- Already covered in `docs/<tool>.md` — cross-link from this README's
44	  "Cross-referenced pitfalls" table below instead of duplicating
45	- Already a Hard invariant (cross-link only)
46	- One-off transient (network glitch, machine-specific config rot)
47	
48	## File template
49	
50	See [`pitfall-doc.md.template`] in the
51	[`project-knowledge-harness` skill](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/local/project-knowledge-harness)
52	for the per-doc template.
53	
54	Key sections (different from `backlog/` template — symptom-first, not
55	context-first):
56	
57	```markdown
58	# <Title describing the SYMPTOM, not the root cause>
59	
60	**Symptoms** (grep this section): <verbatim error messages, observable behaviour>
61	**First seen**: YYYY-MM
62	**Affects**: <tool/version/OS combo>
63	**Status**: workaround documented / fixed upstream in vX.Y / WONTFIX
64	
65	## Symptom
66	
67	Full error messages (verbatim — preserves grep-ability).
68	
69	## Root cause
70	
71	Why this happens, with source/docs/upstream issue link.
72	
73	## Workaround
74	
75	Copy-pasteable commands or config diff.
76	
77	## Prevention
78	
79	How to avoid stepping on this again.
80	
81	## Related
82	
83	Links to docs, sibling pitfalls, TODO entries, upstream issues.
84	```

+
+## Codex through the gateway
+
+`codex-copilot` and its identical `codex-copilot-once` alias start the local
+gateway/shim and pass a `copilot_api` Responses provider through one-invocation
+Codex `-c` overrides. They do not edit user or project Codex config, so plain
+`codex` is unaffected. An explicit `-m` / `--model` wins; otherwise the live raw
+catalog is ranked OpenAI/Codex first (`Sol > Terra > GPT-5.5 > GPT-5.4 > GPT-5.3
+Codex > Luna > mini`), then Claude, Gemini and other chat models. Disabled and
+embedding models are excluded.
+
+This is a separate picker from Claude Code's `copilot-model --auto`: that path
+remains Claude-first, while only the Codex launcher is OpenAI-first.
+
+SpecStory is automatic when installed. The wrapper preserves the effective
+`codex_cmd` (project config > user config > bare `codex`) before appending
+provider/model/user arguments; `--no-specstory` runs Codex directly. Claude and
+Gemini fallback through Responses Lite, which does not support Responses
+`tool_search`, so native Responses OpenAI models stay ahead of Anthropic.
+The launcher also enables gateway-backed remote compaction and excludes the
+`mcp__codex_apps__sites` namespace that depends on unavailable `tool_search`;
+later explicit `-c` arguments can override either setting per invocation.
+
+`codex_apps` itself is not a localhost service and not an Apple-Silicon-only
+Codex Desktop bridge. It is a remote MCP at
+`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps`, so startup can fail even while
+Copilot inference on `localhost:4142` works. Keep Apps enabled and use
+`copilot-proxy doctor --live` to diagnose that route independently.
+
+There is deliberately no Codex equivalent of `copilot-here`: project
+`.codex/config.toml` cannot override provider definitions, provider selection or
+auth metadata. The explicit launcher provides project/session scope without
+changing the user-wide default.
+
+### Experimental direct configuration
+
+The direct `model_providers.copilot-enterprise` example is documented in the
+macOS/Linux guide rather than installed. It is not the localhost proxy path, and
+the pasted `gh auth token` flow is not portable: on the tested EMU account it
+returned `421`/`403`, while the credential stored by `copilot-proxy auth` plus
+the normal short-lived Copilot token exchange worked. The supported launcher
+therefore uses the authenticated local gateway.

```text
1	# npm returns 404 against `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io` — and the registry is actually fine
2	
3	**Symptoms** (grep this section): probing the internal Microsoft npm mirror
4	looks like a dead service —
5	
6	```
7	npm error 404
8	npm error 404 Note that you can also install from a
9	npm error 404 tarball, folder, http url, or git url.
10	```
11	
12	`npm ping --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` → **404**.
13	`https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/` and `/undici` → **404** in a browser or
14	`Invoke-WebRequest`. `npm view <pkg> --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/registry/`
15	→ **404**. Yet DNS resolves and TCP 443 connects fine, and *some* tarball URLs
16	return 200. The natural conclusion — "this is only a tarball proxy for specific
17	packages, not a real npm registry" — is **wrong**.
18	**First seen**: 2026-07-29 (reached independently on two company laptops)
19	**Affects**: Microsoft corp machines where `registry=https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/`
20	is set at the machine level (`Q:\.tools\.npm-global\etc\npmrc`) and
21	`registry.npmjs.org` is blocked.
22	**Status**: not a bug — three probing mistakes.
23	
24	## Root cause
25	
26	`packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` **is** a full pull-through npm registry.
27	Three separate things make it look broken:
28	
29	### 1. `npm ping` is not implemented — 404 does not mean unhealthy
30	
31	`npm ping` hits `/-/ping`, which this mirror does not serve. It returns 404 on a
32	perfectly working registry. **Never use `npm ping` as the health probe here.**
33	Use a metadata read instead:
34	
35	```bash
36	npm view undici version --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/
37	# 8.8.0
38	```
39	
40	### 2. `/npm/registry/` is one segment too deep
41	
42	The registry root is `/npm/`, **not** `/npm/registry/`:
43	
44	| URL | Result |
45	|---|---|
46	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` | works |
47	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/registry/` | 404 |
48	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/` | 404 |
49	
50	The `/npm/registry/...` shape is what **Azure Artifacts** feeds use
51	(`pkgs.dev.azure.com/<org>/_packaging/<feed>/npm/registry/`), so it is an easy
52	habit to carry over. The give-away that `/npm/` is correct: the tarball path
53	that *does* work, `/npm/@scope/name/-/name-1.2.3.tgz`, is the standard npm
54	layout relative to base `/npm/`.
55	
56	### 3. The internal feed can be *ahead* of the public mirror
57	
58	Asking the internal Azure Artifacts feed for `undici@latest` yields a version
59	the public mirror does not have yet. Requesting that newer tarball from
60	`packagefeedproxy` then 404s, which reads as "tarball not provided" when it
61	actually means "that version isn't mirrored". At time of writing the internal
62	feed had `undici` 8.9.0 while the mirror's latest was **8.8.0**.
63	
64	## How to verify it is healthy
65	
66	```bash
67	R='https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/'
68	npm view undici version   --registry "$R"   # 8.8.0   -> metadata works
69	npm view left-pad version --registry "$R"   # 1.3.0   -> arbitrary public pkg, so no allowlist
70	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14' version --registry "$R"
71	```
72	
73	`left-pad` is the important one: an obscure package nobody on the machine has
74	ever installed proves this is a general pull-through proxy, not a curated
75	allowlist.
76	
77	Metadata rewrites `dist.tarball` to Microsoft's 1ES **public** mirror:
78	
79	```
80	https://ms-feed-25.pkgs.visualstudio.com/1es-public/_packaging/npm-public/npm/registry/undici/-/undici-8.8.0.tgz
81	```
82	
83	Note `npm-public` — packages served here are public npm packages, so a scoped
84	name resolving through it is **not** evidence that a package is internal or
85	that an internal-feed credential is required.
86	
87	## Prevention
88	
89	- Health-probe with `npm view <pkg> version --registry <url>`, never `npm ping`.
90	- Do not copy the `/npm/registry/` suffix from Azure Artifacts URLs.
91	- Before concluding a version is missing, check the mirror's own `latest`
92	  rather than the internal feed's.
93	- `npm config list` shows which file supplies `registry` (`builtin` / `global` /
94	  `user` / `env`) and masks credentials — prefer it to reading `~/.npmrc`, which
95	  contains a live token.
96	
97	## Related
98	
99	- [`copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module`](copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module.md)
100	  — the failure this investigation was chasing. It was not a registry problem
101	  at all; a stale deployed module was falling back to Bun, which ignores the
102	  configured registry.
103
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# `copilot-proxy` install dies with `error: ConnectionRefused downloading package manifest`
2	
3	**Symptoms** (grep this section): `copilot-proxy start` / `copilot-proxy reinstall`
4	prints
5	
6	```
7	Resolving dependencies
8	Resolved, downloaded and extracted [6]
9	error: ConnectionRefused downloading package manifest @jeffreycao/copilot-api
10	WARNING: copilot-proxy: install stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ...
11	Resolving dependencies
12	Resolved, downloaded and extracted [6]
13	error: ConnectionRefused downloading package manifest @jeffreycao/copilot-api
14	Write-Error: copilot-proxy: could not install @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'.
15	```
16	
17	Both attempts fail identically (with and without the proxy env), so it looks
18	like a hard network block. `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg` stays empty and
19	`.installed-spec` is never written. Meanwhile plain `npm` works fine —
20	`npm view @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 version` returns the version, and
21	other global npm CLIs install without complaint. That mismatch is the tell.
22	**First seen**: 2026-07-29
23	**Affects**: corp/managed Windows boxes where the npm registry is an internal
24	mirror (here `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io`) and `registry.npmjs.org` is
25	blocked, **and** the deployed Copilot module predates the npm-install branch.
26	**Status**: fixed — `chezmoi apply`.
27	
28	## Root cause
29	
30	Two things compound:
31	
32	1. **Bun does not use the corp npm registry.** `Resolving dependencies` /
33	   `Resolved, downloaded and extracted [N]` / `error: ConnectionRefused` is
34	   **Bun's** output format, not npm's. Bun reaches for `registry.npmjs.org`,
35	   which the corp network blocks, hence `ConnectionRefused`. npm, by contrast,
36	   honours the `registry=` line in `~/.npmrc` (and the machine-level npmrc), so
37	   the same package resolves instantly.
38	2. **The deployed module was stale.** `Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry` prefers npm
39	   when `npm.cmd` is on PATH and only falls back to Bun otherwise — but that
40	   npm branch was added in commit `5351411`. The copy at
41	   `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1` still had the
42	   **Bun-only** version, because `chezmoi apply` had not been run since. The
43	   source tree was correct; the deployed file was not.
44	
45	So the error says "network", the real answer is "your deployed module is behind
46	your source tree". `chezmoi status` had been flagging it the whole time:
47	
48	```
49	 M .config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
50	```
51	
52	## Workaround
53	
54	```powershell
55	chezmoi status                 # look for a modified Copilot.psm1
56	chezmoi apply ~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
57	copilot-proxy reinstall        # now uses npm
58	# copilot-proxy: installed @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 -> ...\copilot-api\pkg
59	```
60	
61	Successful run takes ~22s and reports `added 149 packages`.
62	
63	A full `chezmoi apply` also works but runs the `run_onchange` package installers
64	(scoop/winget/npm), which can take many minutes; target the single file when
65	you only need the module refreshed.
66	
67	## Prevention
68	
69	- **Check `chezmoi status` before debugging any behaviour of a chezmoi-managed
70	  script.** A stale deployed copy reproduces bugs that no longer exist in the
71	  source, and nothing warns you.
72	- Do **not** conclude "the registry is broken" from a Bun error. Confirm with
73	  npm first — `npm view <pkg> version` uses the configured registry, Bun does
74	  not. See
75	  [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
76	  for how to probe the registry correctly.
77	- This is why `Copilot.psm1` carries the warning
78	  `npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm)`
79	  — if you see that line, the Bun path is about to be taken and will fail on a
80	  corp network.
81	
82	## Related
83	
84	- [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
85	  — the companion trap: probing the internal registry the wrong way and
86	  concluding it is broken.
87	- `docs/copilot-proxy.md` — module overview; note it lists **bun** as the only
88	  prerequisite, which is true for *running* the proxy but not for *installing*
89	  the package on a corp feed.
90
```
</details></tool-use>

```md
# Context

The current Windows setup has four independent regressions:

1. A failed `npm install @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0` can be reported as successful because an older package tree/binlink satisfies the current weak postcondition; the requested spec is then stamped and the stale package is launched.
2. `copilot-proxy auth` passes `auth --provider copilot`, so Citty interprets the option value `copilot` as the subcommand and reports `Unknown command copilot`. The supported argv is `auth login --provider copilot`.
3. `doctor --live` probes the first alphabetically sorted model instead of the effective pin, discards structured error bodies, and therefore reports only `HTTP 402`. `billing_not_configured` is an account-wide GitHub Copilot billing configuration error, not a model-specific or retryable failure.
4. The Codex `modify_` overlay mishandles a leading UTF-8 BOM and does not preserve malformed input byte-for-byte. The failed Actions run additionally lacked `uv`/`tomlkit`, so every non-empty TOML merge silently failed closed.

The intended outcome is deterministic package/auth behavior, an actionable and honest live diagnostic, a byte-safe Codex overlay, and a Windows workflow that exercises the real non-empty merge path. # Building LLM-Powered Applications with Claude

This skill helps you build LLM-powered applications with Claude. Choose the right surface based on your needs, detect the project language, then read the relevant language-specific documentation.

## Before You Start

Scan the target file (or, if no target file, the prompt and project) for non-Anthropic provider markers — `import openai`, `from openai`, `langchain_openai`, `OpenAI(`, `gpt-4`, `gpt-5`, file names like `agent-openai.py` or `*-generic.py`, or any explicit instruction to keep the code provider-neutral. If you find any, stop and tell the user that this skill produces Claude/Anthropic SDK code; ask whether they want to switch the file to Claude or want a non-Claude implementation. Do not edit a non-Anthropic file with Anthropic SDK calls. (Exception: the `prompt-audit` subcommand is non-interactive and does not stop here — it records non-Anthropic provider markers in its report's stated assumptions and never proposes switching a non-Anthropic file to the Anthropic SDK.)

## Output Requirement

When the user asks you to add, modify, or implement a Claude feature, your code must call Claude through one of:

1. **The official Anthropic SDK** for the project's language (`anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `com.anthropic.*`, etc.). This is the default whenever a supported SDK exists for the project.
2. **Raw HTTP** (`curl`, `requests`, `fetch`, `httpx`, etc.) — only when the user explicitly asks for cURL/REST/raw HTTP, the project is a shell/cURL project, or the language has no official SDK.

Never mix the two — don't reach for `requests`/`fetch` in a Python or TypeScript project just because it feels lighter. Never fall back to OpenAI-compatible shims.

**Never guess SDK usage.** Function names, class names, namespaces, method signatures, and import paths must come from explicit documentation — either the `{lang}/` files in this skill or the official SDK repositories or documentation links listed in `shared/live-sources.md`. If the binding you need is not explicitly documented in the skill files, WebFetch the relevant SDK repo from `shared/live-sources.md` before writing code. Do not infer Ruby/Java/Go/PHP/C# APIs from cURL shapes or from another language's SDK.

**If WebFetch or repository access fails** (network restricted, timeouts, clone blocked): do not keep retrying — write code from the patterns and namespace/package tables in the `{lang}/` file, run the compiler or interpreter on it, and iterate on the error output. For statically-typed SDKs (C#, Java, Go) a compile-fix loop against local errors reaches working code faster than blocked network research.

## Defaults

Unless the user requests otherwise:

For the Claude model version, please use Claude Opus 5, which you can access via the exact model string `claude-opus-5`. Please default to using adaptive thinking (`thinking: {type: "adaptive"}`) for anything remotely complicated. And finally, please default to streaming for any request that may involve long input, long output, or high `max_tokens` — it prevents hitting request timeouts. Use the SDK's `.get_final_message()` / `.finalMessage()` helper to get the complete response if you don't need to handle individual stream events

## ⚠️ API Drift — Your Training Prior May Be Stale

Several common Claude API shapes changed in 2025–2026. If you recall a pattern from training, verify it against the `{lang}/` files in this skill before writing — the rows below are the most frequent drift points:

| Area | Stale prior | Current API |
|---|---|---|
| Extended thinking | `thinking: {type: "enabled", budget_tokens: N}` | On Claude 4.6+ models: `thinking: {type: "adaptive"}`. `budget_tokens` is deprecated on Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6 and **rejected with a 400** on Fable 5 / Sonnet 5 / Opus 5 / 4.8 / 4.7. Pre-4.6 models still use `budget_tokens`. |
| Web search / web fetch tool type | `web_search_20250305`, `web_fetch_20250910` | `web_search_20260209`, `web_fetch_20260209` (dynamic filtering) on Opus 5/4.8/4.7/4.6, Sonnet 5, and Sonnet 4.6. Older models keep the basic variants; on Vertex AI only basic `web_search_20250305` is available (web fetch is not on Vertex) — see the Server Tools QR below. |
| PHP parameter names | snake_case wire names as named args (`max_tokens`) | Top-level named args are camelCase (`maxTokens`). Nested array keys vary by feature (e.g. `'taskBudget'`, `'skillID'`, `'mcp_server_name'`) — copy the exact key from the documented example; do not bulk-convert. |
| Managed Agents credentials | Keep secrets host-side via custom tools (the only option before vaults shipped) | Vault `environment_variable` credentials — stored by Anthropic, substituted at egress, never visible in the sandbox (`shared/managed-agents-tools.md` → Vaults). Host-side custom tools remain the fallback for self-hosted sandboxes. |

The `{lang}/` files in this skill are authoritative over recalled patterns.

This lets users invoke specific flows via `/claude-api <subcommand>`. If no table in the document matches, treat the request as normal prose.

| Subcommand | Action |
|---|---|
| `migrate` | Migrate existing Claude API code to a newer model. **Read `shared/model-migration.md` immediately** and follow it in order: Step 0 (confirm scope — ask which files/directories before any edit), Step 1 (classify each file), then the per-target breaking-changes section. Do not summarize the guide — execute it. If the user did not name a target model, ask which model to migrate to in the same turn as the scope question. After the per-target changes are applied, audit the in-scope prompt text, tool descriptions, and request code against `shared/prompt-audit.md` — prompting written for the source model is part of every migration, and it does not announce itself. |
| `prompt-audit` | Audit existing prompts, skills, and tool descriptions for dated patterns ("cruft") written for older models. **Read `shared/prompt-audit.md` immediately** and follow it in order: Step 0 (establish scope and target model from the request and the repository — state the assumptions in the report, do not stop to ask), inventory, provenance, then the pattern scan. Produce both deliverables in full — the audit report (findings with `file:line`, pattern, why it's obsolete for the target model, confidence) and a proposed diff — without pausing for confirmation; apply edits only if the request explicitly asked for them.
