```text
600	# --- shim start/stop ---
601	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
602	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
603	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
604	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
605	    }
606	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
607	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
608	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
609	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
610	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
611	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
612	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
613	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
614	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
615	}
616	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
617	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
618	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
619	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
620	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
621	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
622	    }
623	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
624	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
625	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
626	}
627	
628	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
629	function copilot-proxy {
630	    [CmdletBinding()]
631	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
632	
633	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
634	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
635	    }
636	
637	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
638	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
639	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
640	
641	    switch ($action) {
642	        'start' {
643	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
644	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
645	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
646	            }
647	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
648	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
649	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
650	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
651	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
652	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
653	            }
654	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
655	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
656	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
657	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
658	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
659	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
660	
661	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
662	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
663	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
664	            if ($httpProxy) {
665	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
666	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
667	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
668	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
669	            }
670	
671	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
672	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
673	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
674	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
675	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
676	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
677	            } else {
678	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
679	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
680	            }
681	
682	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
683	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
684	            $saved = @{}
685	            if ($httpProxy) {
686	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
687	            }
688	            try {
689	                $spArgs = @{
690	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
691	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
692	                    PassThru                = $true
693	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
694	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
695	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
696	                }
697	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
698	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
699	            } finally {
700	                if ($httpProxy) {
701	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
702	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
703	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
704	                    }
705	                }
706	            }
707	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
708	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
709	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
710	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
711	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
712	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
713	                    }
714	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
715	                    return
716	                }
717	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
718	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
719	                if ($p.HasExited) {
720	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
721	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
722	                }
723	                Start-Sleep 1
724	            }
725	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
726	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
727	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
728	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
729	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
730	        }
731	        'stop' {
732	            Stop-CopilotShim
733	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
734	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
735	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
736	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
737	            }
738	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
739	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
740	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
741	            Start-Sleep 1
742	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
743	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
744	        }
745	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
746	        'status' {
747	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
748	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
749	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
750	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
751	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
752	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
753	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
754	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
755	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
756	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
757	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
758	            } else {
759	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
760	            }
761	        }
762	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
763	        'logs' {
764	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
765	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
766	            } else {
767	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
768	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
769	            }
770	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
771	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
772	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
773	        }
774	        'auth' {
775	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
776	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
777	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
778	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth --provider copilot }
779	        }
780	        'reinstall' {
781	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
782	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
783	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
784	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
785	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
786	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $(Get-CopilotPkg) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
787	        }
788	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
789	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
790	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
791	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
792	            }
793	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
794	                try {
795	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
796	                    [pscustomobject]@{
797	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
798	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
799	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
800	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
801	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
802	            } else {
803	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
804	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
805	            }
806	        }
807	        'shim' {
808	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
809	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
810	            switch ($sub) {
811	                'on' {
812	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
813	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
814	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
815	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
816	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
817	                }
818	                'off' {
819	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
820	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
821	                }
822	                default {
823	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
824	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
825	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
826	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
827	                }
828	            }
829	        }
830	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
831	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
832	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
833	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
834	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
835	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
836	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
837	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
838	        }
839	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
840	    }
841	}
842	
843	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
844	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
845	    param([switch] $Live)
846	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
847	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
848	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
849	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
850	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
851	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
852	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
853	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
854	
855	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
856	
857	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
858	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
859	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
860	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
861	    }
862	
863	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
864	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
865	    # network at all. An un-installed prefix is not a fault: the next start installs it.
866	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
867	        OK 'installed' $pkg
868	        $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
869	        if ($launch) {
870	            $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()
871	            if ($launch.Cwd) { $how += "   (cwd: $($launch.Cwd))" }
872	            SKIP 'runs via' $how
873	        } else { BAD 'runs via' 'no runnable binary'; HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall' }
874	    } else {
875	        NOTE 'not installed' "$pkg — the next 'copilot-proxy start' installs it (one-time)"
876	        HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now'
877	    }
878	
879	    Write-Host "`nAuthentication"
880	    if (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken)) { OK 'token file' (Get-CopilotToken) } else { BAD 'token file' 'absent'; HINT 'copilot-proxy auth' }
881	
882	    Write-Host "`nProxy"
883	    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { OK 'listening' (Get-CopilotBase) } else { BAD 'listening' "nothing on port $port"; HINT 'copilot-proxy start' }
884	    # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds the
885	    # port: `start` just says "did not come up in time" and the log shows only
886	    # "Resolving dependencies". Hard failure when nothing is listening (that IS the
887	    # fault), softer when the proxy is up (a leftover still holding bun's cache lock,
888	    # which will hang the next restart).
889	    $stale = @(Get-CopilotStaleInstaller)
890	    if ($stale.Count -gt 0) {
891	        if (Test-CopilotAlive) { NOTE 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)" }
892	        else { BAD 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at `"Resolving dependencies`", never binds port $port" }
893	        HINT "kill just those: Stop-Process -Id $($stale.ProcessId -join ',') -Force"
894	        HINT 'then: copilot-proxy reinstall'
895	        HINT 're-hangs? bun is stalling on the proxy — $env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1; copilot-proxy reinstall'
896	    } else {
897	        SKIP 'installer' "no wedged 'bun add' process"
898	    }
899	    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
900	        if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { OK 'throttle shim' "up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)" } else { BAD 'throttle shim' 'enabled but DOWN'; HINT 'copilot-proxy shim on' }
901	    } else { SKIP 'throttle shim' 'off' }
902	
903	    Write-Host "`nModels"
904	    $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
905	    $proxyMode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
906	    if ($httpProxy) { NOTE 'http proxy' "$httpProxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this" }
907	    else { SKIP 'http proxy' "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode)" }
908	
909	    # A/B: true-direct vs via the local proxy. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog
910	    # on some egress, and .NET/curl follow the System Proxy by default — so a single
911	    # "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as an entitlement problem.
912	    $dirClaude = 0; $viaClaude = 0; $anyUpstream = $false
913	    $upDirect = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via 'direct'
914	    if ($upDirect) {
915	        $anyUpstream = $true
916	        $dirClaude = @($upDirect | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
917	        OK 'upstream direct' "$($upDirect.Count) ids, $dirClaude claude (no proxy)"
918	    } else {
919	        SKIP 'upstream direct' 'could not query GitHub direct (need a token, or blocked)'
920	    }
921	    if ($httpProxy) {
922	        $upVia = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via $httpProxy
923	        if ($upVia) {
924	            $anyUpstream = $true
925	            $viaClaude = @($upVia | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
926	            OK 'upstream via proxy' "$($upVia.Count) ids, $viaClaude claude ($httpProxy)"
927	        } else {
928	            BAD 'upstream via proxy' "no response through $httpProxy"
929	            HINT 'the Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another selection'
930	        }
931	    }
932	
933	    $served = Get-CopilotServedModels
934	    if ($served -and $served.Count -gt 0) {
935	        $claude = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' })
936	        OK 'served' "$($served.Count) model ids"
937	        if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { OK 'claude models' "$($claude.Count) ids available" }
938	        else { NOTE 'claude models' "0 of $($served.Count) — Anthropic unavailable; role-aware OpenAI fallback will be used" }
939	
940	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0) {
941	            NOTE 'egress geo' 'Claude appears ONLY via the local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct egress'
942	            if ($claude.Count -eq 0) {
943	                BAD 'MISSING --proxy-env' 'copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog'
944	                HINT 'copilot-proxy restart   # auto attaches --proxy-env when a proxy is detected'
945	                HINT '$env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7897"; copilot-proxy restart'
946	            }
947	        } elseif ($viaClaude -eq 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0 -and $anyUpstream) {
948	            NOTE 'entitlement' 'neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude'
949	            HINT 'org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help'
950	        } elseif ($claude.Count -eq 0 -and $viaClaude -gt 0) {
951	            BAD 'STALE CACHE' 'via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not'
952	            HINT 'copilot-proxy restart'
953	        } elseif ($claude.Count -gt 0) {
954	            OK 'cache' 'the served Claude list looks healthy'
955	        }
956	
957	        $pin = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
958	        $model = $pin[0]; $src = $pin[1]
959	        if ($served -contains $model) { OK 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)" }
960	        else {
961	            BAD 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)"
962	            HINT 'not served -> requests return 400 model_not_supported'
963	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # Claude; else capability-ranked OpenAI, then Gemini'
964	            HINT 'copilot-model -l       # list served ids'
965	        }
966	
967	        # Validate every alias Claude Code may select for background/subagent
968	        # work. A stale Sonnet/Haiku id can fail with 400 while main chat works.
969	        $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
970	        $modelProfile = $null
971	        if (Test-Path $settings) {
972	            try {
973	                $localEnv = (Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env
974	                if ($localEnv.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
975	                    $modelProfile = [ordered]@{
976	                        main   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
977	                        fable  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
978	                        opus   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
979	                        sonnet = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
980	                        haiku  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
981	                    }
982	                }
983	            } catch { $modelProfile = $null }
984	        }
985	        if (-not $modelProfile) {
986	            $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
987	            $modelProfile = Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $model -Catalog $catalog
988	        }
989	        $roleBad = $false
990	        foreach ($role in 'fable', 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku') {
991	            $roleModel = $modelProfile[$role]
992	            if (-not $roleModel) {
993	                BAD "role $role" 'unset — Claude Code may choose its native default and get model_not_supported'
994	                $roleBad = $true
995	            }
996	            elseif ($served -notcontains $roleModel) {
997	                BAD "role $role" "$roleModel is not served"
998	                $roleBad = $true
999	            }
1000	        }
1001	        if (-not $roleBad) {
1002	            OK 'model roles' "fable=$($modelProfile.fable), opus=$($modelProfile.opus), sonnet=$($modelProfile.sonnet), haiku=$($modelProfile.haiku)"
1003	        } else {
1004	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # rewrite main + every Claude Code role alias'
1005	        }
1006	    } else {
1007	        BAD 'served' "could not fetch $(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models"
1008	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0) { HINT 'start with the proxy: copilot-proxy start   # attaches --proxy-env automatically' }
1009	    }
1010	
1011	    Write-Host "`nUpstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
1012	    foreach ($h in 'api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com', 'api.githubcopilot.com') {
1013	        try {
1014	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1015	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://$h/models" -TimeoutSec 12 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1016	            $sw.Stop()
1017	            OK $h "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
1018	        } catch { BAD $h 'no response within 12s'; HINT 'connection blocked or upstream unreachable' }
1019	    }
1020	    SKIP '' 'HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)'
1021	
1022	    Write-Host "`nCodex Apps (ChatGPT MCP)"
1023	    $appsUri = 'https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps'
1024	    SKIP 'route' "$appsUri — independent of localhost Copilot inference and Codex.app"
1025	    if (-not $Live) {
1026	        SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to compare direct and configured-proxy reachability'
1027	    } else {
1028	        $appsDirect = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via 'direct'
1029	        if ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1030	            OK 'direct' "HTTP $($appsDirect.Code) in $($appsDirect.Seconds)s (an auth rejection still proves reachability)"
1031	        } else {
1032	            NOTE 'direct' "$($appsDirect.Kind) failure after $($appsDirect.Seconds)s"
1033	            if ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'tls') { HINT 'inspect antivirus/corporate TLS interception and the Windows trust store' }
1034	            elseif ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'timeout') { HINT 'the ChatGPT Apps route is blocked or not entering the expected TUN path' }
1035	        }
1036	
1037	        if ($httpProxy) {
1038	            $appsVia = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via $httpProxy
1039	            if ($appsVia.Reached) {
1040	                OK 'via proxy' "HTTP $($appsVia.Code) in $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1041	                if (-not $appsDirect.Reached) {
1042	                    HINT "Codex Apps needs this route; launch Codex with HTTPS_PROXY=$httpProxy or repair TUN routing"
1043	                }
1044	            } elseif ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1045	                SKIP 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure — direct already works, so Apps need no explicit proxy"
1046	            } else {
1047	                NOTE 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure after $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1048	                HINT 'this does not invalidate GitHub Copilot inference; it only explains codex_apps startup failures'
1049	            }
1050	        } else {
1051	            SKIP 'via proxy' 'no explicit/system HTTP proxy detected; TUN may still carry direct traffic'
1052	        }
1053	    }
1054	
1055	    Write-Host "`nLive probe"
1056	    if (-not $Live) { SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)' }
1057	    elseif (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { SKIP 'skipped' 'proxy is not running' }
1058	    elseif (-not $served) { SKIP 'skipped' 'no served model to probe with' }
1059	    else {
1060	        $pm = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'embedding' -and $_ -notmatch '\[1m\]' })[0]
1061	        $body = @{ model = $pm; max_tokens = 1; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'hi' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
1062	        try {
1063	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1064	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotClientBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `
1065	                -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1066	            $sw.Stop()
1067	            if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300) { OK 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s" }
1068	            else { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode)"; HINT 'copilot-proxy logs 40' }
1069	        } catch { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> request failed ($_)" }
1070	    }
1071	
1072	    Write-Host ''
1073	    if ($script:fail -gt 0) { Write-Host "$($script:fail) failed, $($script:warn) warning(s)`n"; return }
1074	    Write-Host "all checks passed ($($script:warn) warning(s))`n"
1075	}

1077	# ------------------------------------------------------------- copilot-run ----
1078	function copilot-run {
1079	    [CmdletBinding()]
1080	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1081	    if (-not $Argv -or $Argv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]'; return }
1082	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1083	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) { Start-CopilotShim | Out-Null }
1084	
1085	    # Single source of truth — see Get-CopilotEnvBlock.
1086	    $inject = Get-CopilotEnvBlock
1087	    # Scope env to the child process: set, run, restore (equivalent to `env VAR=..`).
1088	    $saved = @{}
1089	    foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) { $saved[$k] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($k); Set-Item "env:$k" $inject[$k] }
1090	    try {
1091	        $exe = $Argv[0]; $rest = if ($Argv.Count -gt 1) { $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
1092	        & $exe @rest
1093	    } finally {
1094	        foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) {
1095	            if ($null -eq $saved[$k]) { Remove-Item "env:$k" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1096	            else { Set-Item "env:$k" $saved[$k] }
1097	        }
1098	    }
1099	}

1101	# Codex prefers a native Responses-capable OpenAI model. Claude/Gemini are
1102	# Responses Lite fallbacks only, unlike Select-CopilotBestModel (Claude Code),
1103	# where native Claude remains the first choice.
1104	function script:Select-CopilotBestCodexModel {
1105	    param([string[]] $Model)
1106	    if (-not $Model -or $Model.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
1107	    $Model = @($Model | ForEach-Object { Remove-CopilotContextHint $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1108	
1109	    foreach ($preferred in 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.3-codex',
1110	                           'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini') {
1111	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1112	    }
1113	    $pick = { param($re, $exclude)
1114	        $c = @($Model | Where-Object { $_ -match $re -and (-not $exclude -or $_ -notmatch $exclude) } | Sort-Object)
1115	        if ($c.Count -gt 0) { $c[-1] } else { $null }
1116	    }
1117	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' 'mini|nano|luna'
1118	    if ($r) { return $r }
1119	    $r = & $pick 'codex' $null
1120	    if ($r) { return $r }
1121	    $r = & $pick '^gpt-' $null
1122	    if ($r) { return $r }
1123	
1124	    foreach ($preferred in 'claude-fable-5',
1125	                           'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6',
1126	                           'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
1127	                           'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5') {
1128	        if ($Model -contains $preferred) { return $preferred }
1129	    }
1130	    $r = & $pick '^claude-' $null
1131	    if ($r) { return $r }
1132	    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' 'flash'
1133	    if ($r) { return $r }
1134	    $r = & $pick '^gemini-' $null
1135	    if ($r) { return $r }
1136	    @($Model | Sort-Object)[-1]
1137	}

1143	            if ($line -match '^\s*codex_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {

1145	                if ($v) { return $v }

1149	    'codex'

1160	function codex-copilot {
1161	    [CmdletBinding()]
1162	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1163	    $ss = 'auto'
1164	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
1165	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = @($Argv | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
1166	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1167	        Write-Host 'Usage: codex-copilot [--no-specstory] [codex args...]'
1168	        Write-Host '  One-off Codex session on the local Copilot Responses gateway.'
1169	        Write-Host '  Auto model: OpenAI/Codex > Claude > Gemini > other served chat models.'
1170	        Write-Host '  Alias: codex-copilot-once'
1171	        return
1172	    }
1173	
1174	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1175	    # Codex always needs the shim's Responses compatibility normalization even
1176	    # when persistent burst throttling is disabled. This does not change state.
1177	    if (-not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) {
1178	        if (-not (Start-CopilotShim)) { return }
1179	    }
1180	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1181	    if (-not $catalog) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: could not read the live gateway model catalog'; return }
1182	
1183	    $explicitModel = Test-CopilotExplicitCodexModel -Argv $Argv
1184	    $model = $null
1185	    if (-not $explicitModel) {
1186	        $models = @($catalog.data | Where-Object {
1187	            ($_.policy.state -ne 'disabled') -and ($_.model_picker_enabled -ne $false) -and
1188	            ($_.capabilities.type -ne 'embeddings')
1189	        } | ForEach-Object { $_.id } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
1190	        $model = Select-CopilotBestCodexModel -Model $models
1191	        if (-not $model) { Write-Error 'codex-copilot: no usable chat model in the live gateway catalog'; return }
1192	        $Argv = @('-m', $model) + @($Argv)
1193	        if ($model -like 'claude-*' -or $model -like 'gemini-*') {
1194	            Write-Warning "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model (Responses Lite; tool_search unavailable)"
1195	        } else { Write-Host "codex-copilot: --auto -> $model" }
1196	    }
1197	
1198	    $base = Get-CopilotShimBase
1199	    $providerArgs = @(
1200	        '-c', 'model_provider="copilot_api"',
1201	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.name="OpenAI"',
1202	        '-c', "model_providers.copilot_api.base_url=`"$base`"",
1203	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.env_key="GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY"',
1204	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.requires_openai_auth=true',
1205	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.supports_websockets=false',
1206	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.wire_api="responses"',
1207	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.request_max_retries=3',
1208	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_max_retries=1',
1209	        '-c', 'model_providers.copilot_api.stream_idle_timeout_ms=300000',
1210	        '-c', 'features.remote_compaction_v2=true',
1211	        '-c', 'features.code_mode.excluded_tool_namespaces=["mcp__codex_apps__sites"]'
1212	    )
1213	    if ($model) {
1214	        $entry = $catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $model } | Select-Object -First 1
1215	        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens) {
1216	            $Argv = @('-c', "model_context_window=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens)") + @($Argv)
1217	        }
1218	        if ($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens) {
1219	            $Argv = @('-c', "model_auto_compact_token_limit=$($entry.capabilities.limits.max_prompt_tokens)") + @($Argv)
1220	        }
1221	    }
1222	
1223	    $savedKey = $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY
1224	    $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = 'dummy'
1225	    try {
1226	        if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1227	            $cc = Get-SpecstoryCodexCmd
1228	            foreach ($a in @($providerArgs) + @($Argv)) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
1229	            specstory run codex -c $cc
1230	        } else { codex @providerArgs @Argv }
1231	    } finally {
1232	        if ($null -eq $savedKey) { Remove-Item env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1233	        else { $env:GITHUB_COPILOT_API_KEY = $savedKey }
1234	    }
1235	}

1243	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ---
1244	#
1245	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1246	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1247	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1248	# `-c "claude $args"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1249	# claude-copilot has args to pass through, which made these two disagree:
1250	#
1251	#   claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
1252	#   claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"
1253	#
1254	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1255	# truth for BOTH branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it.
1256	
1257	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1258	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > `claude`
1259	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1260	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1261	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1262	function script:Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd {
1263	    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
1264	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
1265	        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1266	            if ($line -match '^\s*claude_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
1267	                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
1268	                if ($v) { return $v }
1269	            }
1270	        }
1271	    }
1272	    'claude'
1273	}
1274	
1275	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
1276	# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes, so quoting is both possible
1277	# and necessary — an unquoted join flattens `-p "two words"` into two arguments.
1278	# POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
1279	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote {
1280	    param([string] $Value)
1281	    "'" + ($Value -replace "'", "'\''") + "'"
1282	}

1284	# --------------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot -----
1285	function claude-copilot {
1286	    [CmdletBinding()]
1287	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1288	    $ss = 'auto'
1289	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1290	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
1291	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1292	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1293	        Write-Host "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy. Sticky: copilot-here on"
1294	        Write-Host "  Runs claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions (hands-off proxy flow)."
1295	        return
1296	    }
1297	    if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1298	        if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -gt 0) {
1299	            # Rebuild what `-c` clobbers: the configured base command (ITS flags left
1300	            # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
1301	            $cc = Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd
1302	            foreach ($a in $Argv) { $cc = "$cc $(ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote $a)" }
1303	            copilot-run specstory run claude -c $cc
1304	        }
1305	        else { copilot-run specstory run claude }
1306	    } else {
1307	        # No specstory on PATH (the Windows default — no native CLI yet): run claude
1308	        # directly, still bypassing permission prompts so behaviour matches the
1309	        # specstory path regardless of whether specstory is installed.
1310	        copilot-run claude --dangerously-skip-permissions @Argv
1311	    }
1312	}

1314	# --------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot-once ------
1315	function claude-copilot-once {
1316	    [CmdletBinding()]
1317	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1318	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
1319	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1320	        Write-Host "  Pin this project to the proxy, run one session, auto-unpin (even on Ctrl-C)."
1321	        return
1322	    }
1323	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) {
1324	        Write-Error "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(Get-CopilotPort). Start it: copilot-proxy start"; return
1325	    }
1326	    $wasOn = $false
1327	    if (Test-Path '.claude/settings.local.json') {
1328	        try { if ((Get-Content -Raw '.claude/settings.local.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { $wasOn = $true } } catch { $null = $_ }
1329	    }
1330	    if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here on }
1331	    else {
1332	        # Already pinned here. If the pin drifted from current defaults (model bump,
1333	        # proxy moved, a key added since), offer to refresh it in place; otherwise
1334	        # leave it untouched. Either way it was already ON, so it stays ON on exit.
1335	        $drift = Get-CopilotHereDrift
1336	        if ($drift) {
1337	            Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: this project's copilot-here pin looks stale:"
1338	            $drift | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
1339	            if (Confirm-CopilotAction '  override with current defaults? (keep = default) [y/N]') { copilot-here on }
1340	            else { Write-Host 'claude-copilot-once: kept the existing pin (stays ON on exit).' }
1341	        } else {
1342	            Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: copilot-here already ON here — leaving the pin in place on exit."
1343	        }
1344	    }
1345	    try {
1346	        claude-copilot @Argv
1347	    } finally {
1348	        if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here off }
1349	        Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: session ended. Proxy still running on $(Get-CopilotBase)."
1350	    }
1351	}

1354	$script:CopilotHereKeys = @(
1355	    'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL', 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL',
1356	    'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL',
1357	    'CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC', 'CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER',
1358	    'CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION', 'CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY', 'DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS'
1359	)

1361	# y/N prompt. Returns $true only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive host
1362	# returns $false — the safe default (keep, don't override). Only called right
1363	# before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading input is fine.
1364	function script:Confirm-CopilotAction {
1365	    param([string] $Message = 'Proceed? [y/N]')
1366	    if (-not [Environment]::UserInteractive -or [Console]::IsInputRedirected) { return $false }
1367	    $ans = Read-Host -Prompt $Message
1368	    $ans -match '^\s*y(es)?\s*$'
1369	}
1370	
1371	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1372	# write now (default model bumped, proxy moved, a key added since the pin was
1373	# written)? Returns one "  KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key, or nothing.
1374	#
1375	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1376	# computed by diffing the live file against Get-CopilotEnvBlock — not a hand-picked
1377	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). The asymmetry is
1378	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1379	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1380	function script:Get-CopilotHereDrift {
1381	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1382	    if (-not (Test-Path $settings)) { return @() }
1383	    try { $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return @() }
1384	    # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent -> nothing to do.
1385	    if (-not $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { return @() }
1386	
1387	    $want = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1388	    $out = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1389	    foreach ($k in $want.Keys) {
1390	        $cur = if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k } else { '(unset)' }
1391	        if ($cur -ne $want[$k]) { $out.Add("  $k : $cur -> $($want[$k])") }
1392	    }
1393	    $out
1394	}
1395	
1396	function copilot-here {
1397	    [CmdletBinding()]
1398	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1399	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1400	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1401	    switch ($action) {
1402	        'on' {
1403	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.claude' | Out-Null
1404	            $obj = if (Test-Path $settings) { try { Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { [pscustomobject]@{} } } else { [pscustomobject]@{} }
1405	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties['env']) { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
1406	            # Single source of truth, shared with copilot-run and the drift check.
1407	            $envSet = Get-CopilotEnvBlock -Pinned
1408	            $model = $envSet.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
1409	            foreach ($k in $envSet.Keys) {
1410	                if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k = $envSet[$k] }
1411	                else { $obj.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $envSet[$k] }
1412	            }
1413	            $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
1414	            # Belt-and-braces gitignore via .git/info/exclude (un-anchored **/ form).
1415	            $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null
1416	            if ($gitDir) {
1417	                git check-ignore -q $settings 2>$null
1418	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
1419	                    $exclude = Join-Path $gitDir 'info/exclude'
1420	                    Add-Content -Path $exclude -Value '**/.claude/settings.local.json'
1421	                }
1422	            }
1423	            Write-Host "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $(Get-CopilotBase) (model: $model)"
1424	            if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { Write-Host "  WARNING proxy not running — start it: copilot-proxy start" }
1425	        }
```

```text
1	#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
2	# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
3	#
4	# Runs under pwsh via [interpreters.ps1] in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl. chezmoi pipes the
5	# CURRENT target file into stdin and takes the new contents from stdout.
6	#
7	# WHY AN OVERLAY (this replaced a plain managed dot_config/herdr/config.toml):
8	# herdr rewrites this file at runtime — the onboarding flag, in-app settings
9	# popups, [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state. A plain managed
10	# file clobbers all of that on every `chezmoi apply`, which can re-trigger
11	# onboarding. The parent (unix) repo hit this and moved create_ -> modify_ on
12	# 2026-07-06; this repo's config was added five days later and still used the
13	# plain form. Same fix, ported.
14	#
15	# MERGE MODEL — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
16	#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
17	#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
18	#   - Every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file that is NOT managed and NOT already in
19	#     the template is copied across (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
20	#     [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
21	#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins).
22	#   - FORCED single keys are re-asserted INTO a pulled-through table, so the table
23	#     keeps herdr's own bookkeeping. Windows needs exactly one: update.channel
24	#     must stay "preview" (the installer rejects "stable" on Windows builds), but
25	#     [update] also holds herdr's last-check state, which we do not want to wipe.
26	#     This sub-key merge is the one deliberate divergence from the unix overlay.
27	#
28	# WHY tomlkit (not a hand-rolled emitter): herdr's config has an array-of-tables
29	# ([[keys.command]]) and comments worth keeping; stdlib tomllib is read-only.
30	# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees >=3.11 -> stdlib tomllib), fall back to
31	# system python, then to emitting the raw template (a fresh host with neither
32	# still gets a full config — note we emit the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a
33	# fresh host stdin is empty).
34	#
35	# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
36	# Validate the result with `herdr server reload-config` (empty diagnostics).
37

95	
96	
97	def emit(text):

99	        fh.write(text)
100	
101	
102	try:
103	    import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
104	except ModuleNotFoundError:
105	    try:
106	        import tomli as tomllib
107	    except ModuleNotFoundError:
108	        # No TOML reader -> can't safely merge; ship the managed template as-is.
109	        emit(template_text)

122	
123	# Tables the template owns outright.
124	MANAGED = {"theme", "ui", "terminal", "keys"}
125	# Single keys re-asserted into an otherwise pulled-through table.
126	FORCED = {("update", "channel"): "preview"}

128	with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
129	    live_text = fh.read().strip()

132	try:

134	except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError:

137	    live = {}

140	    if key in MANAGED:

142	    if key in doc:
143	        # The template also declares this table. Keep herdr's runtime keys and
144	        # let the template win only on the keys it actually sets.
145	        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(doc[key], dict):
146	            for sub_key, sub_value in value.items():
147	                if sub_key not in doc[key]:
148	                    doc[key][sub_key] = sub_value
149	        continue
150	    doc[key] = value

152	for (table, sub_key), forced_value in FORCED.items():
153	    if table not in doc:

155	    doc[table][sub_key] = forced_value

167	    $rest = @($py[1..($py.Count - 1)]) + @($pyFile)
168	    & $exe @rest

172	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: merge failed (exit $rc); emitting managed template")
173	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($templateText)
174	        return
175	    }
```

```tmpl
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
# chezmoi modify_ script: enforce only Codex's native footer while preserving
# every unrelated live setting (providers, projects, plugins, feature flags).
# Runs under [interpreters.ps1]. Every failure emits the original stdin bytes
# unchanged: config recovery must be explicit, never an accidental overwrite.

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

function Write-StdoutBytes {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [AllowEmptyCollection()]
        [byte[]] $Bytes
    )

    $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
    $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
    $out.Flush()
}

function Write-PreservedInput {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string] $Message,

        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [AllowEmptyCollection()]
        [byte[]] $Bytes
    )

    [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: $Message; preserving live config unchanged")
    Write-StdoutBytes -Bytes $Bytes
}

function Test-StartsWithUtf8Bom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [AllowEmptyCollection()]
        [byte[]] $Bytes
    )

    return $Bytes.Length -ge 3 -and
        $Bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and
        $Bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and
        $Bytes[2] -eq 0xBF
}

$inputBuffer = [System.IO.MemoryStream]::new()
try {
    try {
        [Console]::OpenStandardInput().CopyTo($inputBuffer)
        [byte[]] $originalBytes = $inputBuffer.ToArray()
    } catch {
        [byte[]] $originalBytes = $inputBuffer.ToArray()
        Write-PreservedInput -Message "could not read stdin bytes: $($_.Exception.Message)" -Bytes $originalBytes
        return
    }
} finally {
    $inputBuffer.Dispose()
}

# Keep the original byte array immutable. Parsing gets a copy with at most one
# leading UTF-8 BOM removed; successful output is always newly encoded instead.
[byte[]] $parseBytes = [byte[]]::new($originalBytes.Length)
[System.Array]::Copy($originalBytes, $parseBytes, $originalBytes.Length)
$removedBom = Test-StartsWithUtf8Bom -Bytes $parseBytes
if ($removedBom) {
    [byte[]] $withoutBom = [byte[]]::new($parseBytes.Length - 3)
    if ($withoutBom.Length -gt 0) {
        [System.Array]::Copy($parseBytes, 3, $withoutBom, 0, $withoutBom.Length)
    }
    $parseBytes = $withoutBom
}

if ($removedBom -and (Test-StartsWithUtf8Bom -Bytes $parseBytes)) {
    Write-PreservedInput -Message 'multiple leading UTF-8 BOMs are not valid TOML' -Bytes $originalBytes
    return
}

$strictUtf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
try {
    $liveText = $strictUtf8.GetString($parseBytes)
} catch [System.Text.DecoderFallbackException] {
    Write-PreservedInput -Message "stdin is not valid UTF-8: $($_.Exception.Message)" -Bytes $originalBytes
    return
}

# TOML permits space, tab, LF, and CRLF as blank input. Do not let PowerShell's
# broader Unicode whitespace definition turn NBSP, a lone CR, or similar bytes
# into a fresh config silently; tomlkit must never be bypassed for those inputs.
$legalBlank = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::IsMatch(
    $liveText,
    '\A(?:[ \t]|\n|\r\n)*\z',
    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::CultureInvariant
)
if (-not $legalBlank -and [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($liveText)) {
    Write-PreservedInput -Message 'stdin contains whitespace that TOML does not allow as blank input' -Bytes $originalBytes
    return
}

$uv = Get-Command uv -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $uv) {
    Write-PreservedInput -Message 'uv was not found; the pinned TOML parser is unavailable' -Bytes $originalBytes
    return
}

$utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$overlayText = @'
{{ include (joinPath .chezmoi.sourceDir ".chezmoitemplates/agents/codex.config.overlay.toml") }}
'@

$tmpDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
$stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()
$overlayFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-overlay-$stamp.toml"
$liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-live-$stamp.toml"
$pyFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-merge-$stamp.py"
$outFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "codex-out-$stamp.toml"

try {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($overlayFile, $utf8.GetBytes($overlayText))
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($liveFile, $parseBytes)

    $pySource = @'
import sys

try:
    import tomlkit
except Exception as exc:
    print(f"modify_config.toml: pinned tomlkit parser is unavailable: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(10)

_, overlay_path, live_path, out_path = sys.argv

try:
    with open(overlay_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        overlay_text = fh.read()
    overlay = tomlkit.parse(overlay_text)
    status_line = overlay["tui"]["status_line"]
except Exception as exc:
    print(f"modify_config.toml: managed overlay is invalid: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(11)

try:
    with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        live_text = fh.read()
    live = tomlkit.parse(live_text)
except Exception as exc:
    print(f"modify_config.toml: live config is invalid TOML: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(12)

try:
    if "tui" not in live or not isinstance(live["tui"], dict):
        live["tui"] = tomlkit.table()
    live["tui"]["status_line"] = status_line

    output = tomlkit.dumps(live)
    output = output.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").rstrip("\n") + "\n"
    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(output.encode("utf-8"))
except Exception as exc:
    print(f"modify_config.toml: could not merge managed status line: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(13)
'@
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($pyFile, $pySource, $utf8)

    $uvArgs = @(
        'run', '--no-project', '--quiet',
        '--with', 'tomlkit==0.13.3',
        '--python', '>=3.11',
        'python', $pyFile, $overlayFile, $liveFile, $outFile
    )
    $uvExecutable = $uv.Source
    & $uvExecutable @uvArgs 1>$null
    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile -PathType Leaf)) {
        Write-PreservedInput -Message "pinned TOML merge failed (exit $rc)" -Bytes $originalBytes
        return
    }

    Write-StdoutBytes -Bytes ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($outFile))
} catch {
    Write-PreservedInput -Message "unexpected merge failure: $($_.Exception.Message)" -Bytes $originalBytes
} finally {
    foreach ($file in $overlayFile, $liveFile, $pyFile, $outFile) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $file -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
```

```ps1
BeforeAll {
    $RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    $TemplatePath = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl'
    $RenderedPath = Join-Path $TestDrive 'modify_config.toml.ps1'
    $BrokenOverlayPath = Join-Path $TestDrive 'modify_config-broken-overlay.toml.ps1'
    $Utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
    [byte[]] $Utf8Bom = 0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF
    $PwshPath = (Get-Command pwsh -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop).Source

    $rendered = & chezmoi execute-template --source $RepoRoot --file $TemplatePath
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to render Codex modifier' }
    $renderedText = $rendered -join "`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($RenderedPath, $renderedText, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

    $brokenOverlayText = $renderedText.Replace("[tui]`n#", "[tui`n#")
    if ($brokenOverlayText -eq $renderedText) { throw 'failed to construct broken Codex overlay fixture' }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($BrokenOverlayPath, $brokenOverlayText, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

    function ConvertTo-Hex {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
            [AllowEmptyCollection()]
            [byte[]] $Bytes
        )

        return [System.Convert]::ToHexString($Bytes)
    }

    function Assert-ExactBytes {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
            [AllowEmptyCollection()]
            [byte[]] $Actual,

            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
            [AllowEmptyCollection()]
            [byte[]] $Expected
        )

        (ConvertTo-Hex -Bytes $Actual) | Should -BeExactly (ConvertTo-Hex -Bytes $Expected)
    }

    function ConvertFrom-StrictUtf8 {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
            [AllowEmptyCollection()]
            [byte[]] $Bytes
        )

        return $Utf8.GetString($Bytes)
    }

    function Assert-SuccessfulMerge {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
            [psobject] $Result
        )

        $Result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $Result.Stderr | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        (ConvertFrom-StrictUtf8 -Bytes $Result.StdoutBytes) | Should -Match 'model-with-reasoning'
    }

    function Invoke-CodexModifier {
        param(
            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
            [AllowEmptyCollection()]
            [byte[]] $LiveBytes,

            [string] $ScriptPath = $RenderedPath,

            [hashtable] $Environment = @{}
        )

        $startInfo = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
        $startInfo.FileName = $PwshPath
        $startInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
        $startInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
        $startInfo.RedirectStandardInput = $true
        $startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
        $startInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-NoProfile')
        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-NonInteractive')
        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-File')
        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add($ScriptPath)
        foreach ($name in $Environment.Keys) {
            $startInfo.Environment[$name] = [string] $Environment[$name]
        }

        $process = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::new()
        $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
        $stdout = [System.IO.MemoryStream]::new()
        $stderr = [System.IO.MemoryStream]::new()
        try {
            if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'failed to start rendered Codex modifier' }
            $stdoutCopy = $process.StandardOutput.BaseStream.CopyToAsync($stdout)
            $stderrCopy = $process.StandardError.BaseStream.CopyToAsync($stderr)

            if ($LiveBytes.Length -gt 0) {
                $process.StandardInput.BaseStream.Write($LiveBytes, 0, $LiveBytes.Length)
            }
            $process.StandardInput.BaseStream.Close()

            $process.WaitForExit()
            $stdoutCopy.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            $stderrCopy.GetAwaiter().GetResult()

            return [pscustomobject]@{
                StdoutBytes = $stdout.ToArray()
                Stderr      = $Utf8.GetString($stderr.ToArray())
                ExitCode    = $process.ExitCode
            }
        } finally {
            $stdout.Dispose()
            $stderr.Dispose()
            $process.Dispose()
        }
    }
}

Describe 'Codex config byte-safe overlay' {
    It 'creates the managed status line from zero input bytes' {
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes ([byte[]]::new(0))

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $result
        $text = ConvertFrom-StrictUtf8 -Bytes $result.StdoutBytes
        $text | Should -Match '(?s)status_line\s*=.*model-with-reasoning.*fast-mode.*git-branch.*context-remaining.*task-progress.*current-dir'
        $text | Should -Not -Match 'five-hour-limit|weekly-limit'
    }

    It 'accepts only TOML-legal whitespace as blank input' {
        $liveBytes = $Utf8.GetBytes(" `t`n`r`n`t ")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $result
    }

    It 'accepts a UTF-8 BOM with no content' {
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $Utf8Bom

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $result
    }

    It 'removes one UTF-8 BOM from valid live TOML before parsing' {
        [byte[]] $liveBytes = $Utf8Bom + $Utf8.GetBytes("model = `"bom-model`"`r`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $result
        (ConvertFrom-StrictUtf8 -Bytes $result.StdoutBytes) | Should -Match 'model = "bom-model"'
    }

    It 'preserves a double BOM byte-for-byte with a diagnostic' {
        [byte[]] $liveBytes = $Utf8Bom + $Utf8Bom + $Utf8.GetBytes("model = `"untouched`"`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'multiple leading UTF-8 BOMs'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'does not treat NBSP as blank TOML' {
        [byte[]] $liveBytes = 0xC2, 0xA0
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'whitespace that TOML does not allow as blank input'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'preserves providers, projects, and nested TUI tables while replacing status_line' {
        $live = @'
model = "custom-model"

[model_providers.copilot]
base_url = "http://localhost:4142"

[model_providers.copilot.http_headers]
X-Custom = "preserve-me"

[projects."C:/src/project"]
trust_level = "trusted"

[tui]
status_line = ["old-status"]

[tui.keymap.editor]
insert_newline = ["ctrl-j"]
'@
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $Utf8.GetBytes($live)

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $result
        $text = ConvertFrom-StrictUtf8 -Bytes $result.StdoutBytes
        $text | Should -Match 'model = "custom-model"'
        $text | Should -Match 'base_url = "http://localhost:4142"'
        $text | Should -Match 'X-Custom = "preserve-me"'
        $text | Should -Match '(?s)\[projects\."C:/src/project"\].*trust_level = "trusted"'
        $text | Should -Match '(?s)\[tui\.keymap\.editor\].*insert_newline = \["ctrl-j"\]'
        $text | Should -Not -Match 'old-status'
    }

    It 'preserves malformed TOML with LF byte-for-byte and diagnoses the parser failure' {
        $liveBytes = $Utf8.GetBytes("model = [`nprovider = `"still here`"`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'live config is invalid TOML'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'preserves malformed TOML with CRLF byte-for-byte and diagnoses the parser failure' {
        $liveBytes = $Utf8.GetBytes("model = [`r`nprovider = `"still here`"`r`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'live config is invalid TOML'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'preserves invalid UTF-8 byte-for-byte with a diagnostic' {
        [byte[]] $liveBytes = 0x6D, 0x6F, 0x64, 0x65, 0x6C, 0x20, 0x3D, 0x20, 0x22, 0xC3, 0x28, 0x22, 0x0A
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'stdin is not valid UTF-8'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'preserves valid input when uv is absent instead of using bare Python' {
        $liveBytes = $Utf8.GetBytes("model = `"no-parser`"`r`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes -Environment @{ PATH = $TestDrive }

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'uv was not found'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'preserves valid input when the managed overlay cannot be parsed' {
        $liveBytes = $Utf8.GetBytes("model = `"overlay-failure`"`r`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes -ScriptPath $BrokenOverlayPath

        $result.ExitCode | Should -Be 0
        $result.Stderr | Should -Match 'managed overlay is invalid'
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $result.StdoutBytes -Expected $liveBytes
    }

    It 'normalizes successful output to BOM-free LF with exactly one final LF' {
        [byte[]] $liveBytes = $Utf8Bom + $Utf8.GetBytes("model = `"normalize-me`"`r`n`r`n[tui]`r`nstatus_line = [`"old`"]`r`n`r`n")
        $result = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $result
        $result.StdoutBytes.Length | Should -BeGreaterThan 3
        (ConvertTo-Hex -Bytes $result.StdoutBytes[0..2]) | Should -Not -BeExactly 'EFBBBF'
        $result.StdoutBytes | Should -Not -Contain 0x0D
        $result.StdoutBytes[-1] | Should -Be 0x0A
        $result.StdoutBytes[-2] | Should -Not -Be 0x0A
    }

    It 'is byte-idempotent after the first successful merge' {
        $liveBytes = $Utf8.GetBytes("model = `"stable`"`r`n`r`n[tui]`r`nstatus_line = [`"old`"]`r`n")
        $first = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $liveBytes
        $second = Invoke-CodexModifier -LiveBytes $first.StdoutBytes

        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $first
        Assert-SuccessfulMerge -Result $second
        Assert-ExactBytes -Actual $second.StdoutBytes -Expected $first.StdoutBytes
    }
}
```

````md
# `modify_config.toml: invalid TOML ... Empty key at line 1 col 0`

**Symptoms** (grep this section): `chezmoi update --init` or `chezmoi apply`
prints:

```text
modify_config.toml: invalid TOML; preserving live config unchanged: Empty key at line 1 col 0
```

The existing `~/.codex/config.toml` looks empty or valid in an editor, and the
managed `tui.status_line` is not applied.
**First seen**: 2026-08
**Affects**: Windows dotfiles at the first `modify_`-based Codex footer release,
when the live config starts with a UTF-8 BOM.
**Status**: fixed — the modifier accepts one BOM and preserves every failure path
byte-for-byte.

## Symptom

The parser reports an empty key at the very first column even though line 1 does
not contain an empty TOML assignment. Missing and ordinary zero-byte files work;
an existing file created by a Windows editor can fail.

A separate CI symptom had the same outward result (the old status line survived):
Python existed on `windows-latest`, but `tomlkit` did not. The old Pester helper
discarded stderr, so the import failure was hidden.

## Root cause

The first implementation read stdin through `[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()`.
`Console.In` decoded the leading UTF-8 BOM into the literal character U+FEFF;
`[string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([char]0xFEFF)` is false, so the fresh-input shortcut
did not run. The parsing copy still began with U+FEFF. TOML permits space, tab,
LF, and CRLF as whitespace, not U+FEFF, so `tomlkit` attempted to parse a key,
consumed zero valid key characters, and raised `Empty key at line 1 col 0`.

The same text-mode path also made “preserving unchanged” weaker than advertised:
invalid UTF-8 could be replaced during decode, and Python universal-newline reads
could turn CRLF into LF.

References:

- [TOML 1.0 whitespace and newline grammar](https://toml.io/en/v1.0.0)
- [.NET `Console` implementation](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/v8.0.0/src/libraries/System.Console/src/System/ConsolePal.Windows.cs)
- [`tomlkit` parser](https://github.com/python-poetry/tomlkit/blob/0.13.3/tomlkit/parser.py)

## Workaround

Apply the fixed modifier. It reads stdin as bytes, strips exactly one BOM only
from the parsing copy, and emits successful output as UTF-8 without BOM:

```powershell
chezmoi apply ~/.codex/config.toml
```

Before the fix, remove one BOM only after backing up the file:

```powershell
$p = Join-Path $HOME '.codex/config.toml'
Copy-Item $p "$p.bak"
$text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
if ($text.Length -gt 0 -and $text[0] -eq [char]0xFEFF) {
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $text.Substring(1), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
}
chezmoi apply $p
```

Do not replace or truncate a nonblank file merely because parsing failed; it may
contain providers, project trust, plugins, or credentials that the overlay must
preserve.

## Prevention

- Treat a `modify_` target as a byte stream until parsing succeeds.
- Decode with strict UTF-8 and retain the original bytes for every fail-closed
  return.
- Accept at most one leading BOM; do not use `.IsNullOrWhiteSpace()` as TOML’s
  whitespace grammar.
- Capture stderr and assert bytes in Pester. Include BOM-only, BOM-prefixed valid
  TOML, malformed CRLF, invalid UTF-8, double-BOM, and idempotence cases.
- Provision the same pinned parser runtime in CI and seed a non-empty target before
  `chezmoi apply`; an empty target does not exercise the merge path.

## Related

- [`docs/codex-status-line.md`](../docs/codex-status-line.md)
- [`dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl`](../dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl)
- [`tests/CodexConfig.Tests.ps1`](../tests/CodexConfig.Tests.ps1)
````

````md
# `npm ETARGET` is followed by `copilot-proxy doctor` saying the requested version is installed

**Symptoms** (grep this section): `copilot-proxy restart` prints:

```text
copilot-proxy: installing @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0 (one-time — later starts skip this) ...
npm error code ETARGET
npm error notarget No matching version found for @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0.
copilot-proxy: starting (@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0) on port 4141 ...
```

A subsequent doctor contradicts npm:

```text
Package
  ✓ installed        @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0
```

The proxy can listen and serve models because it actually launched an older tree
left in `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`.
**First seen**: 2026-08
**Affects**: the Windows Copilot module before installed `package.json` metadata
became the installation postcondition, especially after the pin changed from
`1.13.14` to `2.1.0` on a lagging corporate npm mirror.
**Status**: fixed — stale package contents cannot satisfy readiness or receive a
new stamp.

## Root cause

The old installer used this success test after npm/Bun exited:

1. any `node_modules/.bin/copilot-api*` shim exists, **or**
2. any `node_modules/@jeffreycao/copilot-api` directory exists.

It did not read that package’s `package.json`. When npm returned `ETARGET`, the
old package tree remained, the weak filesystem predicate returned true, and the
installer wrote the **requested string** `@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0` to
`.installed-spec`. Doctor trusted that stamp plus the same old directory/binlink,
so it claimed 2.1.0 and `start` launched the stale binary.

The exact 2.1.0 release exists on public npm. In the first report, `ETARGET` was
therefore consistent with the configured corporate pull-through mirror not having
synchronized that version yet—not evidence that the public package never existed.

Reference: [public npm metadata for 2.1.0](https://registry.npmjs.org/@jeffreycao%2Fcopilot-api/2.1.0).

## Workaround

First identify the registry and verify the exact pin **before** deleting the
working prefix:

```powershell
npm config get registry
npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' version
# Compare only where direct public npm is permitted:
npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

If only the corporate mirror is missing 2.1.0, wait/request synchronization or
use an approved registry for the reinstall. Then deploy the fixed module and
reinstall:

```powershell
chezmoi apply ~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot/Copilot.psm1
copilot-proxy reinstall
copilot-proxy doctor
```

Do not switch the managed pin to `latest`; that trades a diagnosable mirror delay
for an unreviewed gateway upgrade.

## Prevention

- Read installed `package.json.name` and `.version`; a directory or binlink is not
  proof of which package landed.
- Store requested spec plus verified installed name/version in the stamp, and
  compare the stamp back to live metadata on every readiness check.
- Write the stamp only after metadata and a runnable launch path agree.
- Keep filesystem metadata as the authoritative postcondition. The existing
  Windows `Start-Process` child shape has returned misleading exit-code data, so
  exit status alone is insufficient.
- Test the exact regression: stale 1.13.14 tree + desired 2.1.0 + failed installer
  must return false, write no 2.1.0 stamp, and never reach proxy launch.

## Related

- [`copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module`](copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module.md)
- [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
- [`docs/copilot-proxy.md`](../docs/copilot-proxy.md)
````

```text
303	+function script:ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText {
304	+    param($Value, [int] $MaxLength = 320)
305	+    $text = if ($Value -is [string]) { $Value } else {
306	+        try { $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress -ErrorAction Stop } catch { [string]$Value }
307	+    }
308	+    $text = ($text -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
309	+    if ($text.Length -gt $MaxLength) { return $text.Substring(0, $MaxLength - 3) + '...' }
310	+    $text
311	+}
```
