313	+# Error bodies appear as direct code/message pairs, error.code/error.message, or
314	+# another JSON error encoded inside error.message. Normalize all three shapes.
315	+function script:Get-CopilotApiError {
316	+    param($Body, [int] $Depth = 0)
317	+    $raw = ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText $Body
318	+    if ($Depth -gt 4) {
319	+        return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw }
320	+    }
321	+
322	+    $object = $Body
323	+    if ($Body -is [string]) {
324	+        try { $object = $Body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop }
325	+        catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
326	+    }
327	+    if (-not $object) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
328	+
329	+    $container = $object
330	+    if ($object.PSObject.Properties['error']) {
331	+        $container = $object.error
332	+        if ($container -is [string]) {
333	+            $nestedError = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $container -Depth ($Depth + 1)
334	+            if ($nestedError.Code -or $nestedError.Message) { return $nestedError }
335	+        }
336	+    }
337	+
338	+    $code = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['code']) { [string]$container.code } else { $null }
339	+    $message = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['message']) { [string]$container.message } else { $null }
340	+    if ($message -and $message.TrimStart().StartsWith('{')) {
341	+        $nestedMessage = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $message -Depth ($Depth + 1)
342	+        if ($nestedMessage.Code -or $nestedMessage.Message) { return $nestedMessage }
343	+    }
344	+    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Message = $message; Raw = $raw }
345	+}
346	+
347	+function script:Classify-CopilotInferenceError {
348	+    param([int] $StatusCode, $Body)
349	+    $errorInfo = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $Body
350	+    $code = ([string]$errorInfo.Code).ToLowerInvariant()
351	+    $detailParts = @($errorInfo.Code, $errorInfo.Message) | Where-Object { $_ }
352	+    $detail = $detailParts -join ': '
353	+    if (-not $detail) { $detail = $errorInfo.Raw }
354	+
355	+    if ($StatusCode -eq 402 -and $code -eq 'billing_not_configured') {
356	+        return [pscustomobject]@{
357	+            Kind        = 'BillingNotConfigured'
358	+            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
359	+            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
360	+            Summary     = "account-wide GitHub Copilot billing is not configured: $detail"
361	+            Retryable   = $false
362	+            AccountWide = $true
363	+            Action      = 'https://github.com/settings/copilot/features'
364	+            Guidance    = 'Enable Copilot billing/features for the account. Changing the model, using --auto, or enabling the shim cannot fix this account-wide failure.'
365	+        }
366	+    }
367	+
368	+    if ($code -match '^(model_not_supported|model_unsupported|unsupported_model)$') {
369	+        return [pscustomobject]@{
370	+            Kind        = 'ModelUnsupported'
371	+            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
372	+            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
373	+            Summary     = $detail
374	+            Retryable   = $false
375	+            AccountWide = $false
376	+            Action      = 'Run copilot-model --auto, or copilot-model -l and select a model advertised by the live catalog.'
377	+            Guidance    = $null
378	+        }
379	+    }
380	+
381	+    [pscustomobject]@{
382	+        Kind        = 'HttpError'
383	+        Code        = $errorInfo.Code
384	+        Message     = $errorInfo.Message
385	+        Summary     = $detail
386	+        Retryable   = ($StatusCode -eq 429 -or $StatusCode -ge 500)
387	+        AccountWide = $false
388	+        Action      = $null
389	+        Guidance    = $null
390	+    }
391	+}

+    function Invoke-CodexModifier {
+        param(
+            [Parameter(Mandatory)]
+            [AllowEmptyCollection()]
+            [byte[]] $LiveBytes,
+
+            [string] $ScriptPath = $RenderedPath,
+
+            [hashtable] $Environment = @{}
+        )
+
+        $startInfo = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
+        $startInfo.FileName = $PwshPath
+        $startInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
+        $startInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
+        $startInfo.RedirectStandardInput = $true
+        $startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+        $startInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
+        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-NoProfile')
+        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-NonInteractive')
+        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-File')
+        $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add($ScriptPath)
+        foreach ($name in $Environment.Keys) {
+            $startInfo.Environment[$name] = [string] $Environment[$name]
+        }
+
+        $process = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::new()
+        $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
+        $stdout = [System.IO.MemoryStream]::new()
+        $stderr = [System.IO.MemoryStream]::new()
+        try {
+            if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'failed to start rendered Codex modifier' }
+            $stdoutCopy = $process.StandardOutput.BaseStream.CopyToAsync($stdout)
+            $stderrCopy = $process.StandardError.BaseStream.CopyToAsync($stderr)
+
+            if ($LiveBytes.Length -gt 0) {
+                $process.StandardInput.BaseStream.Write($LiveBytes, 0, $LiveBytes.Length)
+            }
+            $process.StandardInput.BaseStream.Close()
+
+            $process.WaitForExit()
+            $stdoutCopy.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+            $stderrCopy.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+
+            return [pscustomobject]@{
+                StdoutBytes = $stdout.ToArray()
+                Stderr      = $Utf8.GetString($stderr.ToArray())
+                ExitCode    = $process.ExitCode
+            }
+        } finally {
+            $stdout.Dispose()
+            $stderr.Dispose()
+            $process.Dispose()
+        }
     }
 }

1	# Copilot.psm1 — GitHub Copilot agent gateway for Claude Code and Codex, native
2	# PowerShell port of the POSIX 43_copilot_proxy.sh / 44_copilot_embed.sh.
3	#
4	# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (npm @jeffreycao/copilot-api) from a pinned
5	# local install so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code and Codex.
6	# The optional Bun throttle shim (copilot-throttle-shim.js) is reused verbatim from
7	# the unix side.
8	#
9	# Public commands (exported with their original hyphenated names for muscle
10	# memory — PSUseApprovedVerbs is intentionally waived):
11	#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]
12	#   copilot-run <cmd...>            run a command with the proxy env injected
13	#   claude-copilot [args...]        one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
14	#   claude-copilot-once [args...]   pinned one-shot session, auto-reverted
15	#   codex-copilot [args...]         one-off Codex session on Responses proxy
16	#   codex-copilot-once [args...]    identical zero-persistence alias
17	# (claude-copilot / -once run claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions — the
18	#  proxy flow is the trusted, hands-off path; plain `claude` is unaffected.)
19	#   copilot-here [on|off|status]    per-project pin via ./.claude/settings.local.json
20	#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto]  switch the pinned model
21	#   copilot-embed [--model M] [--json] [TEXT|-] | -l
22	#   semsearch index [PATH...] | semsearch <QUERY> [-k N] [--corpus PATH]
23	#
24	# Contract preserved from the unix version: token at
25	# ~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token, ports 4141 (proxy) / 4142 (shim),
26	# state under $XDG_STATE_HOME/copilot-proxy, per-project ./.claude/settings.local.json
27	# pin, default model gpt-5.6-sol[1m], and the ANTHROPIC_* env block.
28	#
29	# The pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into $XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg and the
30	# proxy runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
31	# bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever resolving
32	# through a socks proxy — which wedged `start` at "Resolving dependencies" AND kept
33	# bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too. Force a re-install with
34	# `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
35	#
36	# Env knobs:
37	#   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default 4141    - port the proxy listens on
38	#   COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT default 45 - seconds allowed for model refresh
39	#   COPILOT_SHIM_PORT    default 4142    - throttle shim port
40	#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0 - spec to install
41	#                                          (changing it re-installs via the stamp)
42	#   COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL                 - override the pinned model
43	#   COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET  1               - add the telemetry-suppressing env keys
44	#   COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY 1            - skip straight to the no-proxy install try
45	#   COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY   default auto    - Node->GitHub /models egress:
46	#                          auto   = use the Windows System Proxy (WinINET registry)
47	#                                   or HTTPS_PROXY when either is set; Node ignores
48	#                                   the system setting unless it is passed the env.
49	#                          always = same, but warn when no proxy is found
50	#                          never  = never pass --proxy-env
51	#                          http://127.0.0.1:PORT = force that URL
52	
53	Set-StrictMode -Off
54	
55	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers ---
56	function script:Get-CopilotPort { if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_PORT) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_PORT } else { '4141' } }
57	function script:Get-CopilotPkg  { if ($env:COPILOT_API_PKG)   { $env:COPILOT_API_PKG }   else { '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0' } }
58	function script:Get-CopilotPkgFlavor {
59	    switch -Regex (Get-CopilotPkg) { '^copilot-api(@.*)?$' { 'original' } default { 'fork' } }
60	}
61	function script:Get-CopilotBase    { "http://localhost:$(Get-CopilotPort)" }
62	function script:Get-CopilotTmp     { if ($env:TEMP) { $env:TEMP } else { [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath() } }
63	function script:Get-CopilotLogFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).log" }
64	function script:Get-CopilotPidFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).pid" }

67	function script:Get-XdgState { if ($env:XDG_STATE_HOME) { $env:XDG_STATE_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/state' } }
68	function script:Get-XdgConfig { if ($env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME) { $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.config' } }
69	function script:Get-XdgData { if ($env:XDG_DATA_HOME) { $env:XDG_DATA_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share' } }

71	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -----------
72	#
73	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
74	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
75	# proxy (a browser/curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
76	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so
77	# every retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and
78	# running the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm
79	# start does zero network before it binds the port.
80	
81	# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
82	# The naive "split on @" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
83	# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
84	function script:Get-CopilotPkgName {
85	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
86	    if ($spec.TrimStart('@') -match '@') { $spec -replace '@[^@]*$', '' } else { $spec }
87	}
88	
89	function script:Get-CopilotPkgPrefix { Join-Path (Get-XdgData) 'copilot-api/pkg' }
90	# Records verified installed metadata, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the pinned
91	# default) re-installs instead of silently running an old or partial tree.
92	function script:Get-CopilotPkgStamp { Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) '.installed-spec' }
93	
94	# Exact npm selectors can be verified against installed package metadata. Tags,
95	# ranges, aliases and git/file selectors are deliberately non-exact.
96	function script:Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion {
97	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
98	    $name = Get-CopilotPkgName
99	    if ($spec.Length -le $name.Length) { return $null }
100	    $selector = $spec.Substring($name.Length)
101	    if ($selector -match '^@v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$') {
102	        return $Matches[1]
103	    }
104	    $null
105	}
106	
107	function script:Get-CopilotPkgMetadata {
108	    $path = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) "node_modules/$(Get-CopilotPkgName)/package.json"
109	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
110	    try {
111	        $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
112	        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.name) -or
113	            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.version)) { return $null }
114	        [pscustomobject]@{
115	            Name    = [string]$json.name
116	            Version = [string]$json.version
117	            Path    = $path
118	        }
119	    } catch { $null }
120	}
121	
122	function script:Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata {
123	    $path = Get-CopilotPkgStamp
124	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
125	    try {
126	        $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
127	        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.requestedSpec) -or
128	            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.name) -or
129	            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.version)) { return $null }
130	        [pscustomobject]@{
131	            RequestedSpec = [string]$json.requestedSpec
132	            Name          = [string]$json.name
133	            Version       = [string]$json.version
134	        }
135	    } catch { $null }
136	}
137	
138	function script:Get-CopilotPkgLegacyStamp {
139	    $path = Get-CopilotPkgStamp
140	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
141	    try {
142	        $raw = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop).Trim()
143	        if ($raw -and -not $raw.StartsWith('{')) { return $raw }
144	    } catch { $null }
145	    $null
146	}
147	
148	function script:Write-CopilotPkgStamp {
149	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] $Metadata)
150	    [ordered]@{
151	        requestedSpec = Get-CopilotPkg
152	        name          = [string]$Metadata.Name
153	        version       = [string]$Metadata.Version
154	    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotPkgStamp) -Encoding utf8
155	}
156	
157	# The binlink bun wrote, if any. Bun on Windows writes node_modules/.bin/<name>.exe
158	# (plus a .bunx sidecar); the other extensions cover an npm/yarn-populated prefix.
159	# Returns $null when no directly-runnable shim exists — Get-CopilotPkgLaunch then
160	# falls back to `bun run`, which resolves from the local node_modules offline.
161	function script:Get-CopilotPkgBin {
162	    $binDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/.bin'
163	    foreach ($ext in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat', '', '.ps1') {
164	        $p = Join-Path $binDir "copilot-api$ext"
165	        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { return $p }
166	    }
167	    $null
168	}
169	
170	# How to invoke the installed proxy: @{ Exe; Pre; Cwd }. Cwd is non-null only for
171	# the `bun run` fallback, which must resolve node_modules/.bin from the prefix.
172	#
173	# The prefix is deliberately NOT passed as an argument (`bun run --cwd <path>`):
174	# Start-Process joins -ArgumentList with spaces and does no quoting, so a prefix
175	# under a $HOME containing a space ("C:\Users\Da-Wei Lee\...") would arrive split
176	# across two argv entries. -WorkingDirectory takes the path as a real parameter.
177	function script:Get-CopilotPkgLaunch {
178	    $bin = Get-CopilotPkgBin
179	    # .ps1 can't be Start-Process'd directly, and a bare extensionless shim is a
180	    # shell script — route both through `bun run`, which finds node_modules/.bin.
181	    if ($bin -and [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($bin) -in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat') {
182	        return @{ Exe = $bin; Pre = @(); Cwd = $null }
183	    }
184	    if (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
185	        return @{ Exe = 'bun'; Pre = @('run', 'copilot-api'); Cwd = (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) }
186	    }
187	    $null
188	}
189	
190	# Did the requested package actually land in the prefix and remain runnable?
191	# Metadata is authoritative: a stale directory or binlink alone never satisfies
192	# this postcondition. Exact selectors must also match the installed version.
193	function script:Test-CopilotPkgInstalled {
194	    param($Metadata = (Get-CopilotPkgMetadata))
195	    if (-not $Metadata) { return $false }
196	    if ($Metadata.Name -cne (Get-CopilotPkgName)) { return $false }
197	    $exactVersion = Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion
198	    if ($exactVersion -and $Metadata.Version -cne $exactVersion) { return $false }
199	    $null -ne (Get-CopilotPkgLaunch)
200	}
201	
202	# Is the CURRENT selector installed, stamped with verified metadata and runnable?
203	function script:Test-CopilotPkgReady {
204	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
205	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) { return $false }
206	    $stamp = Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata
207	    if (-not $stamp) { return $false }
208	    ($stamp.RequestedSpec -ceq (Get-CopilotPkg)) -and
209	        ($stamp.Name -ceq $metadata.Name) -and
210	        ($stamp.Version -ceq $metadata.Version)
211	}
212	
213	# Remove only the requested package and its dedicated launch shims. This ensures a
214	# failed ETARGET/install cannot pass its postcondition by inheriting an old tree.
215	function script:Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget {
216	    $packageDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) "node_modules/$(Get-CopilotPkgName)"
217	    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $packageDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
218	    $binDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/.bin'
219	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $binDir) {
220	        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $binDir -Filter 'copilot-api*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
221	            Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
222	    }
223	}
224	
225	# One package-install attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. npm is preferred
226	# because it supports Azure Artifacts' credential-provider token in ~/.npmrc;
227	# Bun does not. -NoProxy strips the proxy env for the child. Returns $true only
228	# when matching metadata and a runnable launch path exist afterwards.
229	#
230	# Success is judged from the FILESYSTEM, not $p.ExitCode: a Start-Process -PassThru
231	# object reports ExitCode 0 even for a child that exited non-zero (verified — the
232	# .Handle-caching workaround does not help either), so trusting it would let a
233	# failed install write the .installed-spec stamp and silently pin a broken prefix.
234	#
235	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
236	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
237	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
238	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry {
239	    param([string] $Dir, [switch] $NoProxy, [int] $BudgetSeconds)
240	
241	    Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget
242	    $proxyVars = 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy'
243	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
244	    $installer = if ($npm) {
245	        @{ File = $npm.Source; Args = @('install', '--no-save', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', (Get-CopilotPkg)) }
246	    } else {
247	        Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm).'
248	        @{ File = 'bun'; Args = @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') }
249	    }
250	    $saved = @{}
251	    if ($NoProxy) {
252	        foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
253	    }
254	    try {
255	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $installer.File -ArgumentList $installer.Args `
256	            -WorkingDirectory $Dir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
257	        if ($p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) { return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled) }
258	        Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
259	        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the install lock.
260	        $name = [regex]::Escape((Get-CopilotPkgName))
261	        Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
262	            Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'bun.exe', 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match '\b(add|install)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
263	            ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
264	        return $false
265	    } catch {
266	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch package installer ($_)"; return $false
267	    } finally {
268	        if ($NoProxy) {
269	            foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
270	                if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
271	                else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
272	            }
273	        }
274	    }
275	}
276	
277	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
278	function script:Install-CopilotPkg {
279	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) { return $true }
280	
281	    # Migrate the old one-line stamp without a network call only when an exact
282	    # selector, the legacy stamp, live package metadata and launch path all agree.
283	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
284	    if ((Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion) -and
285	        (Get-CopilotPkgLegacyStamp) -ceq (Get-CopilotPkg) -and
286	        (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
287	        Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
288	        return $true
289	    }
290	
291	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
292	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return $false
293	    }
294	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg; $prefix = Get-CopilotPkgPrefix
295	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $prefix | Out-Null
296	    # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
297	    $pkgJson = Join-Path $prefix 'package.json'
298	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pkgJson)) {
299	        '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' | Set-Content -Path $pkgJson -Encoding utf8
300	    }
301	
302	    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
303	    # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
304	    # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
305	    # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
306	    # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
307	    $skipFirst = ($env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY -eq '1')
308	    if ($skipFirst -or -not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -BudgetSeconds 45)) {
309	        if (-not $skipFirst) {
310	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: install failed or stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..."
311	            # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
312	            # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
313	            $bunHome = if ($env:BUN_INSTALL) { $env:BUN_INSTALL } else { Join-Path $HOME '.bun' }
314	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $bunHome 'install/cache/.tmp') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
315	        }
316	        if (-not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -NoProxy -BudgetSeconds 90)) {
317	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'."; return $false
318	        }
319	    }
320	
321	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
322	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
323	        $actual = if ($metadata) { "$($metadata.Name)@$($metadata.Version)" } else { 'no readable package metadata' }
324	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: install finished but $actual does not satisfy $spec with a runnable launch path under $prefix."
325	        return $false
326	    }
327	    Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
328	    $true
329	}
330	
331	# Run a copilot-api subcommand (auth / check-usage / debug) in the foreground.
332	# Honours $launch.Cwd so the `bun run` fallback resolves node_modules/.bin.
333	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand {
334	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argument)
335	    if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
336	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
337	    if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api — try 'copilot-proxy reinstall'"; return }
338	    if ($launch.Cwd) { Push-Location $launch.Cwd }
339	    try {
340	        & $launch.Exe @($launch.Pre + $Argument)
341	        $commandExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
342	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = $commandExitCode
343	        if ($commandExitCode -ne 0) {
344	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: copilot-api $($Argument -join ' ') failed with exit code $commandExitCode"
345	        }
346	    } finally { if ($launch.Cwd) { Pop-Location } }
347	}
348	
349	# Live `bun add … copilot-api` processes. Install is a one-shot, so a match at
350	# rest is a clean stale-installer signal: a stalled one keeps bun's global
351	# install-cache lock, which wedges every later install too. Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry
352	# bounds and kills its own attempts, so this should stay empty — it remains as a
353	# safety net for a stall we didn't spawn (e.g. a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`).
354	function script:Get-CopilotStaleInstaller {
355	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
356	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '\badd\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'copilot-api' }
357	}

361	function script:Get-CopilotShimPort   { if ($env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT) { $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT } else { '4142' } }
362	function script:Get-CopilotShimBase   { "http://localhost:$(Get-CopilotShimPort)" }
363	function script:Get-CopilotShimScript { Join-Path (Get-XdgConfig) 'powershell/copilot-throttle-shim.js' }
364	function script:Get-CopilotShimLog    { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-shim-$(Get-CopilotShimPort).log" }
365	function script:Get-CopilotShimPid    { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-shim-$(Get-CopilotShimPort).pid" }
366	function script:Get-CopilotShimState  { Join-Path (Get-XdgState) 'copilot-proxy/shim' }
367	function script:Get-CopilotModelState { Join-Path (Get-XdgState) 'copilot-proxy/model' }

369	# --- egress: which proxy should Node use for the GitHub /models fetch? --------
370	#
371	# copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for the whole process
372	# lifetime, and GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog on some egress paths. Node
373	# does NOT honour the Windows System Proxy on its own — it only sees HTTP(S)_PROXY
374	# — so a host whose browser reaches the unfiltered catalog could still have the
375	# proxy cache a Claude-less list, which then looks exactly like an entitlement
376	# problem. Resolve the URL here and hand it to the child explicitly.
377	#
378	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY: auto|always|never|<url>. Returns a URL or $null.
379	function script:Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy {
380	    $mode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
381	    switch -Regex ($mode) {
382	        '^(never|off|0|false|no)$' { return $null }
383	        '^(http|https|socks5h?)://' { return $mode }
384	        '^(always|auto|on|1|true|yes)$' { break }
385	        default {
386	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)"
387	            return $null
388	        }
389	    }
390	
391	    # The Windows System Proxy (WinINET). This is what Clash Verge / mihomo /
392	    # v2rayN write when their "System Proxy" toggle is on, so reading it covers
393	    # the same ground the unix side gets from its Clash detector.
394	    try {
395	        $key = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction Stop
396	        if ($key.ProxyEnable -eq 1 -and $key.ProxyServer) {
397	            # ProxyServer is either "host:port" or "http=host:port;https=host:port".
398	            $server = $key.ProxyServer
399	            if ($server -match '(?:^|;)\s*https?=([^;]+)') { $server = $Matches[1] }
400	            elseif ($server -match ';') { $server = ($server -split ';')[0] }
401	            if ($server) { return "http://$($server -replace '^https?://', '')" }
402	        }
403	    } catch { $null = $_ }
404	
405	    # Fallback: an explicit env proxy in this shell.
406	    foreach ($v in $env:HTTPS_PROXY, $env:https_proxy, $env:HTTP_PROXY, $env:http_proxy) {
407	        if ($v) { return $v }
408	    }
409	    $null
410	}
411	
412	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW, for the direct-vs-proxied
413	# A/B in doctor. -Via: 'direct' forces no proxy, a URL forces that proxy, absent
414	# uses .NET defaults. Returns sorted-unique ids, or $null on any failure.
415	#
416	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens only ever travel in request headers — never in
417	# a command line, never echoed.
418	function script:Get-CopilotUpstreamModel {
419	    param([string] $Via)
420	
421	    $tokFile = Get-CopilotToken
422	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokFile)) { return $null }
423	    $ghu = Get-Content -First 1 $tokFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
424	    if (-not $ghu) { return $null }
425	
426	    $transport = @{}
427	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
428	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
429	
430	    try {
431	        $ex = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token' -TimeoutSec 10 `
432	            -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "token $ghu"; 'user-agent' = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' } `
433	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
434	    } catch { return $null }
435	
436	    $api = if ($ex.endpoints.api) { $ex.endpoints.api } else { 'https://api.githubcopilot.com' }
437	    if (-not $ex.token) { return $null }
438	
439	    try {
440	        $up = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$api/models" -TimeoutSec 12 `
441	            -Headers @{
442	                'Authorization'            = "Bearer $($ex.token)"
443	                'user-agent'               = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7'
444	                'copilot-integration-id'   = 'vscode-chat'
445	            } @transport -ErrorAction Stop
446	    } catch { return $null }
447	
448	    @($up.data.id | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
449	}
450	
451	# Optional ChatGPT Apps reachability. This is deliberately separate from the
452	# Copilot inference probes: codex_apps is a remote MCP served by chatgpt.com,
453	# not a localhost bridge to Codex.app and not part of GitHub Copilot.
454	function script:Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind {
455	    param($ErrorRecord)
456	
457	    $message = if ($ErrorRecord -is [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]) {
458	        $ErrorRecord.Exception.ToString()
459	    } else { [string]$ErrorRecord }
460	
461	    if ($message -match '(?i)timed?\s*out|timeout|operation.*canceled|deadline') { return 'timeout' }
462	    if ($message -match '(?i)certificate|authenticationexception|ssl|tls|secure channel') { return 'tls' }
463	    'network'
464	}
465	
466	function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
467	    param(
468	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
469	        [string] $Via = 'direct'
470	    )
471	
472	    $transport = @{}
473	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
474	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
475	
476	    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
477	    try {
478	        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12 `
479	            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `
480	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
481	        $sw.Stop()
482	        [pscustomobject]@{
483	            Reached = $true
484	            Code    = [int]$response.StatusCode
485	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
486	            Kind    = $null
487	            Error   = $null
488	        }
489	    } catch {
490	        $sw.Stop()
491	        [pscustomobject]@{
492	            Reached = $false
493	            Code    = 0
494	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
495	            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
496	            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
497	        }
498	    }

525	# Resolve the model: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
526	#
527	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude Code
528	#     only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to a legacy
529	#     "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
530	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
531	#     window. ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel derives it from live /v1/models metadata
532	#     for every provider. Claude Code-only: raw API clients use the plain id.
533	function script:Get-CopilotDefaultModel {
534	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL }
535	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
536	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return (Get-Content -First 1 $sf) }
537	    'gpt-5.6-sol[1m]'
538	}

540	# Every model id the proxy accepts: .id plus the .claude_model_id alias. Callers
541	# with several catalog views pass one snapshot so all decisions share one response.
542	function script:Get-CopilotServedModels {
543	    param($Catalog)
544	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
545	    if (-not $Catalog) { return @() }
546	    $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
547	    foreach ($m in $Catalog.data) {

549	        if ($m.claude_model_id) { $ids.Add([string]$m.claude_model_id) }
550	    }
551	    $ids | Sort-Object -Unique
552	}

572	# Pick exactly one live inference target. The configured main wins only when its
573	# raw id is advertised; otherwise the catalog-ranked fallback is explicit.
574	function script:Resolve-CopilotDoctorTarget {
575	    param([string] $ConfiguredMain, [string[]] $RawModel)
576	    $RawModel = @($RawModel | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch 'embedding' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
577	    $rawConfigured = Remove-CopilotContextHint $ConfiguredMain
578	    if ($rawConfigured -and $RawModel -contains $rawConfigured) {
579	        return [pscustomobject]@{
580	            Model  = $rawConfigured
581	            Label  = 'ConfiguredMain'
582	            Reason = 'configured main is advertised by the live catalog'
583	        }
584	    }
585	
586	    $fallback = Select-CopilotBestModel -Model $RawModel
587	    $reason = if ($rawConfigured) {
588	        "configured main '$rawConfigured' is not advertised by the live catalog"
589	    } else {
590	        'no configured main model was found'
591	    }
592	    [pscustomobject]@{
593	        Model  = $fallback
594	        Label  = 'CatalogFallback'
595	        Reason = $reason
596	    }
597	}

599	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText {
600	    param($Value, [int] $MaxLength = 320)
601	    $text = if ($Value -is [string]) { $Value } else {
602	        try { $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress -ErrorAction Stop } catch { [string]$Value }
603	    }
604	    $text = ($text -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
605	    if ($text.Length -gt $MaxLength) { return $text.Substring(0, $MaxLength - 3) + '...' }
606	    $text
607	}

609	# Error bodies appear as direct code/message pairs, error.code/error.message, or
610	# another JSON error encoded inside error.message. Normalize all three shapes.
611	function script:Get-CopilotApiError {
612	    param($Body, [int] $Depth = 0)
613	    $raw = ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText $Body
614	    if ($Depth -gt 4) {
615	        return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw }
616	    }
617	
618	    $object = $Body
619	    if ($Body -is [string]) {
620	        try { $object = $Body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop }
621	        catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
622	    }
623	    if (-not $object) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
624	
625	    $container = $object
626	    if ($object.PSObject.Properties['error']) {
627	        $container = $object.error
628	        if ($container -is [string]) {
629	            $nestedError = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $container -Depth ($Depth + 1)
630	            if ($nestedError.Code -or $nestedError.Message) { return $nestedError }
631	        }
632	    }
633	
634	    $code = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['code']) { [string]$container.code } else { $null }
635	    $message = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['message']) { [string]$container.message } else { $null }
636	    if ($message -and $message.TrimStart().StartsWith('{')) {
637	        $nestedMessage = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $message -Depth ($Depth + 1)
638	        if ($nestedMessage.Code -or $nestedMessage.Message) { return $nestedMessage }
639	    }
640	    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Message = $message; Raw = $raw }
641	}
642	
643	function script:Classify-CopilotInferenceError {
644	    param([int] $StatusCode, $Body)
645	    $errorInfo = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $Body
646	    $code = ([string]$errorInfo.Code).ToLowerInvariant()
647	    $detailParts = @($errorInfo.Code, $errorInfo.Message) | Where-Object { $_ }
648	    $detail = $detailParts -join ': '
649	    if (-not $detail) { $detail = $errorInfo.Raw }
650	
651	    if ($StatusCode -eq 402 -and $code -eq 'billing_not_configured') {
652	        return [pscustomobject]@{
653	            Kind        = 'BillingNotConfigured'
654	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
655	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
656	            Summary     = "account-wide GitHub Copilot billing is not configured: $detail"
657	            Retryable   = $false
658	            AccountWide = $true
659	            Action      = 'https://github.com/settings/copilot/features'
660	            Guidance    = 'Select an organization or enterprise in GitHub''s "Usage billed to" setting. Changing the model, using --auto, or enabling the shim cannot fix this account-wide failure.'
661	        }
662	    }
663	
664	    if ($code -match '^(model_not_supported|model_unsupported|unsupported_model)$') {
665	        return [pscustomobject]@{
666	            Kind        = 'ModelUnsupported'
667	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
668	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
669	            Summary     = $detail
670	            Retryable   = $false
671	            AccountWide = $false
672	            Action      = 'Run copilot-model --auto, or copilot-model -l and select a model advertised by the live catalog.'
673	            Guidance    = $null
674	        }
675	    }
676	
677	    [pscustomobject]@{
678	        Kind        = 'HttpError'
679	        Code        = $errorInfo.Code
680	        Message     = $errorInfo.Message
681	        Summary     = $detail
682	        Retryable   = ($StatusCode -eq 429 -or $StatusCode -ge 500)
683	        AccountWide = $false
684	        Action      = $null
685	        Guidance    = $null
686	    }
687	}

689	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
690	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
691	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
692	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
693	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
694	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
695	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
696	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
697	    if ($Catalog) {
698	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
699	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
700	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
701	        return $raw
702	    }
703	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
704	    $raw
705	}

709	    foreach ($c in $Candidate) { if ($Model -contains $c) { return $c } }
710	    $null
711	}

713	# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
714	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
715	# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
716	function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
717	    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
718	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
719	    $models = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $Catalog
720	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
721	    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
722	
723	    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
724	    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
725	        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
726	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
727	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
728	
729	        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
730	            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
731	        )
732	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
733	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
734	
735	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
736	            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
737	        )
738	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
739	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
740	
741	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
742	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
743	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
744	    }
745	    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
746	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
747	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
748	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
749	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
750	    }
751	
752	    [ordered]@{
753	        main   = $main
754	        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
755	        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
756	        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
757	        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
758	    }
759	}

770	# "<model>|<source>" — the model Claude Code would send from this directory.
771	function script:Get-CopilotEffectiveModel {
772	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
773	    if (Test-Path $settings) {
774	        try {
775	            $j = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
776	            if ($j.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
777	                $m = $j.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
778	                if ($m) { return "$m|project pin: $settings" }
779	            }
780	        } catch { $null = $_ }
781	    }
782	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return "$($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL)|`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" }
783	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState

785	    "$(Get-CopilotDefaultModel)|built-in default"

788	# The EXACT env block `copilot-here on` / `copilot-run` would apply right now.
789	#
790	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for three callers: copilot-run (process env),
791	# `copilot-here on` (what it merges into settings.local.json) and
792	# Get-CopilotHereDrift (what it compares against). These used to be hand-maintained
793	# copies and they diverged — the drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `on` writes,
794	# so a pin missing ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
795	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC reported "no drift" while `on` would
796	# still have changed it. Add a key here and all three follow.
797	#
798	# -Pinned uses the shim base when the shim is enabled but not yet up (what a
799	# written-to-disk pin should say); copilot-run wants the live base instead.
800	function script:Get-CopilotEnvBlock {
801	    param([switch] $Pinned, [string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
802	    $modelProfile = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) {
803	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
804	    } else {
805	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model
806	    }
807	    $block = [ordered]@{
808	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = if ($Pinned) { Get-CopilotPinnedBase } else { Get-CopilotClientBase }
809	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
810	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $modelProfile.main
811	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL  = $modelProfile.fable
812	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $modelProfile.opus
813	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = $modelProfile.sonnet
814	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = $modelProfile.haiku
815	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = $modelProfile.haiku
816	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
817	    }
818	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
819	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
820	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
821	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
822	        $block.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
823	    }
824	    $block
825	}

827	# --- shim start/stop ---
828	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
829	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
830	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
831	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
832	    }
833	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
834	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
835	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
836	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
837	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
838	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
839	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
840	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
841	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
842	}
843	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
844	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
845	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
846	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
847	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
848	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
849	    }
850	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
851	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
852	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
853	}
854	
855	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
856	function copilot-proxy {
857	    [CmdletBinding()]
858	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
859	
860	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
861	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
862	    }
863	
864	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
865	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
866	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
867	
868	    switch ($action) {
869	        'start' {
870	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
871	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
872	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
873	            }
874	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
875	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
876	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
877	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
878	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
879	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
880	            }
881	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
882	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
883	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
884	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
885	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
886	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
887	
888	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
889	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
890	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
891	            if ($httpProxy) {
892	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
893	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
894	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
895	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
896	            }
897	
898	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
899	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
900	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
901	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
902	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
903	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
904	            } else {
905	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
906	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
907	            }
908	
909	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
910	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
911	            $saved = @{}
912	            if ($httpProxy) {
913	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
914	            }
915	            try {
916	                $spArgs = @{
917	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
918	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
919	                    PassThru                = $true
920	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
921	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
922	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
923	                }
924	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
925	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
926	            } finally {
927	                if ($httpProxy) {
928	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
929	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
930	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
931	                    }
932	                }
933	            }
934	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
935	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
936	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
937	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
938	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
939	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
940	                    }
941	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
942	                    return
943	                }
944	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
945	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
946	                if ($p.HasExited) {
947	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
948	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
949	                }
950	                Start-Sleep 1
951	            }
952	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
953	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
954	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
955	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
956	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
957	        }
958	        'stop' {
959	            Stop-CopilotShim
960	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
961	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
962	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
963	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
964	            }
965	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
966	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
967	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
968	            Start-Sleep 1
969	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
970	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
971	        }
972	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
973	        'status' {
974	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
975	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
976	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
977	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
978	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
979	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
980	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
981	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
982	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
983	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
984	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
985	            } else {
986	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
987	            }
988	        }
989	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
990	        'logs' {
991	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
992	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
993	            } else {
994	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
995	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
996	            }
997	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
998	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
999	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
1000	        }
1001	        'auth' {
1002	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
1003	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
1004	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
1005	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth login --provider copilot }
1006	        }
1007	        'reinstall' {
1008	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
1009	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
1010	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
1011	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1012	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1013	            $installed = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1014	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $($installed.Name)@$($installed.Version) (requested $(Get-CopilotPkg)) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
1015	        }
1016	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
1017	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
1018	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1019	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
1020	            }
1021	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1022	                try {
1023	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
1024	                    [pscustomobject]@{
1025	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
1026	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
1027	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
1028	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
1029	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
1030	            } else {
1031	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
1032	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
1033	            }
1034	        }
1035	        'shim' {
1036	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
1037	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
1038	            switch ($sub) {
1039	                'on' {
1040	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
1041	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
1042	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
1043	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
1044	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1045	                }
1046	                'off' {
1047	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
1048	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
1049	                }
1050	                default {
1051	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1052	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
1053	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1054	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
1055	                }
1056	            }
1057	        }
1058	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
1059	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1060	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
1061	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
1062	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1063	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
1064	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1065	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1066	        }
1067	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
1068	    }
1069	}
1070	
1071	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
1072	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
1073	    param([switch] $Live)
1074	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1075	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
1076	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
1077	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
1078	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
1079	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
1080	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
1081	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
1082	
1083	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
1084	
1085	    # This is the doctor's only /v1/models fetch. The same snapshot determines
1086	    # liveness, raw ids, aliases, role checks and the optional live target.
1087	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1088	    $proxyAlive = $null -ne $catalog
1089	
1090	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
1091	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
1092	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1093	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
1094	    }
1095	
1096	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
1097	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
1098	    # network at all. Report live metadata even when it disagrees with the selector.
1099	    $installedMetadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1100	    $installedStamp = Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata
1101	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
1102	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
1103	        OK 'installed' "$($installedMetadata.Name)@$($installedMetadata.Version) (requested $pkg)"
1104	        $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()
1105	        if ($launch.Cwd) { $how += "   (cwd: $($launch.Cwd))" }
1106	        SKIP 'runs via' $how
1107	    } elseif ($installedMetadata) {
1108	        NOTE 'installed' "$($installedMetadata.Name)@$($installedMetadata.Version) does not verify requested $pkg"
1109	        $exactVersion = Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion
1110	        if ($installedMetadata.Name -cne (Get-CopilotPkgName)) {
1111	            HINT "metadata name mismatch: wanted $(Get-CopilotPkgName), found $($installedMetadata.Name)"
1112	        } elseif ($exactVersion -and $installedMetadata.Version -cne $exactVersion) {
1113	            HINT "metadata version mismatch: wanted $exactVersion, found $($installedMetadata.Version)"
1114	        } elseif (-not $launch) {
1115	            HINT 'metadata exists but no runnable launch path is available'
1116	        } elseif (-not $installedStamp) {
1117	            HINT 'verified JSON stamp is absent or corrupt'
1118	        } else {
1119	            HINT "stamp mismatch: requested=$($installedStamp.RequestedSpec), name=$($installedStamp.Name), version=$($installedStamp.Version)"
1120	        }
1121	        HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall'
1122	    } else {
1123	        NOTE 'not installed' "$pkg — no readable installed package metadata; the next start installs it"
1124	        HINT 'copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now'
1125	    }
1126	
1127	    Write-Host "`nAuthentication"
1128	    if (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken)) { OK 'token file' (Get-CopilotToken) } else { BAD 'token file' 'absent'; HINT 'copilot-proxy auth' }
1129	
1130	    Write-Host "`nProxy"
1131	    if ($proxyAlive) { OK 'listening' (Get-CopilotBase) } else { BAD 'listening' "nothing on port $port"; HINT 'copilot-proxy start' }
1132	    # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds the
1133	    # port: `start` just says "did not come up in time" and the log shows only
1134	    # "Resolving dependencies". Hard failure when nothing is listening (that IS the
1135	    # fault), softer when the proxy is up (a leftover still holding bun's cache lock,
1136	    # which will hang the next restart).
1137	    $stale = @(Get-CopilotStaleInstaller)
1138	    if ($stale.Count -gt 0) {
1139	        if ($proxyAlive) { NOTE 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)" }
1140	        else { BAD 'stale installer' "$($stale.Count) wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at `"Resolving dependencies`", never binds port $port" }
1141	        HINT "kill just those: Stop-Process -Id $($stale.ProcessId -join ',') -Force"
1142	        HINT 'then: copilot-proxy reinstall'
1143	        HINT 're-hangs? bun is stalling on the proxy — $env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1; copilot-proxy reinstall'
1144	    } else {
1145	        SKIP 'installer' "no wedged 'bun add' process"
1146	    }
1147	    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1148	        if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { OK 'throttle shim' "up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)" } else { BAD 'throttle shim' 'enabled but DOWN'; HINT 'copilot-proxy shim on' }
1149	    } else { SKIP 'throttle shim' 'off' }
1150	
1151	    Write-Host "`nModels"
1152	    $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
1153	    $proxyMode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
1154	    if ($httpProxy) { NOTE 'http proxy' "$httpProxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this" }
1155	    else { SKIP 'http proxy' "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$proxyMode)" }
1156	
1157	    # A/B: true-direct vs via the local proxy. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog
1158	    # on some egress, and .NET/curl follow the System Proxy by default — so a single
1159	    # "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as an entitlement problem.
1160	    $dirClaude = 0; $viaClaude = 0; $anyUpstream = $false
1161	    $upDirect = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via 'direct'
1162	    if ($upDirect) {
1163	        $anyUpstream = $true
1164	        $dirClaude = @($upDirect | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
1165	        OK 'upstream direct' "$($upDirect.Count) ids, $dirClaude claude (no proxy)"
1166	    } else {
1167	        SKIP 'upstream direct' 'could not query GitHub direct (need a token, or blocked)'
1168	    }
1169	    if ($httpProxy) {
1170	        $upVia = Get-CopilotUpstreamModel -Via $httpProxy
1171	        if ($upVia) {
1172	            $anyUpstream = $true
1173	            $viaClaude = @($upVia | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' }).Count
1174	            OK 'upstream via proxy' "$($upVia.Count) ids, $viaClaude claude ($httpProxy)"
1175	        } else {
1176	            BAD 'upstream via proxy' "no response through $httpProxy"
1177	            HINT 'the Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another selection'
1178	        }
1179	    }
1180	
1181	    # The one local catalog snapshot drives raw ids, aliases, role checks and the
1182	    # live target. Do not mix decisions from several /v1/models responses.
1183	    $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
1184	    $served = @(Get-CopilotServedModels -Catalog $catalog)
1185	    if ($served.Count -gt 0) {
1186	        $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' })
1187	        OK 'served catalog' "$($rawIds.Count) raw ids, $($served.Count) ids including Claude Code aliases"
1188	        if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { OK 'claude catalog' "$($claude.Count) raw Claude ids advertised (inference not yet tested)" }
1189	        else { NOTE 'claude catalog' "0 of $($rawIds.Count) raw ids — select an advertised non-Claude model explicitly" }
1190	
1191	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0) {
1192	            NOTE 'egress geo' 'Claude appears ONLY via the local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct egress'
1193	            if ($claude.Count -eq 0) {
1194	                BAD 'MISSING --proxy-env' 'copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog'
1195	                HINT 'copilot-proxy restart   # auto attaches --proxy-env when a proxy is detected'
1196	                HINT '$env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7897"; copilot-proxy restart'
1197	            }
1198	        } elseif ($viaClaude -eq 0 -and $dirClaude -eq 0 -and $anyUpstream) {
1199	            NOTE 'entitlement' 'neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude'
1200	            HINT 'org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help'
1201	        } elseif ($claude.Count -eq 0 -and $viaClaude -gt 0) {
1202	            BAD 'STALE CACHE' 'via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not'
1203	            HINT 'copilot-proxy restart'
1204	        } elseif ($claude.Count -gt 0) {
1205	            OK 'cache' 'the served Claude list looks healthy'
1206	        }
1207	
1208	        $pin = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
1209	        $model = $pin[0]; $src = $pin[1]
1210	        if ($served -contains $model) { OK 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)" }
1211	        else {
1212	            BAD 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)"
1213	            HINT 'not served -> requests return 400 model_not_supported'
1214	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # Claude; else capability-ranked OpenAI, then Gemini'
1215	            HINT 'copilot-model -l       # list served ids'
1216	        }
1217	
1218	        # Validate every alias Claude Code may select for background/subagent
1219	        # work. A stale Sonnet/Haiku id can fail with 400 while main chat works.
1220	        $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
1221	        $modelProfile = $null
1222	        if (Test-Path $settings) {
1223	            try {
1224	                $localEnv = (Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env
1225	                if ($localEnv.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
1226	                    $modelProfile = [ordered]@{
1227	                        main   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
1228	                        fable  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
1229	                        opus   = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
1230	                        sonnet = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
1231	                        haiku  = $localEnv.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
1232	                    }
1233	                }
1234	            } catch { $modelProfile = $null }
1235	        }
1236	        if (-not $modelProfile) {
1237	            $modelProfile = Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $model -Catalog $catalog
1238	        }
1239	        $roleBad = $false
1240	        foreach ($role in 'fable', 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku') {
1241	            $roleModel = $modelProfile[$role]
1242	            if (-not $roleModel) {
1243	                BAD "role $role" 'unset — Claude Code may choose its native default and get model_not_supported'
1244	                $roleBad = $true
1245	            }
1246	            elseif ($served -notcontains $roleModel) {
1247	                BAD "role $role" "$roleModel is not served"
1248	                $roleBad = $true
1249	            }
1250	        }
1251	        if (-not $roleBad) {
1252	            OK 'model roles' "fable=$($modelProfile.fable), opus=$($modelProfile.opus), sonnet=$($modelProfile.sonnet), haiku=$($modelProfile.haiku)"
1253	        } else {
1254	            HINT 'copilot-model --auto   # rewrite main + every Claude Code role alias'
1255	        }
1256	    } else {
1257	        BAD 'served' "could not fetch $(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models"
1258	        if ($viaClaude -gt 0) { HINT 'start with the proxy: copilot-proxy start   # attaches --proxy-env automatically' }
1259	    }
1260	
1261	    Write-Host "`nUpstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
1262	    foreach ($h in 'api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com', 'api.githubcopilot.com') {
1263	        try {
1264	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1265	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://$h/models" -TimeoutSec 12 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1266	            $sw.Stop()
1267	            OK $h "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
1268	        } catch { BAD $h 'no response within 12s'; HINT 'connection blocked or upstream unreachable' }
1269	    }
1270	    SKIP '' 'HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)'
1271	
1272	    Write-Host "`nCodex Apps (ChatGPT MCP)"
1273	    $appsUri = 'https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/apps'
1274	    SKIP 'route' "$appsUri — independent of localhost Copilot inference and Codex.app"
1275	    if (-not $Live) {
1276	        SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to compare direct and configured-proxy reachability'
1277	    } else {
1278	        $appsDirect = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via 'direct'
1279	        if ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1280	            OK 'direct' "HTTP $($appsDirect.Code) in $($appsDirect.Seconds)s (an auth rejection still proves reachability)"
1281	        } else {
1282	            NOTE 'direct' "$($appsDirect.Kind) failure after $($appsDirect.Seconds)s"
1283	            if ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'tls') { HINT 'inspect antivirus/corporate TLS interception and the Windows trust store' }
1284	            elseif ($appsDirect.Kind -eq 'timeout') { HINT 'the ChatGPT Apps route is blocked or not entering the expected TUN path' }
1285	        }
1286	
1287	        if ($httpProxy) {
1288	            $appsVia = Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe -Uri $appsUri -Via $httpProxy
1289	            if ($appsVia.Reached) {
1290	                OK 'via proxy' "HTTP $($appsVia.Code) in $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1291	                if (-not $appsDirect.Reached) {
1292	                    HINT "Codex Apps needs this route; launch Codex with HTTPS_PROXY=$httpProxy or repair TUN routing"
1293	                }
1294	            } elseif ($appsDirect.Reached) {
1295	                SKIP 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure — direct already works, so Apps need no explicit proxy"
1296	            } else {
1297	                NOTE 'via proxy' "$($appsVia.Kind) failure after $($appsVia.Seconds)s ($httpProxy)"
1298	                HINT 'this does not invalidate GitHub Copilot inference; it only explains codex_apps startup failures'
1299	            }
1300	        } else {
1301	            SKIP 'via proxy' 'no explicit/system HTTP proxy detected; TUN may still carry direct traffic'
1302	        }
1303	    }
1304	
1305	    Write-Host "`nLive probe"
1306	    $effective = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
1307	    $probeTarget = Resolve-CopilotDoctorTarget -ConfiguredMain $effective[0] -RawModel $rawIds
1308	    if (-not $Live) { SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)' }
1309	    elseif (-not $proxyAlive) { SKIP 'skipped' 'proxy is not running' }
1310	    elseif (-not $probeTarget.Model) { SKIP 'skipped' 'the catalog has no usable inference model' }
1311	    else {
1312	        $pm = $probeTarget.Model
1313	        SKIP 'target' "$pm [$($probeTarget.Label): $($probeTarget.Reason)]"
1314	        $body = @{ model = $pm; max_tokens = 1; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'hi' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
1315	        try {
1316	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
1317	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotClientBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `
1318	                -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
1319	            $sw.Stop()
1320	            if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300) {
1321	                OK 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
1322	            } else {

1346	# ------------------------------------------------------------- copilot-run ----
1347	function copilot-run {
1348	    [CmdletBinding()]
1349	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1350	    if (-not $Argv -or $Argv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]'; return }
1351	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
1352	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) { Start-CopilotShim | Out-Null }
1353	
1354	    # Single source of truth — see Get-CopilotEnvBlock.
1355	    $inject = Get-CopilotEnvBlock
1356	    # Scope env to the child process: set, run, restore (equivalent to `env VAR=..`).
1357	    $saved = @{}
1358	    foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) { $saved[$k] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($k); Set-Item "env:$k" $inject[$k] }
1359	    try {
1360	        $exe = $Argv[0]; $rest = if ($Argv.Count -gt 1) { $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
1361	        & $exe @rest
1362	    } finally {
1363	        foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) {
1364	            if ($null -eq $saved[$k]) { Remove-Item "env:$k" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1365	            else { Set-Item "env:$k" $saved[$k] }
1366	        }
1367	    }
1368	}

1414	                if ($v) { return $v }
1415	            }
1416	        }
1417	    }
1418	    'codex'
1419	}
